date_basis: The ACM-deposited Crossref record gives November 7, 2022 for both online and print publication; this date is not inferred solely from the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 记录将在线及印刷出版日期均列为 2022 年 11 月 7 日；该日期并非仅根据会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2022 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: StateInspector learns protocol Mealy machines by combining active message queries with snapshots of runtime memory, without requiring the target’s source code. It identifies candidate state-defining heap locations and uses taint and concolic analysis to merge states, evaluated by the authors on TLS 1.2 and WPA/2 implementations.
description_zh: StateInspector 将主动消息查询与运行时内存快照结合起来，学习协议的 Mealy 状态机，无需目标实现的源代码。它识别可能决定状态的堆内存位置，并通过污点分析与混合执行合并状态；作者在 TLS 1.2 和 WPA/2 实现上进行了评估。
scope_limitations_en: Assumes a finite Mealy-machine abstraction, a known input alphabet that can reach the relevant states, and state-defining memory on the heap exercised by bootstrap queries. State merging depends on configured search-depth and symbolic look-ahead bounds. Missing inputs or state stored elsewhere can leave behavior unmodeled; malformed harness messages, response abstraction and timeouts can create misleading transitions. Learned models and bounded checks do not establish full implementation equivalence, recover unknown message formats or reconstruct an application’s source code.
scope_limitations_zh: 假设协议可抽象为有限 Mealy 状态机、已知输入字母表能到达相关状态，且决定状态的内存位于堆上并可由初始化查询触及。状态合并依赖所配置的搜索深度与符号执行前瞻上限。缺失的输入或存储在其他位置的状态可能导致行为未被建模；测试驱动程序构造的错误消息、响应抽象方式和超时也可能产生误导性转移。学习出的模型与有界检查不能证明实现完全等价，也不恢复未知消息格式或重建应用源代码。
why_fits_en: Provides a concrete method for reconstructing communication-state behavior from executable protocol implementations and testing deviations from expected flows, complementing message-format inference.
why_fits_zh: 提供从可执行协议实现中重建通信状态行为、检查其与预期流程偏差的具体方法，可与消息格式推断互补。
metadata_notes: Reviewed the author-hosted 19-page copy; ACM-deposited metadata lists proceedings pages 2265–2278, so these are not asserted to be identical PDF versions. Public code documents a dated Linux setup with Python 2, OpenJDK 14, Maven, per-protocol input/reset harnesses and target-specific ptrace hooks. The taint path requires Triton and IDA Pro/Wine; omitting it can prevent termination on counters. No project-wide license was found in the inspected repository; component licenses and proprietary-tool rights remain separate. Only public text and paper documents were retrieved; no upstream code was executed and no encrypted archive was downloaded or decrypted.
metadata_notes_zh: 核查的是作者托管的 19 页版本；ACM 提交的元数据将论文集页码列为 2265–2278，因此不声称两者是完全相同的 PDF 版本。公开代码记录了较早的 Linux 环境，包括 Python 2、OpenJDK 14、Maven、针对各协议的输入与重置测试驱动程序，以及目标相关的 ptrace 钩子。污点分析路径需要 Triton 和 IDA Pro/Wine；省略该路径可能因计数器而无法终止。所检查仓库中未发现项目整体许可证；各组件许可与专有工具使用权需分别处理。本次仅获取公开文本及论文文档，未执行上游代码，也未下载或解密加密归档。

title: HALucinator: Firmware Re-hosting Through Abstraction Layer Emulation
title_zh: HALucinator：通过抽象层仿真实现固件重托管
date_basis: The official USENIX proceedings citation gives August 2020. Month precision is retained; the conference’s event dates are not substituted for a publication day.
date_basis_zh: USENIX 官方论文集引用信息给出 2020 年 8 月。保留月份精度，不把会议举办日期当作具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 29th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 20)

description_en: HALucinator rehosts monolithic ARM Cortex-M firmware by identifying hardware-abstraction-library functions and replacing them with authored Python handlers and peripheral models. LibMatch locates library interfaces; the QEMU/Avatar2 implementation supports interactive I/O, while the paper-associated HAL-fuzz variant uses AFL-Unicorn for fuzzing.
description_zh: HALucinator 识别单体 ARM Cortex-M 固件中的硬件抽象库函数，并用人工编写的 Python 处理函数和外设模型替换它们，从而重托管固件。LibMatch 定位库接口；QEMU/Avatar2 实现支持交互式输入输出，与论文关联的 HAL-fuzz 变体则使用 AFL-Unicorn 进行模糊测试。
scope_limitations_en: LibMatch requires an available HAL/library and a sufficiently similar compilation environment; compiler variation and inlining limit matching. Rehosting also needs a QEMU-supported architecture, firmware memory layout, interception addresses and authored handlers/models. Unmodeled direct hardware accesses may return zero or ignore writes, and simplified timing and peripheral behavior do not establish hardware equivalence. The authors’ rehosting and fuzzing demonstrations are not universal firmware coverage, complete device reconstruction or original-source recovery.
scope_limitations_zh: LibMatch 需要可获取的硬件抽象层或库，以及足够相似的编译环境；编译器差异与内联会限制匹配效果。重托管还需要 QEMU 支持的架构、固件内存布局、拦截地址及人工编写的处理函数和模型。未建模的直接硬件访问可能在读取时返回零、在写入时被忽略；简化的时序与外设行为不能证明硬件等价。作者的重托管与模糊测试演示不代表普遍覆盖所有固件、完整重建设备或恢复原始源代码。
why_fits_en: Shows how binary library identification and explicit environment models can reconstruct enough of an embedded execution environment to analyze existing firmware, with the abstraction boundary made visible.
why_fits_zh: 展示如何通过二进制库识别与显式环境模型，重建分析已有固件所需的嵌入式执行环境，并明确其抽象边界。
metadata_notes: Reviewed the final USENIX paper, pages 1201–1218; no DOI or arXiv identifier is asserted. The paper-linked embedded-sec/halucinator repository carries GPLv3, while the separate ucsb-seclab/hal-fuzz implementation carries Apache-2.0; these licenses are not interchangeable. The original README describes a lightly tested Ubuntu 16.04/18.04 and Python 3 environment with Avatar2, QEMU and GDB, and points to a newer project separately. Reproduction needs firmware images, compatible HAL/SDK inputs and configuration; vendor firmware, dependencies and SDK rights remain separate. HAL-fuzz uses simplified handlers and deterministic timers rather than wall-clock equivalence. No firmware binaries were retrieved and no upstream runtime or experiment was executed.
metadata_notes_zh: 核查的是 USENIX 正式论文，页码 1201–1218；不推定 DOI 或 arXiv 标识。论文链接的 embedded-sec/halucinator 仓库采用 GPLv3，独立的 ucsb-seclab/hal-fuzz 实现采用 Apache-2.0，两者许可不可混同。原始 README 记载了仅经有限测试的 Ubuntu 16.04/18.04 与 Python 3 环境，依赖 Avatar2、QEMU 和 GDB，并另行指向较新项目。复现需要固件镜像、兼容的 HAL/SDK 输入及配置；厂商固件、依赖项和 SDK 的使用权需分别处理。HAL-fuzz 使用简化处理函数和确定性计时器，不保证与真实时钟等价。本次未获取固件二进制，也未运行上游程序或实验。

title: User-Space Dependency-Aware Rehosting for Linux-Based Firmware Binaries
title_zh: 面向 Linux 固件二进制的用户空间依赖感知重托管
date_basis: The Internet Society’s Crossref deposit and the official NDSS paper identify publication year 2026. No finer publication date is asserted from the conference event dates.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 提交的 Crossref 元数据与 NDSS 官方论文标明出版年份为 2026；不根据会议举办日期推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: FIRMWELL reconstructs the execution environment of Linux firmware services by running their initialization processes, locating blocking dependencies and repairing missing system-level behavior. It combines containerized QEMU-user emulation with a QEMU-system fallback, using process traces and binary analysis to recover resources needed by the target service.
description_zh: FIRMWELL 通过运行初始化进程、定位阻塞依赖并修补缺失的系统层行为，重建 Linux 固件服务的执行环境。它结合容器化 QEMU-user 仿真与 QEMU-system 回退，并利用进程轨迹和二进制分析恢复目标服务所需的资源。
scope_limitations_en: The evaluation concerns selected network services, not complete device or hardware equivalence. HTTP acceptance uses configured response-status and error-content checks; other services need their own criteria. Coverage depends on unpacking, supported architectures, initialization heuristics and peripheral models. Symbolic path explosion, solver timeouts and complex peripheral checks remain failure modes. The paper’s recovery strategy avoids patching target binaries; successful service interaction does not establish recovery of original source code or every device function.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估针对选定网络服务，并非完整设备或硬件等价。HTTP 验收采用配置好的响应状态与错误内容检查；其他服务需要各自的判定标准。覆盖范围受解包、架构支持、初始化启发式规则和外设模型限制，符号执行路径爆炸、求解超时及复杂外设检查仍可能导致失败。论文中的修复策略避免补丁修改目标二进制；服务交互成功不能证明恢复了原始源码或全部设备功能。
why_fits_en: A concrete method for reconstructing the dependencies around shipped firmware binaries, complementing HAL-level and full-system rehosting research.
why_fits_zh: 提供围绕已发布固件二进制重建运行依赖的具体方法，可与 HAL 层及全系统重托管研究互补。
metadata_notes: The nine-author order follows the official paper. Crossref agrees on the DOI but repeats Jian Zhang as a tenth author row; that duplicate is not reproduced here. Its appendix lists 1 CPU core, 4 GiB RAM and 100 GiB disk per task, and describes the full firmware corpus as private. The pinned repository declares GPLv3; vendor firmware and dependencies retain separate terms. Its Docker-in-Docker workflow uses an elevated-privilege outer container, and the authors recommend VM isolation; the current inner-container privilege flag defaults off. Mutable container tags mean the source pin alone does not fix the execution environment. Experiments were not rerun for this collection.
metadata_notes_zh: 九位作者的顺序以官方论文为准。Crossref 的 DOI 相符，但将 Jian Zhang 重复列为第十个作者条目；此处不沿用该重复项。论文附录列出每个任务需 1 个 CPU 核心、4 GiB 内存和 100 GiB 磁盘，并将完整固件语料描述为私有。固定仓库声明采用 GPLv3；厂商固件与依赖仍有各自条款。其 Docker-in-Docker 流程使用具有较高权限的外层容器，作者建议以虚拟机隔离；当前内层容器权限开关默认关闭。容器标签可变，因此固定源码版本本身并未固定执行环境。本合集未重新运行实验。

title: Target-Centric Firmware Rehosting with Penguin
title_zh: 使用 Penguin 进行以目标为中心的固件重托管
date_basis: The Internet Society’s Crossref deposit gives publication year 2025. The PDF footer names the 28 February 2025 workshop; no finer publication date is asserted from the event date.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据给出出版年份 2025。PDF 页脚标注研讨会于 2025 年 2 月 28 日举行；不据此推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: Penguin rehosts embedded Linux firmware from an extracted filesystem by deriving an editable configuration of emulation transformations, such as file changes, pseudofiles, NVRAM values and network interfaces, from static analysis. Dynamic-analysis plugins expose failures so the configuration can be refined for each target, and a minimizer identifies which transformations a working rehosting needs.
description_zh: Penguin 以提取出的固件文件系统为输入，通过静态分析生成可编辑的仿真变换配置（如文件修改、伪文件、NVRAM 值和网络接口），用于重托管嵌入式 Linux 固件。动态分析插件揭示运行失败，便于针对具体目标完善配置；配置最小化工具则找出可用的重托管所必需的变换。
scope_limitations_en: Targets embedded Linux firmware through whole-system emulation with kernel replacement, as in Firmadyne and FirmAE; the implementation covers x86, ARM and MIPS and relies on the Linux syscall ABI. In the FirmAE comparison, success means a process binds port 80 or 443; a non-empty HTTP response is a stricter check, and the authors note neither shows full functionality. The 75% gain over FirmAE is author-reported on their own corpus of 13,649 images from vendor websites. Refinement still needs an analyst, and nondeterministic runs were repeated up to ten times. It builds an analysis environment, not a faithful device reproduction or source recovery.
scope_limitations_zh: 面向嵌入式 Linux 固件，沿用 Firmadyne 和 FirmAE 的思路，采用替换内核的整机仿真；实现支持 x86、ARM 和 MIPS，并依赖 Linux 系统调用 ABI。与 FirmAE 对比时，判定成功的标准是有进程绑定 80 或 443 端口，更严格的检查是 HTTP 返回非空响应；作者指出两者都不代表系统功能完整。比 FirmAE 多出 75% 的结果由作者在其自建语料（13,649 个取自厂商网站的镜像）上报告。完善配置仍需分析人员参与；运行结果不完全确定，作者对配置最多重复运行十次。该工作构建的是分析环境，不代表忠实复现设备或恢复源代码。
why_fits_en: Makes firmware rehosting an explicit, shareable per-target configuration refined from runtime evidence, a reproducible way to rebuild an analyzable execution environment without the original hardware.
why_fits_zh: 将固件重托管表达为明确、可共享并针对具体目标的配置，依据运行时证据逐步完善，以可复现的方式在脱离原始硬件的条件下重建可分析的执行环境。
metadata_notes: BAR 2025 is a workshop co-located with NDSS Symposium 2025, not the NDSS main track. The 13-author order and the name ‘Wil Robertson’ follow the PDF and the Internet Society’s Crossref deposit; the NDSS paper and program pages list ‘William Robertson’ and place Caden Kline after Cole DiLorenzo. The DOI resolves directly to the PDF, whose footer gives ISBN 979-8-9919276-4-2; no page range was verified. The conclusion says 13,650 images where the abstract and appendix say 13,649. The PDF’s availability section points to rehosting/penguin but names no evaluated release; the curated tool record reviews v3.1.21 (2026-10-06), which postdates the paper. The repository is GPL-2.0-or-later at the pinned commit, and the paper does not describe its firmware corpus as released. Experiments were not rerun for this collection.
metadata_notes_zh: BAR 2025 是与 NDSS Symposium 2025 同期举办的研讨会，并非 NDSS 主会。13 位作者的顺序及“Wil Robertson”的写法以 PDF 和 Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据为准；NDSS 论文页和日程页写作“William Robertson”，并将 Caden Kline 排在 Cole DiLorenzo 之后。该 DOI 直接解析到 PDF，PDF 页脚标注 ISBN 979-8-9919276-4-2；未核实页码范围。论文结论写作 13,650 个镜像，摘要和附录则为 13,649 个。PDF 的“可用性”一节指向 rehosting/penguin 仓库，但未注明评测所用版本；精选工具条目审阅的 v3.1.21（2026-10-06）晚于论文发表。固定提交中的仓库采用 GPL-2.0-or-later，论文也未说明公开其固件语料。本合集未重新运行实验。

title: Fingerprinting and analysis of Bluetooth devices with automata learning
title_zh: 基于自动机学习的蓝牙设备指纹识别与分析
date_basis: Springer-deposited Crossref metadata and the article page give the August 2022 issue date of volume 61, issue 1, represented at month precision; the 22 May 2023 online publication is recorded in metadata notes.
date_basis_zh: Springer 向 Crossref 提交的元数据及文章页面将第 61 卷第 1 期的刊期标为 2022 年 8 月，本目录采用月份精度；2023 年 5 月 22 日的在线出版日期另在元数据说明中记录。
description_en: Learns Mealy-machine models of Bluetooth Low Energy implementations on physical peripherals by active automata learning. An nRF52840 central running SweynTooth-derived firmware sends abstract BLE inputs, with error handling, repeated queries and caching for lost packets and non-deterministic replies. The authors learn connection-procedure models of six devices and legacy-pairing models of three, and use model differences to fingerprint their SoCs.
description_zh: 通过主动自动机学习，为实体外设上的低功耗蓝牙（BLE）协议实现推断 Mealy 状态机模型。运行 SweynTooth 衍生固件的 nRF52840 中心设备发送抽象 BLE 输入，并以错误处理、重复查询和缓存应对丢包与不确定的响应。作者学习了六款设备的连接过程模型和其中三款的传统配对（legacy pairing）模型，并利用模型差异识别各设备的 SoC。
scope_limitations_en: Models are bounded by the chosen abstract alphabet and cover only connection and legacy pairing; message formats are not inferred, and secure pairing is left to future work. Equivalence was approximated with a small number of conformance tests per state, so models are hypotheses, not proofs. One SoC was learnable only with reduced alphabets, two were learned from an already-connected state, and some pairing runs needed manual hard resets. The fingerprinting sequence holds only for the tested SoCs. Apart from one crashing input sequence, the authors report no security vulnerabilities in the learned models.
scope_limitations_zh: 模型受所选抽象输入字母表限制，仅覆盖连接过程和传统配对；不推断报文格式，安全配对留待后续研究。等价性仅以每个状态少量的一致性测试近似检验，因此模型只是假设而非证明。其中一款 SoC 只能缩减输入字母表后学习，两款设备从已建立连接的状态开始学习，部分配对实验还需人工硬重置设备。所得指纹识别序列仅适用于受测 SoC。除一条会导致设备崩溃的输入序列外，作者未在学习所得模型中发现安全漏洞。
why_fits_en: Reconstructs the protocol-state behavior of closed BLE implementations through black-box interaction with real devices, showing how learned state machines expose implementation differences and deviations from the specification.
why_fits_zh: 通过与真实设备的黑盒交互重建封闭 BLE 实现的协议状态行为，展示学习所得的状态机如何揭示不同实现之间的差异及其与规范的偏离。
metadata_notes: Formal Methods in System Design 61(1), pages 35–62, published online on 22 May 2023 as an open-access CC BY 4.0 article. It extends the authors’ FM 2021 paper ‘Fingerprinting Bluetooth Low Energy Devices via Active Automata Learning’ (LNCS 13047, pages 524–542, DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-90870-6_28), which is not listed separately because no open copy was verified. The ble-learning README, linked from AALpy’s applications list, names this article ‘Identification and Analysis of Bluetooth Devices via Automata Learning’, unlike the published title. Springer’s PDF could not be fetched automatically, so its full-text page and arXiv v2, the accepted manuscript, were reviewed. The study used Python 3.9.0, AALpy 1.0.1 and a modified Scapy 2.4.4; the repository, pinned at a 2025 commit, now requires aalpy>=1.1.7 and scapy>=2.4.5. It needs an nRF52840 dongle or development kit flashed with the supplied SweynTooth-derived firmware, and pairing also needs Linux with SweynTooth’s BlueZ-based Security Manager module. The repository has no license file, so no reuse license is implied. No learning experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 发表于 Formal Methods in System Design 第 61 卷第 1 期，35–62 页，于 2023 年 5 月 22 日在线出版，为 CC BY 4.0 开放获取论文。本文是作者 FM 2021 论文“Fingerprinting Bluetooth Low Energy Devices via Active Automata Learning”（LNCS 13047，524–542 页，DOI 10.1007/978-3-030-90870-6_28）的扩展版；因未核实该会议论文的公开全文，未单独收录。AALpy 应用列表链接的 ble-learning README 将本文称为“Identification and Analysis of Bluetooth Devices via Automata Learning”，与正式标题不同。Springer 的 PDF 无法自动获取，因此核查的是出版方全文页面和 arXiv v2（作者接收稿）。研究使用 Python 3.9.0、AALpy 1.0.1 和修改版 Scapy 2.4.4；固定在 2025 年提交的仓库目前要求 aalpy>=1.1.7 和 scapy>=2.4.5。运行需要一块刷入仓库所附 SweynTooth 衍生固件的 nRF52840 Dongle 或开发板，配对实验另需 Linux 及 SweynTooth 基于 BlueZ 的安全管理器（Security Manager）模块。仓库没有许可证文件，因此不意味着授予任何复用许可。本次未运行学习实验。

title: Web2Code: A Large-scale Webpage-to-Code Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Multimodal LLMs
title_zh: Web2Code：面向多模态大语言模型的大规模网页转代码数据集与评估框架
date_basis: The official NeurIPS proceedings and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata identify publication year 2024; Crossref provides no finer publication date. The first arXiv submission date is recorded separately.
date_basis_zh: NeurIPS 官方论文集与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据标明出版年份为 2024；Crossref 未提供更精确的出版日期。arXiv 首次提交日期另行记录。
description_en: Studies screenshot-to-HTML reconstruction through instruction tuning and two evaluation benchmarks. Web2Code combines generated webpages, refined WebSight and pix2code image/code pairs, and WebSRC-derived question answering. Models produce HTML from a webpage image and instruction; rendered output is compared visually, while a separate benchmark measures screenshot understanding.
description_zh: 通过指令微调和两个评测基准研究从截图重建 HTML。Web2Code 结合生成网页、经改进的 WebSight 与 pix2code 图像／代码对，以及来自 WebSRC 的问答。模型根据网页图像与指令生成 HTML，渲染输出接受视觉比较，另一个基准则测量截图理解能力。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses 1,198 screenshots and 5,990 yes/no questions. WCGB grades rendered images with GPT-4V; its User Interface and Interactivity category measures element appearance, not executed click paths, persistent state or backend behavior. Synthetic and refined examples do not establish coverage of arbitrary real web applications, original-source equivalence or code quality. The paper reports contact-information issues in 2.7% of a 1,000-item privacy sample, so a blanket claim that the data is free of such information is unsupported.
scope_limitations_zh: 评估使用 1,198 张截图和 5,990 个是／否问题。WCGB 用 GPT-4V 评价渲染图像；其“用户界面与交互性”类别衡量元素外观，并不执行点击路径、持久状态或后端行为。合成与改进样本不能确立对任意真实 Web 应用的覆盖、与原始源码等价或代码质量。论文报告，在 1,000 项隐私抽样中，2.7% 存在联系信息问题，因此不能笼统宣称数据完全不含此类信息。
why_fits_en: A foundational visual reconstruction dataset and evaluation method, useful for distinguishing screenshot fidelity from the behavioral guarantees of later website-reconstruction benchmarks.
why_fits_zh: 提供基础性的视觉重建数据集与评估方法，有助于区分截图保真度与后续网站重建基准所检验的行为保证。
metadata_notes: Published in NeurIPS volume 37, pages 112134–112157; full author names follow the proceedings PDF. The repository still cites the preprint; reviewed arXiv v2 is dated 2024-11-17. The LLaVA-based training subtree carries Apache-2.0. Dataset licensing is inconsistent: the GitHub README and dataset-card frontmatter say MIT, while the same card’s body says CC BY 4.0 with research-only/non-commercial wording. No blanket reuse permission is inferred for constituent data or model weights. The training metadata requires Python >=3.8 and pins PyTorch 2.0.1; evaluation needs browser rendering and an external vision-model API. No training, evaluation, model or dataset payload was run or downloaded.
metadata_notes_zh: 发表于 NeurIPS 第 37 卷，第 112134–112157 页；作者完整姓名以论文集 PDF 为准。仓库仍引用预印本；所审阅 arXiv v2 日期为 2024-11-17。基于 LLaVA 的训练子目录采用 Apache-2.0。数据集许可声明不一致：GitHub README 与数据卡元数据写 MIT，同一数据卡正文却写 CC BY 4.0，并附仅供研究／非商业措辞。不据此推定全部组成数据或模型权重具有统一复用许可。训练元数据要求 Python >=3.8，固定 PyTorch 2.0.1；评估需要浏览器渲染与外部视觉模型 API。本合集未运行训练或评估，也未下载模型或数据集载荷。

title: DeGPT: Optimizing Decompiler Output with LLM
title_zh: DeGPT：使用大语言模型优化反编译器输出
date_basis: The official NDSS paper and the publisher’s Crossref deposit establish publication year 2024. The conference dates and DOI registration date do not establish a publication day.
date_basis_zh: NDSS 官方论文与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据确认出版年份为 2024；会议日期与 DOI 注册日期不能据此推定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: Proceedings 2024 Network and Distributed System Security Symposium

description_en: Refines existing C-like decompiler output through three coordinated roles that select, propose and check changes. It simplifies structures, adds comments and renames variables; Micro Snippet Semantic Calculation compares simulated symbol values and calls before accepting structural changes. The authors evaluate readability and naming on 620 functions from four codebases, with separate stripped and non-stripped variants.
description_zh: 通过三个协同角色选择、提出并检查修改，改进已有的类 C 反编译输出。其流程简化代码结构、添加注释并重命名变量，在接受结构修改前，使用微代码片段语义计算比较模拟的符号值与调用。作者以四个代码库中的 620 个函数评估可读性与命名效果，并分别测试保留与剥离符号的版本。
scope_limitations_en: The reported 24.4% reduction is a Halstead-effort proxy on non-stripped output, not a measured reduction in human effort. The 62.9% comment result is the average non-trivial share among manually judged correct comments. MSSC is an intraprocedural heuristic: calls are abstracted and loops become branches; parsing, aliasing and path growth remain limitations. Its 80-case manual audit reports 84% accuracy and 85% recall, including three harmful changes missed. This supports assisted pseudocode comprehension, not guaranteed binary equivalence, recompilable whole programs or original-source recovery.
scope_limitations_zh: 报告的 24.4% 降幅来自保留符号版本输出的 Halstead 工作量代理指标，并非直接测得的人力节省。62.9% 的注释结果是人工判定正确的注释中，具有非平凡信息者的平均占比。MSSC 是过程内启发式检查：调用被抽象处理，循环转化为分支；解析、别名与路径增长仍有限制。其 80 个案例的人工审查报告准确率为 84%、召回率为 85%，其中漏过三处有害修改。这支持辅助理解伪代码，不能保证二进制等价、整程序可重新编译或恢复原始源码。
why_fits_en: A concrete LLM-assisted reverse-engineering method combining readability edits with an explicitly evaluated semantic-change filter.
why_fits_zh: 将可读性改写与经过明确评估的语义变化过滤器结合，为大语言模型辅助逆向工程提供具体方法。
metadata_notes: The publisher and PDF agree on the title, three-author order and DOI; no arXiv identifier or proceedings page range was verified. The September 2024 artifact snapshot is later than the paper, has no release tag, and declares no project license. Its README requires manually installed cinspector, openai==1.28.1, tiktoken==0.2.0 and python-levenshtein, without a DeGPT Python minimum. Current code reads model, API key and endpoint from config.ini, differing from the README’s chat.py setup example; it uses Unix-style SIGALRM timeouts. The separately pinned cinspector dependency declares WTFPL and tree-sitter==0.20.4; this does not license DeGPT or its third-party samples. The paper primarily used gpt-3.5-turbo at temperature 0.2 and Ghidra 10.2.3. Source and dependency inspection do not establish present service compatibility; experiments were not rerun.
metadata_notes_zh: 出版方与 PDF 的标题、三位作者顺序和 DOI 一致；未核实到 arXiv 标识符或论文集页码范围。2024 年 9 月的产物快照晚于论文，没有发布标签，也未声明项目许可证。其 README 要求手动安装 cinspector、openai==1.28.1、tiktoken==0.2.0 和 python-levenshtein，但未声明 DeGPT 所需的最低 Python 版本。当前代码从 config.ini 读取模型、API 密钥和端点，与 README 的 chat.py 配置示例不同，并采用 Unix 风格的 SIGALRM 超时机制。单独固定版本的 cinspector 依赖声明采用 WTFPL，并要求 tree-sitter==0.20.4；这不代表 DeGPT 或其中的第三方样本获得相同授权。论文主要采用温度为 0.2 的 gpt-3.5-turbo 与 Ghidra 10.2.3。源码和依赖审查不证明当前服务仍兼容，本合集未重新运行实验。

title: BinPRE: Enhancing Field Inference in Binary Analysis Based Protocol Reverse Engineering
title_zh: BinPRE：增强基于二进制分析的协议逆向工程中的字段推断
date_basis: The publisher’s Crossref deposit records published/print publication on 2024-12-02 and a separate publisher publication-history assertion on 2024-12-09. This record uses the published/print date; the October 14–18 CCS meeting dates and the September arXiv submission are separate.
date_basis_zh: 出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质出版日期记为 2024-12-02，另有一项出版方发表历史声明记为 2024-12-09。本条目采用 published／纸质出版日期；10 月 14–18 日的 CCS 会议日期及 9 月的 arXiv 提交日期另行区分。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2024 on ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: Infers protocol-message field boundaries and semantics from instrumented server binaries and input messages. BinPRE groups bytes by the instruction operators that process them, applies detectors for field types and functions, then refines results across similar messages. On eight protocols with 50 messages each, the authors report average field perfection of 0.73 and type/function F1 scores of 0.74/0.81.
description_zh: 根据受插桩监测的服务端二进制及输入报文，推断协议报文的字段边界与语义。BinPRE 按处理字节的指令操作符进行分组，使用检测器识别字段类型和功能，再借助相似报文细化结果。作者在八种协议、每种 50 条报文上报告平均字段完美分割率为 0.73，类型／功能推断的 F1 分数为 0.74／0.81。
scope_limitations_en: This is field inference, not recovery of a protocol state machine or complete endpoint behavior. It requires an accessible, instrumentable implementation and runtime message processing; passive captures alone are insufficient. Perfection counts exactly segmented fields against all true fields, not fully recovered protocols. The detector library covers five semantic types and six functions. Byte-level taint cannot accurately resolve bit flags, and unexercised behavior is not established. Ground truth uses Wireshark dissectors and specifications; three binary-analysis baselines were author reimplementations. Reported fuzzing improvements are a downstream evaluation, not proof of implementation equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究对象是字段推断，不是恢复协议状态机或端点的完整行为。方法需要能够访问并插桩的实现及运行时的报文处理；仅有被动捕获数据并不足够。完美分割率统计被精确分割的字段占全部真实字段的比例，而非完整恢复的协议比例。检测器库覆盖五种语义类型与六种功能。字节级污点分析无法准确解析位标志，也不确立未执行行为。真实标签依据 Wireshark 解析器与协议规范构建；三种二进制分析基线由作者重新实现。报告的模糊测试改进属于下游评估，不是实现等价性的证明。
why_fits_en: Adds recent executable-assisted protocol field and semantic inference, complementing the collection’s traffic-based syntax inference and protocol-state learning research.
why_fits_zh: 补充近期借助可执行程序进行协议字段与语义推断的研究，与合集已有的流量语法推断和协议状态学习形成互补。
metadata_notes: The author’s publication page links the CCS-formatted paper, the 17-page arXiv v1 and the artifact. Six-author order, DOI and proceedings pages match Crossref. The reviewed artifact snapshot is dated 2024-10-25 and declares no project-level license. Its README specifies Ubuntu 20.04, Python 3.8 and Intel Pin 3.28; the workflow runs a server and client and requires protocol/thread selection. The reviewed tree supplies a Modbus example, not a complete eight-protocol benchmark package; additional servers, captures and evaluation ground truth need separate setup. The README’s Docker example uses a privileged container, and the Dockerfile fetches a named branch rather than the reviewed commit. Public availability does not grant rights to bundled binaries or dependencies. No binaries, captures, containers or installers were downloaded, and no upstream code or experiments were executed.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者发表列表链接了 CCS 排版论文、17 页的 arXiv v1 及产物。六位作者顺序、DOI 和论文集页码与 Crossref 一致。所审阅产物快照日期为 2024-10-25，未声明项目级许可证。README 指定 Ubuntu 20.04、Python 3.8 与 Intel Pin 3.28；流程运行服务端和客户端，并需选择协议与线程。所审阅源码树提供 Modbus 示例，并非完整的八协议评测包；其他服务端、捕获数据及评估用真实标签需要另行配置。README 的 Docker 示例使用特权容器，Dockerfile 获取具名分支，而非所审阅的固定提交。公开可见不授予捆绑二进制或依赖的使用权。本次未下载二进制、捕获数据、容器或安装程序，也未执行上游代码或实验。

title: BinaryInferno: A Semantic-Driven Approach to Field Inference for Binary Message Formats
title_zh: BinaryInferno：面向二进制报文格式字段推断的语义驱动方法
date_basis: The official NDSS paper and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata establish publication year 2023. Crossref supplies no publication month or day; the conference dates and DOI registration date are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: NDSS 官方论文与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据确立出版年份为 2023。Crossref 未给出出版月份或日期；本条目不以会议日期或 DOI 注册日期代替。

citation.container_title: Proceedings 2023 Network and Distributed System Security Symposium

description_en: Infers partial binary-message formats from static message samples without instrumenting an executable. Specialized detectors recognize floats, timestamps, lengths, entropy boundaries and serialization patterns; a graph-based integration step reconciles their descriptions. Across samples from ten protocols, the authors report top-level field-boundary precision of 0.69, recall of 0.73 and false-positive rate of 0.04 for the 1,000-message setting without analyst priors.
description_zh: 无需对可执行程序插桩，即可从静态报文样本推断部分二进制报文格式。专用检测器识别浮点数、时间戳、长度、熵边界和序列化模式，再通过基于图的集成步骤协调各自的描述。作者对十种协议的样本开展评估，在每组 1,000 条报文且不使用分析者先验的设置下，报告顶层字段边界的精确率为 0.69、召回率为 0.73、假阳性率为 0.04。
scope_limitations_en: Assumes error-free, uncompressed, unencrypted, byte-aligned data and infers common fields or payload regions beginning at consistent offsets. It leaves optional/union fields and unsupported serialization patterns unresolved; sample diversity matters. The 26 encapsulated-payload test sets were pre-grouped using ground-truth message types, not discovered automatically. Ground truth merges adjacent fields that are constant across the sample; empty inference results are excluded from reported averages where stated. BI+ additionally uses supplied endianness and capture-time ranges. These are field-boundary results, not complete semantic recovery, protocol-state inference or behavioral equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 假设数据无错误、未经压缩或加密、按字节对齐，并推断起始偏移一致的共有字段或载荷区域。可选字段、联合类型字段及不支持的序列化模式仍未解决；样本多样性会影响结果。26 组封装载荷测试集依据已知真实报文类型预先分组，并非自动发现。真实标签合并了在整个样本中均保持常量的相邻字段；文中注明的平均值排除了没有推断结果的样本。BI+ 额外使用给定的字节序和捕获时间范围。这些是字段边界结果，不代表完整语义恢复、协议状态推断或行为等价。
why_fits_en: Provides trace-only semantic field inference that complements executable-assisted analysis and protocol-state learning, with explicit assumptions and evaluated false-positive behavior.
why_fits_zh: 提供仅依赖报文轨迹的语义字段推断，与借助可执行程序的分析及协议状态学习互补，并明确列出假设和假阳性评估。
metadata_notes: Three-author order, title and DOI agree across the publisher, paper and Crossref. No arXiv identifier or proceedings page range was verified; the PDF has 18 pages. The paper’s project URL leads to the author’s Tufts page, which links the repository. The reviewed 2023-05-02 snapshot has GPL-3.0-or-later code headers and a GPLv3 LICENSE; third-party trace provenance and rights require separate checking. README prerequisites are Python 3, sklearn, scipy and parallel, without pinned dependency versions; the pattern-search launcher also uses timeout and hardcodes 30 parallel jobs. Input is one hexadecimal message per line; timestamp search accepts a supplied time range. The actual entry file is binaryinferno/blackboard.py, despite the README’s basic-command blackboard.by typo. A dataset directory is present, but its README remains a placeholder. Historical setup and dataset completeness were not reproduced; no captures, binaries or model payloads were downloaded and no upstream code or notebooks were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 出版方、论文和 Crossref 的三位作者顺序、标题及 DOI 一致。未核实到 arXiv 标识符或论文集页码范围；PDF 共 18 页。论文给出的项目网址跳转到作者的 Tufts 页面，该页面链接了仓库。所审阅的 2023-05-02 快照在代码头部声明 GPL-3.0-or-later，并包含 GPLv3 LICENSE；第三方轨迹的来源与权利需另行核查。README 要求 Python 3、sklearn、scipy 和 parallel，未固定依赖版本；模式搜索启动脚本还使用 timeout，并将并行任务数写定为 30。输入为每行一条十六进制报文；时间戳搜索可接受给定的时间范围。实际入口文件为 binaryinferno/blackboard.py，README 的基本命令将其误写为 blackboard.by。仓库包含数据集目录，但其 README 仍是占位说明。本次未复现历史环境或确认数据集完整性；未下载捕获数据、二进制或模型载荷，也未运行上游代码或笔记本。

title: ICEPRE: ICS Protocol Reverse Engineering via Data-Driven Concolic Execution
title_zh: ICEPRE：基于数据驱动混合符号执行的工控协议逆向工程
date_basis: The ACM article page and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata agree on publication on 2025-06-22. The ISSTA presentation date is not substituted for this journal publication date.
date_basis_zh: ACM 文章页面与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据均将出版日期列为 2025-06-22；本条目不以 ISSTA 报告日期替代该期刊出版日期。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering (ISSTA 2025)

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering

description_en: Infers message-field boundaries by following concrete message-guided paths through binary protocol parsers, then symbolically replaying them to extract byte-level data flow. It merges bytes using value-preserving operations and similar processing traces. For the 1,000-message datasets of four public ICS protocols, the authors report average boundary F1 of 0.76 and field perfection of 0.67.
description_zh: 在二进制协议解析器中沿具体报文引导的路径分析，再进行符号化重放，提取字节级数据流以推断报文字段边界。它依据保持原值的运算和相似处理轨迹合并字节。作者在四种公开工控协议、每组 1,000 条报文的数据集上，报告平均边界 F1 分数为 0.76、字段完美分割率为 0.67。
scope_limitations_en: Recovers message syntax, not field semantics, protocol state machines or endpoint equivalence. It needs the binary, loader configuration and correctly identified initialization, input and parsing functions; manual filtering remains necessary, especially without symbols. Encrypted protocols and bit-level fields are unsupported, and ignored or only copied bytes can be merged incorrectly. Perfection measures fields with both boundaries correct. Quantitative tests use four public protocols with 50- and 1,000-message sets; separate proprietary studies cover three protocols in five firmware targets, with interaction checks on three devices and manually established ground truth. Those checks do not demonstrate complete device behavior.
scope_limitations_zh: 恢复的是报文语法，并非字段语义、协议状态机或端点等价性。方法需要二进制、加载配置，以及正确识别的初始化、输入和解析函数；尤其在缺少符号时，仍需人工筛选。不支持加密协议和位级字段；被忽略或仅被复制的字节可能遭到错误合并。完美分割率衡量两端边界均正确的字段。量化实验使用四种公开协议的 50 条与 1,000 条报文集合；另行开展的专有协议研究覆盖五个固件目标中的三种协议，在三台设备上进行交互检查，并由人工建立真实标签。这些检查不能证明完整设备行为。
why_fits_en: Adds firmware-assisted protocol format inference using concolic analysis, complementing live-server instrumentation and traffic-only field inference.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助固件与混合符号分析推断协议格式的方法，与实时服务端插桩和仅基于流量的字段推断互补。
metadata_notes: The publisher identifies article ISSTA105 and licenses the paper under CC BY 4.0; its Data Availability section links the repository. The reviewed 2025-04-16 code snapshot has no project-level license declaration. Python 3 dependencies use compatible-release bounds, including angr~=9.2.100, Netzob~=2.0.0 and scapy~=2.5.0; the paper describes Ghidra 11.0.3 for function analysis. The repository includes public-protocol configurations and a Modbus capture, but no firmware images; target binaries and libraries need separate provision. The paper specifies trace-similarity threshold 0.9, while released InferSyntax.py uses 99 on a 100-point scale. Its batch evaluator excludes abnormal traces from aggregate metrics. These source differences prevent treating this snapshot as a reproduced paper configuration. No firmware, captures or model payloads were downloaded, and no upstream code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 出版方将文章编号列为 ISSTA105，并以 CC BY 4.0 授权论文；其数据可用性章节链接了仓库。所审阅的 2025-04-16 代码快照未声明项目级许可证。Python 3 依赖使用兼容版本范围，包括 angr~=9.2.100、Netzob~=2.0.0 与 scapy~=2.5.0；论文说明使用 Ghidra 11.0.3 进行函数分析。仓库包含公开协议配置和一份 Modbus 捕获数据，但没有固件映像；目标二进制与库需要另行提供。论文指定轨迹相似度阈值为 0.9，发布的 InferSyntax.py 则在百分制上使用 99。批量评估器将异常轨迹排除在汇总指标之外。这些源码差异意味着不能将此快照视为已复现的论文配置。本次未下载固件、捕获数据或模型载荷，也未运行上游代码或实验。

title: Lifting Network Protocol Implementation to Precise Format Specification with Security Applications
title_zh: 从网络协议实现提取精确格式规范及其安全应用
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records published/print publication on 2023-11-15 and a separate online/publication-history date of 2023-11-21. This entry uses the published/print date, not the November 26–30 conference dates.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质出版日期记为 2023-11-15，另列在线／发表历史日期为 2023-11-21。本条目采用 published／纸质出版日期，而非 11 月 26–30 日的会议日期。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2023 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: NetLifter statically lifts source-available C protocol parsers into BNF-style message grammars and first-order constraints between packet fields. It analyzes annotated LLVM bitcode using abstract format graphs, localized path-sensitive analysis, unfolding and reordering. The resulting field boundaries, constraints and names can support packet generation and parser construction.
description_zh: NetLifter 将可获取源码的 C 协议解析器静态转换为 BNF 风格的报文文法及报文字段之间的一阶逻辑约束。它分析经过标注的 LLVM 位码，结合抽象格式图、局部路径敏感分析、展开与重排序。所得字段边界、约束与名称可用于报文生成及解析器构建。
scope_limitations_en: Requires source/LLVM IR and packet-buffer/length annotations; it is not closed-binary or traffic-only recovery. The paper targets common top-down C parsers and does not support C++, inline assembly or libraries without available code. Pointer/loop analysis remains approximate; checksum fields can be identified while some checksum constraints are omitted, and fields ignored by an implementation may be missed. Precision/recall was manually checked on ten selected protocols. The reported fuzzing evaluation used three-hour runs repeated twenty times and bypassed checksum checks. It infers formats, not protocol state machines or proof of implementation equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 需要源码／LLVM 中间表示及报文缓冲区、长度标注，并非对闭源二进制或仅凭流量进行恢复。论文面向常见的自顶向下 C 解析器，不支持 C++、内联汇编及缺少源码的库。指针和循环分析仍有近似；可识别校验和字段，但部分校验和约束会被省略，实现中忽略的字段也可能遗漏。精确率／召回率在选定的十种协议上进行人工核对。报告的模糊测试采用每次三小时、重复二十次的实验，并绕过校验和检查。方法推断的是格式，而非协议状态机或实现等价性的证明。
why_fits_en: Adds source-to-format inference with cross-field constraints, complementing traffic-based and binary-assisted protocol reconstruction research.
why_fits_zh: 补充包含跨字段约束的源码到格式推断方法，与基于流量及借助二进制的协议重建研究互补。
metadata_notes: The final author PDF and Crossref establish the five-author order, CCS 2023 DOI and pages. The 19-page arXiv v1 retains an old CCS 2022 submission template and placeholder DOI; publication identity follows the final 15-page paper. The repository calls its prototype Popeye and warns of rough edges. Its reviewed 2025-04-21 snapshot declares AGPL-3.0-or-later in source headers. CMake requires 3.10+, LLVM 12.x and Z3>=4.8.12; README recommends LLVM 12.0.1 and the author’s modified Z3 4.8.12-popeye branch. Vectorized IR is unsupported: README documents -fno-vectorize and -fno-slp-vectorize, and recommends debug information and removal of optimization flags for field naming. This later artifact snapshot is not an independently reproduced 2023 environment; dependencies and target code retain separate terms. Source files were inspected without running upstream code, downloading benchmark inputs or reproducing experiments.
metadata_notes_zh: 最终作者版 PDF 与 Crossref 确认五位作者顺序、CCS 2023 DOI 和页码。19 页的 arXiv v1 保留旧的 CCS 2022 投稿模板及占位 DOI；出版身份以最终 15 页论文为准。仓库将原型称为 Popeye，并提示仍有粗糙之处。所审阅的 2025-04-21 快照在源码头部声明 AGPL-3.0-or-later。CMake 要求 3.10+、LLVM 12.x 与 Z3>=4.8.12；README 推荐 LLVM 12.0.1 及作者修改的 Z3 4.8.12-popeye 分支。不支持向量化中间表示：README 说明使用 -fno-vectorize 和 -fno-slp-vectorize，并建议保留调试信息、移除优化选项，以帮助字段命名。这个较晚的产物快照不代表独立复现了 2023 年环境；依赖与目标代码保留各自条款。本次仅审阅源码，未运行上游代码、下载基准输入或复现实验。

title: UIOrchestra: Generating High-Fidelity Code from UI Designs with a Multi-agent System
title_zh: UIOrchestra：通过多智能体系统将 UI 设计转换为高保真代码
date_basis: The official ACL Anthology citation gives November 2025. Crossref records only the year; the November 4–9 conference dates printed in the PDF are not treated as a publication day.
date_basis_zh: ACL Anthology 官方引文给出 2025 年 11 月。Crossref 仅记录年份；PDF 中的 11 月 4–9 日会议日期不作为具体出版日。

citation.container_title: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025

description_en: UIOrchestra converts static mobile UI designs into React/CSS through layout-description, code-generation and rendered-image comparison agents. Its APPUI benchmark contains 1,101 human-refined code/rendering pairs based on screenshots from 165 apps across 12 categories. The reference code is reconstructed for evaluation, rather than recovered original application source.
description_zh: UIOrchestra 通过布局描述、代码生成及渲染图像比较三个智能体，将静态移动 UI 设计转换为 React/CSS。其 APPUI 基准包含 1,101 组经人工修订的代码与渲染图像，依据 12 类中的 165 款应用截图构建。参考代码为评测而重建，并非恢复出的原始应用源码。
scope_limitations_en: Tests visual, component and code similarity, not native-package execution, interaction, backend behavior or application equivalence. APPUI references are rendered reconstructions of iOS screenshots; unavailable images/icons use placeholders. A human study covers 200 samples with four annotators. The difference-analysis prompt ignores font-size/typeface differences and placeholder image content. Model snapshots, rendering dependencies and a reproducible runtime setup were not verified; experiments were not rerun.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测视觉、组件及代码相似度，不验证原生安装包执行、交互、后端行为或应用等价性。APPUI 参考图像来自对 iOS 截图所做重建的渲染结果；无法获取的图片／图标使用占位素材。人工研究由四位标注者评估 200 个样本。差异分析提示词忽略字号／字体差异及占位图像内容。未核实模型快照、渲染依赖或可复现的运行环境，亦未重新运行实验。
why_fits_en: Adds a mobile-oriented screenshot reconstruction method and benchmark with explicit human-built reference data; also evaluates on Design2Code-hard webpages.
why_fits_zh: 补充面向移动界面的截图重建方法与基准，明确参考数据由人工参与构建，并在 Design2Code-hard 网页上开展评测。
metadata_notes: Reviewed the final 14-page proceedings PDF. Its eleven-author order is retained, including Yanping Wang where ACL/Crossref metadata renders Wangyanping; Wang Yixuan is preserved as printed. No arXiv version was verified. The paper promises a code/data release, but the reviewed coauthor page has disabled code/project placeholders and no attributable release or artifact license was verified. Code/project URLs therefore remain unset. The paper is covered by ACL’s CC BY 4.0 policy; this does not establish licensing for an unreleased dataset or depicted apps.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅最终 14 页会议论文 PDF，保留其中十一位作者的顺序，包括 ACL／Crossref 元数据写作 Wangyanping 的 Yanping Wang；Wang Yixuan 按论文原样保留。未核实 arXiv 版本。论文承诺发布代码与数据，但所审阅的合作者主页中，代码／项目链接仍是禁用的占位链接；未核实可归属于作者的发布产物或其许可，因此代码／项目 URL 留空。论文适用 ACL 的 CC BY 4.0 政策，但这并不证明尚未发布的数据集或所展示应用的许可。

title: SLaDe: A Portable Small Language Model Decompiler for Optimized Assembly
title_zh: SLaDe：面向优化汇编的可移植小语言模型反编译器
date_basis: IEEE’s Crossref deposit gives published/print date 2024-03-02. Edinburgh’s publication record instead gives 2024-02-28, also the DOI-creation date. This entry uses the publisher-deposited print date and does not infer it solely from the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质出版日期记为 2024-03-02；爱丁堡大学出版记录则给出 2024-02-28，这也是 DOI 创建日期。本条目采用出版方提交的纸质出版日期，并非仅依据会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: 2024 IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Code Generation and Optimization (CGO)

description_en: SLaDe translates function-level assembly into C with a 200M-parameter encoder–decoder model, code-specific tokenization and PsycheC type completion. It studies x86 and ARM at -O0 and -O3, combining generated candidates with input/output checks. The input is assembly text, not raw machine bytes; disassembly is outside the method.
description_zh: SLaDe 使用 200M 参数的编码器—解码器模型、面向代码的分词及 PsycheC 类型补全，将函数级汇编转换为 C。研究覆盖 x86 与 ARM 的 -O0、-O3 设置，并结合生成候选与输入／输出检查。输入是汇编文本而非原始机器字节，反汇编不属于该方法。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers about 4,000 ExeBench functions and a 112-program synthesis suite. Beam size 5 selects the first candidate passing finite I/O tests; generated functions are inserted into the original calling context. Passing these tests is not whole-program or all-input equivalence. Edit similarity is a readability proxy. Longer functions, external calls and incorrect type/operator predictions remain failure modes; the model has 1,024-position source and target windows. Historical baseline comparisons have different coverage and do not establish current rankings.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测覆盖约 4,000 个 ExeBench 函数及含 112 个程序的合成基准。束宽为 5，并选择首个通过有限输入／输出测试的候选；生成函数被放回原始调用上下文。通过这些测试不代表完整程序或全部输入上的等价性。编辑相似度只是可读性的代理指标。较长函数、外部调用及错误的类型／运算符预测仍会导致失败；模型的输入和输出窗口均为 1,024 个位置。历史基线比较的覆盖范围不同，不能据此确立当前排名。
why_fits_en: Adds type-inference-assisted neural decompilation with explicit execution-based evaluation, complementing symbol recovery and later LLM decompilation studies.
why_fits_zh: 补充结合类型推断与执行结果评测的神经反编译方法，与符号恢复及后续大语言模型反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v3 dated 2024-02-15, the accepted CGO manuscript; publication metadata establishes the final venue and pages. Paper reference 65 links the Zenodo artifact. Its separate LICENSE restricts included code/data/models to paper reproducibility and calls it nonproduction research code; no permissive license is inferred. The 1.83 GB archive was not downloaded or inspected. Appendix prerequisites include Python 3.8, PyTorch 1.10.2, Transformers 4.22.2, PsycheC, Haskell Stack and an AArch64 GCC toolchain. BTC weights are not redistributed and ChatGPT outputs may change. These are documented historical requirements, not a verified installation; no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅 2024-02-15 发布的 arXiv v3，即 CGO 接收稿；出版元数据确认最终发表场所及页码。论文参考文献 65 链接至 Zenodo 产物，其独立 LICENSE 将所含代码／数据／模型限定用于论文复现，并说明这是不适合生产环境的研究代码，不能据此推定宽松许可。未下载或检查 1.83 GB 压缩包。附录列出的前提包括 Python 3.8、PyTorch 1.10.2、Transformers 4.22.2、PsycheC、Haskell Stack 及 AArch64 GCC 工具链。产物不再分发 BTC 权重，ChatGPT 输出也可能变化。这些是文档中的历史要求，并非已验证的安装环境；本次未运行代码或实验。

title: Coda: An End-to-End Neural Program Decompiler
title_zh: Coda：端到端神经程序反编译器
date_basis: The NeurIPS proceedings page and its metadata give publication year 2019 (Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32). No publication day is asserted; neither the December conference dates nor the June 2019 arXiv submission is substituted.
date_basis_zh: NeurIPS 论文集页面及其元数据给出出版年份 2019（Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 第 32 卷）。本条目不推定具体出版日，也不以 12 月的会议日期或 2019 年 6 月的 arXiv 提交日期代替。
description_en: Coda decompiles the assembly of short functions into C in two phases. An instruction-type-aware N-ary Tree-LSTM encoder and an attention-fed AST decoder first generate a code sketch; an ensemble of neural error predictors then proposes token corrections, each kept only if recompiling the candidate does not increase its edit distance to the input assembly. On synthetic benchmarks the authors report 82% average program accuracy after correction, against 12% for a sequence-to-sequence baseline with attention.
description_zh: Coda 分两个阶段将短函数的汇编反编译为 C。首先由区分指令类型的 N 叉 Tree-LSTM 编码器与带注意力输入的 AST 解码器生成代码草图；随后由多个神经错误预测器的集成提出词元修正，只有当候选代码重新编译后与输入汇编的编辑距离不增加时，才保留该修正。在合成基准上，作者报告修正后的平均程序准确率为 82%，而带注意力的序列到序列基线为 12%。
scope_limitations_en: Training and test programs are randomly generated from Karel commands, math.h calls and arithmetic or logical expressions, in short and long variants (average length 15 and 30), 50,000 pairs per task, compiled without optimization: clang -O0 for the main MIPS results and gcc -O0 for an x86-64 appendix that reports sketch token accuracy only, about 6% lower on average. Real-world checks are small PyTorch C++ API model-construction and Hacker's Delight loop-free programs. Program accuracy requires an exact token match with the ground-truth source, the metric under which the paper reports 0% for conventional decompilers. Error correction assumes the compiler configuration is known, and token accuracy drops for longer programs. The results show neither optimized, whole-program nor binary-equivalent decompilation, and the paper names no author implementation.
scope_limitations_zh: 训练与测试程序均为随机生成，涵盖 Karel 指令、math.h 调用及算术或逻辑表达式，分为短、长两种（平均长度 15 与 30），每项任务 50,000 对，并在不开启优化的条件下编译：主要 MIPS 结果使用 clang -O0，x86-64 附录使用 gcc -O0，且只报告草图词元准确率，平均约低 6%。真实场景检查仅包括小型 PyTorch C++ API 模型构建程序和 Hacker’s Delight 无循环程序。程序准确率要求与真实源码词元完全一致，论文正是在该指标下报告常规反编译器为 0%。错误修正假定已知编译器配置，程序变长时词元准确率下降。这些结果既不能说明优化代码、整程序或二进制等价的反编译能力，论文也未给出作者实现。
why_fits_en: Adds an early (2019) end-to-end neural decompiler that pairs learned code generation with compiler-checked iterative correction, predating the LLM-based decompilation papers in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充一种 2019 年的早期端到端神经反编译器，它将学习式代码生成与经编译器检验的迭代修正相结合，早于本节中基于大语言模型的反编译论文。
metadata_notes: The sole arXiv version, v1 of 2019-06-28, is titled 'A Neural-based Program Decompiler' and lists the same seven authors; this record uses the proceedings title. NeurIPS metadata gives Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 32, pages 3708–3719; the proceedings page lists no DOI. A footnote expands Coda as CodeAttack. The proceedings supplemental ZIP holds one appendix PDF with dataset statistics, hyper-parameters, the x86-64 table and RetDec examples. The paper cites third-party disassemblers (mipt-mips, REDasm) but no author code, data or model release. No code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 仅有 2019-06-28 提交的 v1，题为“A Neural-based Program Decompiler”，作者同为七人；本条目采用论文集标题。NeurIPS 元数据给出 Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 第 32 卷第 3708–3719 页，论文集页面未列出 DOI。论文脚注说明 Coda 是 CodeAttack 的缩写。论文集补充材料 ZIP 内含一份附录 PDF，提供数据集统计、超参数、x86-64 结果表及 RetDec 示例。论文引用了第三方反汇编器（mipt-mips、REDasm），但未发布作者代码、数据或模型。本次未运行代码或实验。

title: Debin: Predicting Debug Information in Stripped Binaries
title_zh: Debin：预测去符号二进制中的调试信息
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives print and online publication on 2018-10-15. That is also the first day of the October 15–19 conference; the date comes from the publisher record, not from the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2018-10-15。该日期恰为 10 月 15—19 日会议的首日；本条目依据出版方记录，而非根据会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2018 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: Debin predicts debug information for stripped ELF binaries on x86, x64 and ARM. After lifting code to BAP-IR, an Extremely randomized Trees classifier decides which registers and memory offsets hold source-level variables. A conditional random field, solved with Nice2Predict, then jointly predicts names and types for variables and functions, and the result is written back as DWARF sections. On 300 held-out binaries per architecture, the authors report 68.8% precision and 68.3% recall for x64 names and types.
description_zh: Debin 为 x86、x64 与 ARM 上去符号的 ELF 二进制预测调试信息。它先将代码提升为 BAP-IR，用极端随机树分类器判断哪些寄存器和内存偏移对应源码级变量；再借助 Nice2Predict 求解条件随机场，联合预测变量与函数的名称和类型，并将结果以 DWARF 节写回二进制。作者在每种架构 300 个留出二进制上报告，x64 名称与类型预测的精确率为 68.8%、召回率为 68.3%。
scope_limitations_en: The dataset has 3,000 non-stripped executables and shared libraries per architecture from 830 Linux debug-symbol packages of C code built with default package settings, split 2,700/300 for training and testing. Accuracy evaluation assumes given function boundaries; for fully stripped inputs, BAP's ByteWeight infers them, which the paper cites as about 93% accurate. Debin predicts 17 types, and leaves struct and union contents, line numbers and formats such as PE outside the evaluation. A prediction counts only when it equals the original debug value. Models learned from compiler-generated, benign code may be less accurate on obfuscated binaries, hand-written assembly or malware. The 35-sample malware study is manual inspection of decompiled output with no accuracy figures, because the samples lack ground-truth debug information.
scope_limitations_zh: 数据集为每种架构 3,000 个未去符号的可执行文件与共享库，来自 830 个 Linux 调试符号软件包，源码为 C 语言并按各包默认设置编译，按 2,700／300 划分训练与测试。准确率评估假定函数边界已知；对于完全去符号的输入，由 BAP 的 ByteWeight 推断函数边界，论文引用其准确率约为 93%。Debin 预测 17 种类型，struct 与 union 的内部内容、行号以及 PE 等其他格式不在评测范围内。只有与原始调试信息完全相同的预测才计为正确。基于编译器生成的良性代码学习的模型，在混淆二进制、手写汇编或恶意软件上可能准确率较低。针对 35 个恶意样本的研究是对反编译输出的人工检查，由于样本缺少调试信息真实标签，未报告准确率。
why_fits_en: Adds learned name and type prediction that works directly on stripped binaries and emits standard debug sections, complementing identifier-naming and symbol-recovery research that operates on decompiler output.
why_fits_zh: 补充直接作用于去符号二进制、并输出标准调试节的学习式名称与类型预测方法，与基于反编译输出的标识符命名及符号恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref's title field holds only “Debin”; the full title follows the ETH-hosted author PDF, which carries the ACM reference format, DOI and CCS ’18 rights notice. Crossref and the PDF agree on the five-author order and pages 1667–1680. The paper names https://debin.ai as the public tool; that host did not respond on 2026-10-18, so no project page is recorded. The reviewed 2022-05-20 snapshot of eth-sri/debin is Apache-2.0, links the paper and depends on Nice2Predict and BAP. Its README says the setup scripts were tested only on Ubuntu 16.04 with gcc 5.4.0; the Dockerfile pins Ubuntu 16.04, Bazel 0.19.2, OCaml 4.05.0 and BAP 1.4.0, and requirements.txt pins numpy 1.19 and scikit-learn 0.19.2. Pretrained models are a separate archive of about 923 MB from files.sri.inf.ethz.ch. These are historical requirements, not evidence that the code builds on current systems. The model archive was not downloaded, and no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 的标题字段仅为“Debin”；完整标题依据 ETH 托管的作者版 PDF，该文件载有 ACM 引用格式、DOI 及 CCS ’18 版权声明。Crossref 与 PDF 的五位作者顺序及 1667–1680 页码一致。论文将 https://debin.ai 列为公开工具地址；该主机在 2026-10-18 无响应，因此未记录项目页面。所审阅的 eth-sri/debin 2022-05-20 快照采用 Apache-2.0 许可，链接了论文，并依赖 Nice2Predict 与 BAP。其 README 说明安装脚本仅在 Ubuntu 16.04 与 gcc 5.4.0 上测试；Dockerfile 固定 Ubuntu 16.04、Bazel 0.19.2、OCaml 4.05.0 与 BAP 1.4.0，requirements.txt 固定 numpy 1.19 与 scikit-learn 0.19.2。预训练模型是来自 files.sri.inf.ethz.ch、约 923 MB 的独立压缩包。这些是历史要求，不能证明代码可在当前系统上构建。本次未下载模型压缩包，也未运行代码或实验。

title: Towards LLM-Resistant Software Protection: Agent Failure Patterns in CTF Reverse Engineering
title_zh: 迈向抗 LLM 的软件保护：CTF 逆向工程中的智能体失败模式
date_basis: The Internet Society’s Crossref deposit gives publication year 2026. The PDF footer names the 27 February 2026 workshop; no finer publication date is asserted from the event date.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据给出出版年份 2026。PDF 页脚标注研讨会于 2026 年 2 月 27 日举行；不据此推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: Runs Claude Code, Codex CLI and ChatGPT-5.2 Pro on 24 crackme-style challenges selected from 15 international CTF events held in 2025, and attributes their failures to stages of an Observe–Comprehend–Plan loop and to three protection effects: concealment, complication and misdirection. From the failure logs, the authors derive four recurring weaknesses (training bias, over-trust in observations, context limitation and plan persistence). They rerun both CLI agents without a decompiler and compare outcomes with in-competition solve rates.
description_zh: 让 Claude Code、Codex CLI 与 ChatGPT-5.2 Pro 求解从 2025 年 15 场国际 CTF 赛事中选出的 24 道 crackme 类题目，并将失败归因到“观察—理解—计划”循环的各阶段，以及隐藏、复杂化与误导三类保护效果。作者从失败日志中归纳出四类反复出现的弱点：训练偏差、过度信任观察结果、上下文限制和计划固守。他们还在移除反编译器后重新运行两个命令行智能体，并将结果与赛时解题率对比。
scope_limitations_en: The study covers 24 locally solvable Linux x86-64 ELF crackmes and three commercial agents (Claude Opus 4.5 and GPT-5.1-Codex-Max in the CLI tools, and an undisclosed ChatGPT model), evaluated in December 2025 with network access; runs that consulted public write-ups were excluded. The binaries are small relative to real-world software, and malware analysis and vulnerability discovery are out of scope. Each configuration had at most three attempts with early stopping, which the authors call noisy; success means printing the correct flag or finding an accepted input. Weakness labels come from qualitative log analysis by two evaluators and describe these runs, not general properties of LLM agents. ChatGPT-5.2 Pro ran in an uncontrolled web sandbox and is excluded from the decompiler comparison. Solve rates are among teams that solved at least one challenge, unavailable for six tasks, and may include LLM-assisted teams. Training-data exposure remains a validity threat, and the paper does not publish its assembled challenge set, run logs or code.
scope_limitations_zh: 研究覆盖 24 道可在本地求解的 Linux x86-64 ELF crackme 题目和三个商用智能体（命令行工具使用 Claude Opus 4.5 与 GPT-5.1-Codex-Max，ChatGPT 所用模型未公开），于 2025 年 12 月在允许联网的条件下评测；查阅公开题解的运行已被排除。这些二进制相比真实软件规模较小，恶意软件分析与漏洞发现不在范围内。每种配置最多尝试三次，成功即停止，作者承认这种估计噪声较大；成功指输出正确 flag 或找到被程序接受的输入。弱点标签来自两名评估者对日志的定性分析，描述的是这些运行，并非 LLM 智能体的普遍属性。ChatGPT-5.2 Pro 在无法控制的网页沙箱中运行，未纳入反编译器对比。解题率按至少解出一题的队伍计算，其中六题没有数据，参赛队伍也可能借助 LLM。训练数据泄露仍是有效性威胁；论文未公开其整理的题目集、运行日志或代码。
why_fits_en: Links reverse-engineering agent failures to specific protection effects and analysis stages, complementing benchmarks that mainly report success rates.
why_fits_zh: 将逆向工程智能体的失败与具体保护效果和分析阶段联系起来，补充主要报告成功率的基准。
metadata_notes: BAR 2026 is a workshop co-located with NDSS Symposium 2026, not the NDSS main track. The five-author order follows the PDF, the NDSS paper and program pages, and the Internet Society’s Crossref deposit. The DOI resolves directly to the PDF, whose footer gives ISBN 978-1-970672-08-4; Crossref lists no pages, and no page range was verified. No arXiv version was found. Table I gives per-task times and weakness labels for each configuration; the per-agent counts (15, 17, 14, 14 and 19 of 24) and the decompiler comparison are author-reported. The paper names no code or data release. Experiments were not rerun for this collection.
metadata_notes_zh: BAR 2026 是与 NDSS Symposium 2026 同期举办的研讨会，并非 NDSS 主会。五位作者的顺序以 PDF、NDSS 论文页与日程页及 Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据为准。该 DOI 直接解析到 PDF，PDF 页脚标注 ISBN 978-1-970672-08-4；Crossref 未列出页码，本条目未核实页码范围。未找到 arXiv 版本。表 I 给出各配置在每道题上的用时与弱点标签；各智能体解出的题数（24 题中分别为 15、17、14、14 和 19 题）及反编译器对比结果均由作者报告。论文未提及代码或数据发布。本合集未重新运行实验。

title: TypeForge: Synthesizing and Selecting Best-Fit Composite Data Types for Stripped Binaries
title_zh: TypeForge：为去符号二进制合成并选择最适配的复合数据类型
date_basis: IEEE Xplore and the publisher’s Crossref deposit establish publication year 2025. Both list 12 May 2025, the first day of the May 12–15 symposium, and IEEE added the article to Xplore on 16 June 2025; neither date is treated as a verified publication day.
date_basis_zh: IEEE Xplore 与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据确认出版年份为 2025。两者均列出 2025 年 5 月 12 日，即 5 月 12—15 日研讨会的首日；IEEE 于 2025 年 6 月 16 日将文章加入 Xplore。本条目不将这两个日期视为已核实的出版日。

citation.container_title: 2025 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (SP)

description_en: TypeForge recovers composite data types, including struct layouts, unions and pointer or nesting relationships, from stripped binaries. A whole-program Type Flow Graph over Ghidra’s decompiler-inferred variables propagates member offsets and sizes, cuts conflicting edges caused by casts and unions, and synthesizes candidate type declarations. An LLM only selects among these statically synthesized candidates: each is applied through the decompiler’s retype interface, and a double-elimination tournament compares the resulting pseudocode for readability. On OSPREY’s coreutils dataset the authors report F1 of 81.7% for composite-type identification, 88.2% for layout recovery and 72.1% for relationship recovery.
description_zh: TypeForge 从去符号二进制中恢复复合数据类型，包括结构体布局、联合体以及指针引用和嵌套关系。它在 Ghidra 反编译器推断出的变量之上构建全程序类型流图，传播成员偏移与大小，切断由类型转换和联合体引起的冲突边，并合成候选类型声明。大语言模型只在这些静态合成的候选中进行选择：每个候选通过反编译器的重定类型接口应用，再以双败淘汰赛比较所得伪代码的可读性。作者在 OSPREY 的 coreutils 数据集上报告复合类型识别 F1 为 81.7%、布局恢复 F1 为 88.2%、关系恢复 F1 为 72.1%。
scope_limitations_en: Recovers member offsets, sizes and relationships, not original type or member names; relationship correctness is judged by matching layouts because names are unavailable. The main evaluation uses OSPREY’s dataset of GNU coreutils and larger Howard-dataset programs, over 10,000 functions and 11,000 composite-typed variables at O0–O3, with ground truth from debug information; the paper does not report results per architecture. In the baseline comparison, OSPREY results were supplied by its authors and its runtime is an estimate, and ReSym figures are its published results, so not every baseline was rerun. Conservative removal of conflicting edges can drop valid members, and compiler optimizations that merge or flatten members lower accuracy at higher levels. About 75% of runtime is the LLM selection stage; the default model was GPT-4o mini, with each comparison run three times. Downstream readability and vulnerability examples are case studies, not proof of semantic equivalence.
scope_limitations_zh: 恢复的是成员偏移、大小和类型间关系，而非原始类型名或成员名；由于名称不可得，关系是否正确以布局匹配判定。主要评测使用 OSPREY 的数据集，包括 GNU coreutils 与 Howard 数据集中较大的程序，涵盖超过 10,000 个函数和 11,000 个复合类型变量，优化级别为 O0–O3，真实标签取自调试信息；论文未按架构分别报告结果。基线比较中，OSPREY 的结果由其作者提供，运行时间为估算值，ReSym 的数据取自其已发表结果，因此并非所有基线均经重新运行。保守地删除冲突边可能遗漏有效成员；合并或展平成员的编译器优化会降低较高优化级别下的准确率。约 75% 的运行时间用于大语言模型选择阶段；默认模型为 GPT-4o mini，每轮比较执行三次。下游可读性与漏洞检测示例属于案例研究，不能证明语义等价。
why_fits_en: Adds static composite-type and struct-layout recovery that feeds decompiler readability, complementing learned variable naming, data-structure symbol recovery and LLM refinement of decompiler output.
why_fits_zh: 补充以静态分析恢复复合类型与结构体布局、进而提升反编译结果可读性的方法，与基于学习的变量命名、数据结构符号恢复及大语言模型改写反编译输出的研究互补。
metadata_notes: IEEE Xplore and Crossref agree on the title, six-author order and DOI; an arXiv title search found no preprint. Both list article-relative pages 1–18, whereas the repository’s BibTeX gives 2847–2864; neither range is recorded in the citation. The author-hosted PDF is the final paper, including the S&P meta-review appendix. The reviewed 2026-03-17 snapshot, identical to its dev branch at review time, is a Ghidra extension tested with Ghidra 11.0.3; its Python 3.13 selection scripts pin LangChain 0.3.23 and openai 1.75.0, and their README example names gpt-4.1-mini rather than the paper’s GPT-4o mini. Ground-truth extraction needs DWARF 4 debug information. LICENSE contains BSD 3-Clause-style terms with an added requirement to cite the paper in academic work; the README badge says BSD 3-Clause and GitHub reports NOASSERTION, so no single license is asserted here. Evaluation.md links early-version data captured before LLM selection, notes a June 2025 identification bug fix after submission, and withholds the variable-alignment evaluation script, so the paper’s metrics cannot be recomputed from the release alone. No code, model calls or downloads were run.
metadata_notes_zh: IEEE Xplore 与 Crossref 的标题、六位作者顺序和 DOI 一致；按标题检索 arXiv 未发现预印本。两者均列出按文章计的页码 1–18，而仓库提供的 BibTeX 为 2847–2864；引用信息不记录这两种页码范围。作者托管的 PDF 是最终论文，包含 S&P 元评审附录。所审阅的 2026-03-17 快照在审阅时与 dev 分支相同，是在 Ghidra 11.0.3 上测试的 Ghidra 扩展；其 Python 3.13 选择脚本固定 LangChain 0.3.23 与 openai 1.75.0，README 示例使用 gpt-4.1-mini，而非论文中的 GPT-4o mini。提取真实标签需要 DWARF 4 调试信息。LICENSE 文件采用 BSD 3-Clause 风格条款，另加在学术工作中须引用论文的要求；README 徽章标为 BSD 3-Clause，GitHub 则报告 NOASSERTION，因此本条目不认定单一许可证。Evaluation.md 链接的是 LLM 选择阶段之前、由早期版本生成的数据，说明投稿后于 2025 年 6 月修复了影响类型识别的缺陷，并且未公开变量对齐评估脚本，因此仅凭发布内容无法重新计算论文指标。本次未运行代码、调用模型或下载数据。

title: Towards Automated Dynamic Analysis for Linux-based Embedded Firmware
title_zh: 面向基于 Linux 的嵌入式固件的自动化动态分析
date_basis: Internet Society-deposited Crossref metadata supplies only publication year 2016; the publisher PDF separately identifies the 21–24 February 2016 symposium, which is not used to assert a publication month or day.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据仅给出出版年份 2016；出版方 PDF 另列研讨会日期为 2016 年 2 月 21—24 日，本条目不据此推定出版月份或日期。
description_en: Firmadyne crawls, extracts and emulates Linux-based firmware for network-connected commercial devices such as routers and IP cameras. It replaces the vendor kernel with pre-built, instrumented kernels for little-endian ARM and little- and big-endian MIPS, boots the extracted filesystem under QEMU full-system emulation with a userspace NVRAM library, infers the network configuration, then runs automated analyses including 60 known and 14 newly found exploits. From 23,035 images across 42 vendors, the authors extracted 9,486 and report 887 of the 1,971 network-reachable images vulnerable to at least one sampled exploit.
description_zh: Firmadyne 对路由器、IP 摄像头等联网商用设备中基于 Linux 的固件进行爬取、提取与仿真。它以预先构建并插桩的小端 ARM 及小端、大端 MIPS 内核替换厂商内核，在 QEMU 全系统仿真中配合用户态 NVRAM 库启动提取出的文件系统，推断网络配置，再运行自动化分析，包括 60 个已知漏洞利用和 14 个新发现的漏洞利用。作者从 42 家厂商的 23,035 个固件映像中提取出 9,486 个，并报告在 1,971 个网络可达映像中有 887 个至少受一个所选漏洞利用影响。
scope_limitations_en: The work targets Linux-based firmware on little-endian ARM and little- and big-endian MIPS, which made up 90.8% of the dataset; x86, VxWorks and other real-time operating systems are outside the system. Its pre-built kernels do not load vendor out-of-tree kernel modules, so vendor kernels and modules cannot be checked, and instrumented emulation is not identical device behavior. The emulation funnel narrows sharply: of 8,591 images that initially emulated, 2,797 had a network configuration inferred and 1,971 answered ping. NVRAM semantics, interface naming and a single emulated Ethernet device on ARM are among the reported causes. WAN and LAN ports are not distinguished, so remote exploitability is not established, and results count firmware images rather than unique products and are skewed by vendor composition. FirmAE, already in this bibliography, extends Firmadyne to address such emulation failures; these 2016 rates are not current emulation figures.
scope_limitations_zh: 该工作面向小端 ARM 及小端、大端 MIPS 上基于 Linux 的固件，这些平台占数据集的 90.8%；x86、VxWorks 及其他实时操作系统不在系统支持范围内。其预构建内核不加载厂商的树外内核模块，因此无法检查厂商内核及模块，插桩仿真也不等同于设备原有行为。仿真流程逐级大幅收窄：在初始仿真成功的 8,591 个映像中，2,797 个推断出网络配置，1,971 个能响应 ping。论文列出的原因包括 NVRAM 语义、网络接口命名，以及 ARM 平台仅仿真一个以太网设备等。系统不区分 WAN 与 LAN 端口，因此不能确认可否远程利用；结果按固件映像而非独立产品计数，并受厂商构成偏差影响。本收录中已有的 FirmAE 扩展了 Firmadyne 以解决此类仿真失败；这些 2016 年的比率并非当前的仿真数据。
why_fits_en: Adds the full-system firmware-emulation framework, with kernel replacement and userspace NVRAM, that later rehosting research such as FirmAE builds on.
why_fits_zh: 补充采用内核替换与用户态 NVRAM 的全系统固件仿真框架，FirmAE 等后续重托管研究在其基础上展开。
metadata_notes: Crossref gives only the year and no pages; the PDF footer identifies NDSS ’16, 21–24 February 2016, San Diego, with ISBN 1-891562-41-X and the DOI. The DOI resolves directly to the NDSS PDF, so the DOI URL serves as the paper page. Figures differ between sources: the paper's per-vendor appendix table totals 8,893 extracted images where its abstract and body give 9,486, and the repository README reports 846 of 1,971 (43%) vulnerable images where the paper reports 887 (45%). This record follows the paper body. The reviewed 2024-07-21 snapshot of firmadyne/firmadyne is MIT-licensed, calls itself a research tool that is not production ready, and says the paper's results used pre-release toolchains, kernels and components that it lists by version or commit. Its current Dockerfile uses Ubuntu 22.04 and runs in privileged mode, and download.sh fetches pre-built kernels, console and libnvram binaries from GitHub releases. Vendor firmware images and Metasploit exploits carry their own terms. No firmware, binaries or exploits were downloaded, and nothing was run.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 仅给出年份而无页码；PDF 页脚标明 NDSS ’16 于 2016 年 2 月 21—24 日在圣迭戈举行，并载有 ISBN 1-891562-41-X 与 DOI。该 DOI 直接解析至 NDSS PDF，因此以 DOI 链接作为论文页面。各来源的数字存在差异：论文附录按厂商列出的表格合计 8,893 个已提取映像，而摘要与正文为 9,486 个；仓库 README 报告 1,971 个映像中有 846 个（43%）存在漏洞，论文则为 887 个（45%）。本条目以论文正文为准。所审阅的 firmadyne/firmadyne 2024-07-21 快照采用 MIT 许可，自称是尚不适合生产环境的研究工具，并说明论文结果使用了预发布版本的工具链、内核及组件，按版本或提交逐项列出。当前 Dockerfile 使用 Ubuntu 22.04 并以特权模式运行，download.sh 从 GitHub 发布页下载预构建的内核、console 与 libnvram 二进制。厂商固件映像与 Metasploit 漏洞利用适用各自条款。本次未下载固件、二进制或漏洞利用，也未运行任何内容。

title: Self-Constructed Context Decompilation with Fined-grained Alignment Enhancement
title_zh: 自构造上下文反编译与细粒度对齐增强
date_basis: The official ACL Anthology citation gives November 2024. Crossref records only the year; the November 12–16 conference dates printed in the PDF are not treated as a publication day.
date_basis_zh: ACL Anthology 官方引文给出 2024 年 11 月。Crossref 仅记录年份；PDF 中印有的 11 月 12–16 日会议日期不作为具体出版日。
description_en: Adds two techniques to LLM decompilation of function-level x86-64 GCC assembly into C. Self-Constructed Context Decompilation (sc²dec) recompiles a model’s first compilable output and uses the resulting assembly–source pair as an in-context example for a second attempt, without fine-tuning. Fine-grained Alignment Enhancement (FAE) fine-tunes llm4decompile-6.7b with LoRA on statement-level assembly–C alignments derived from DWARF debug information. Combining both, the authors report 52.41% average re-executability on Decompile-Eval, against 48.60% for the base model.
description_zh: 为大语言模型将函数级 x86-64 GCC 汇编反编译为 C 的流程增加两项技术。自构造上下文反编译（sc²dec）无需微调：把模型首次生成且可编译的结果重新编译，以得到的汇编—源码对作为上下文示例再次反编译。细粒度对齐增强（FAE）利用 DWARF 调试信息构造语句级汇编—C 对齐数据，以 LoRA 微调 llm4decompile-6.7b。两者结合后，作者报告在 Decompile-Eval 上的平均可重执行率为 52.41%，基础模型为 48.60%。
scope_limitations_en: Results are function-level re-executability on Decompile-Eval: 164 HumanEval-derived C problems compiled at O0–O3 and checked by recompilation and HumanEval test cases. Passing these tests is not whole-program or all-input equivalence, and the paper does not evaluate real-world binaries, other architectures or readability. sc²dec helps only when the first output recompiles, so low re-compilability limits its gains; the authors report 1–2% lower results when context is built at a mismatched optimization level, and clang-built contexts scored slightly below GCC. FAE used 10,000 ExeBench functions limited to the standard C library, one training epoch and a single 6.7B base model; the authors did not validate it on larger datasets or models, and it slightly lowered the 1-shot result. GPT-4 and DeepSeek baselines are API snapshots that may not be reproducible.
scope_limitations_zh: 结果为 Decompile-Eval 上的函数级可重执行率：164 道源自 HumanEval 的 C 题目，分别以 O0–O3 编译，并通过重新编译和 HumanEval 测试用例检查。通过这些测试不代表完整程序或全部输入上的等价性；论文也未评估真实二进制、其他架构或可读性。只有首次输出能够重新编译时 sc²dec 才有帮助，因此可重编译率低会限制其收益；作者报告以不匹配的优化级别构造上下文会使结果降低 1–2%，用 clang 构造的上下文得分也略低于 GCC。FAE 仅使用 10,000 个只依赖 C 标准库的 ExeBench 函数，训练一个轮次，且只基于一个 6.7B 基础模型；作者未在更大数据集或模型上验证，它还使 1-shot 结果略有下降。GPT-4 与 DeepSeek 基线是 API 快照，未必可复现。
why_fits_en: Adds recompilation feedback and debug-information alignment to end-to-end LLM decompilation, complementing LLM4Decompile and execution-checked decompilation benchmarks.
why_fits_zh: 为端到端大语言模型反编译补充重新编译反馈与调试信息对齐方法，与 LLM4Decompile 及基于执行检查的反编译基准互补。
metadata_notes: The title keeps the published spelling ‘Fined-grained’. The eight-author order follows the Anthology, PDF, Crossref and arXiv. arXiv v2 (2024-10-03) is labeled EMNLP 2024 Findings; v1 was submitted on 2024-06-25. The Anthology and Crossref give pages 6603–6614. The abstract’s ‘approximately 3.90%’ gain differs from the 3.81-point gap between Table 1’s 48.60% base result and 52.41%; this entry cites the table values. At the reviewed 2025-02-18 commit, the repository declares MIT, although LICENSE.txt keeps template placeholders for year and holders. It provides an evaluation script and GCC Decompile-Eval data, and links a LoRA adapter for LLM4Binary/llm4decompile-6.7b-v1.5 and a training dataset on Hugging Face, both tagged MIT; the base model and ExeBench keep their own terms. Its README results table adds readability scores and the authors’ later ReF Decompile, and its FAE-only averages differ slightly from the paper (51.07% versus 50.88%). The evaluator uses local gcc and objdump and, with --compiler, sends code to the public Compiler Explorer API. No weights or datasets were downloaded, and no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 标题保留出版时的拼写“Fined-grained”。八位作者的顺序以 Anthology、PDF、Crossref 与 arXiv 为准。arXiv v2（2024-10-03）标注为 EMNLP 2024 Findings；v1 于 2024-06-25 提交。Anthology 与 Crossref 给出页码 6603–6614。摘要所称约 3.90% 的提升与表 1 中基础结果 48.60% 和 52.41% 之间 3.81 个百分点的差值不一致；本条目引用表中数值。在所审阅的 2025-02-18 提交中，仓库声明采用 MIT，但 LICENSE.txt 仍保留年份与版权人的模板占位符。仓库提供评估脚本和 GCC 版 Decompile-Eval 数据，并链接 Hugging Face 上基于 LLM4Binary/llm4decompile-6.7b-v1.5 的 LoRA 适配器与训练数据集，两者均标为 MIT；基础模型与 ExeBench 保留各自条款。README 的结果表另加入可读性分数和作者后续的 ReF Decompile，其中仅用 FAE 的平均值与论文略有不同（51.07% 对 50.88%）。评估器使用本地 gcc 与 objdump；指定 --compiler 时会把代码发送到公共 Compiler Explorer API。本次未下载权重或数据集，也未运行代码或实验。

title: jTrans: Jump-Aware Transformer for Binary Code Similarity Detection
title_zh: jTrans：面向二进制代码相似性检测的跳转感知 Transformer
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit records published/print and online publication on 2022-07-18. The date comes from that publisher deposit, not from the July 18–22 conference dates.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将 published／纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2022-07-18；该日期取自出版方元数据，而非 7 月 18–22 日的会议日期。
description_en: jTrans embeds binary functions for similarity search with a BERT-style Transformer. Its jump-aware representation shares parameters between a direct jump’s operand token and the positional embedding of the jump target, so control flow enters the instruction sequence without a separate graph network. The model is pre-trained with masked language modeling and jump-target prediction, then fine-tuned with a cosine triplet objective on functions compiled from the same source at different optimization levels. The paper also introduces BinaryCorp, built by compiling C/C++ packages from Arch Linux’s official repositories and the AUR with gcc and g++.
description_zh: jTrans 使用 BERT 风格的 Transformer 为二进制函数生成嵌入，以支持相似性检索。其跳转感知表示让直接跳转的操作数词元与跳转目标的位置嵌入共享参数，从而无需单独的图神经网络即可将控制流引入指令序列。模型先以掩码语言建模和跳转目标预测进行预训练，再以余弦三元组目标在同一源码不同优化级别编译出的函数上微调。论文还发布了 BinaryCorp，它由 gcc 与 g++ 编译 Arch Linux 官方仓库及 AUR 中的 C/C++ 软件包构建而成。
scope_limitations_en: The model is trained on a single architecture (x86, per the paper’s discussion); cross-architecture search is not evaluated. Only direct jumps are encoded, and indirect-jump targets are left out of scope. Disassembly and function extraction rely on IDA Pro 7.5, so boundary errors upstream are not measured. BinaryCorp pairs gcc/g++ builds across O0–O3 and Os, with train and test split by project; it does not cover obfuscation or other compilers, and only the vulnerability study adds clang variants. Author-reported Recall@1 at pool size 10,000 on BinaryCorp-26M averages 62.5% against 32.0% for the best baseline, and accuracy still falls as pools grow, which the authors note for larger real-world pools. The vulnerability search uses eight CVEs with ten variants each. Baselines date from 2022, and Asm2Vec and OrderMatters were reimplemented, so the comparison does not establish current rankings. Similarity ranking identifies candidate matches; it does not recover source code, names or types.
scope_limitations_zh: 模型仅在单一架构上训练（据论文讨论部分为 x86），未评估跨架构检索。方法只编码直接跳转，间接跳转目标不在研究范围内。反汇编与函数提取依赖 IDA Pro 7.5，上游的边界识别错误未被衡量。BinaryCorp 在 O0–O3 与 Os 之间配对 gcc／g++ 构建结果，并按项目划分训练集与测试集；它不涵盖混淆或其他编译器，只有漏洞检索实验额外加入 clang 变体。作者报告在 BinaryCorp-26M、候选池规模为 10,000 时，平均 Recall@1 为 62.5%，最佳基线为 32.0%；随着候选池增大，准确率仍会下降，作者也指出真实场景的候选池更大。漏洞检索实验使用八个 CVE，每个有十个变体。基线来自 2022 年，其中 Asm2Vec 与 OrderMatters 为重新实现，因此该比较不能确立当前排名。相似性排序只给出候选匹配，并不恢复源码、名称或类型。
why_fits_en: Adds learned binary code similarity search, a reverse-engineering aid for function matching, library identification and known-vulnerability search, complementing decompilation and symbol-recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于学习的二进制代码相似性检索。它可辅助逆向工程中的函数匹配、库识别与已知漏洞检索，与反编译和符号恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: The arXiv abstract page titles the paper “jTrans: Jump-Aware Transformer for Binary Code Similarity”; its v1 PDF, the only version, carries the full ISSTA title, ACM reference format and DOI, and its comment cites ISSTA 2022. Crossref and the PDF agree on the eight-author order, the DOI, pages 1–13 and a CC BY 4.0 license. The README at the reviewed 2025-04-10 commit declares MIT and lists Linux, Python 3.8+, PyTorch 1.10+, CUDA 10.2+ and IDA Pro 7.5+ for dataset processing. Trained models, experiment files, the processed BinaryCorp and its original binaries are hosted on the authors’ lab file server outside GitHub, so their availability is separate from the repository. The released data-loading code truncates each function to 512 token positions. Packaged software in BinaryCorp retains its own licenses. Nothing was downloaded beyond the paper and repository files, and no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv 摘要页将论文标题写作“jTrans: Jump-Aware Transformer for Binary Code Similarity”；其唯一版本 v1 的 PDF 使用完整的 ISSTA 标题、ACM 引用格式及 DOI，备注也注明 ISSTA 2022。Crossref 与 PDF 一致给出八位作者顺序、DOI、第 1–13 页及 CC BY 4.0 许可。所审阅的 2025-04-10 提交中，README 声明 MIT 许可，并列出 Linux、Python 3.8+、PyTorch 1.10+、CUDA 10.2+，以及用于数据集处理的 IDA Pro 7.5+。训练好的模型、实验文件、处理后的 BinaryCorp 及其原始二进制托管在作者实验室的 GitHub 之外的文件服务器上，其可用性与代码仓库无关。发布的数据加载代码将每个函数截断为 512 个词元位置。BinaryCorp 中的软件包各自保留原有许可。本次除论文与仓库文件外未下载其他内容，也未运行代码或实验。

title: DecLLM: LLM-Augmented Recompilable Decompilation for Enabling Programmatic Use of Decompiled Code
title_zh: DecLLM：借助大语言模型实现可重新编译的反编译，支持以程序化方式使用反编译代码
date_basis: The ACM article page and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata agree on publication on 2025-06-22. The ISSTA presentation date is not substituted for this journal publication date.
date_basis_zh: ACM 文章页面与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据均将出版日期列为 2025-06-22；本条目不以 ISSTA 报告日期替代该期刊出版日期。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering (ISSTA 2025)

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering

description_en: DecLLM repairs decompiler pseudocode that does not recompile into C that compiles and runs, so source-level tools such as CodeQL can be applied to binaries. An iterative loop feeds compiler errors to an off-the-shelf LLM, reverting illegal outputs and large deletions, then uses mismatched test outputs and AddressSanitizer reports from the rebuilt program to repair behavior, and finally fuzzes the original and rebuilt executables for divergences. With GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 the authors report 74% and 78.3% success on 300 Code Contest programs; on Coreutils and CGC binaries, 61.9–70.9% recompile and 48.1–59.0% are fully functional.
description_zh: DecLLM 将无法重新编译的反编译伪代码修复为可编译、可运行的 C 代码，使 CodeQL 等源码级工具能够用于二进制分析。其迭代流程把编译器错误反馈给现成的大语言模型，并回退非法输出和大段删除；随后利用重建程序与预期不符的测试输出及 AddressSanitizer 报告修复行为，最后对原始与重建的可执行文件进行模糊测试以发现行为差异。作者报告，使用 GPT-3.5 与 GPT-4 时，在 300 个 Code Contest 程序上的成功率分别为 74% 和 78.3%；在 Coreutils 与 CGC 二进制上，61.9%–70.9% 可重新编译，完全功能正常的占 48.1%–59.0%。
scope_limitations_en: On Code Contest, success means the repaired code compiles and the rebuilt executable passes the supplied test cases, with AFL++ fuzzing as an extra check; the Coreutils and CGC overall rates also count rebuilt binaries that malfunction or crash. This establishes compilability and test-based agreement, not semantic equivalence, which the authors note is undecidable. Results depend on IDA Pro 8.3 output, with one Ghidra 10.4 repetition, and on the API-served gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 and gpt-4-0314 snapshots with a 4,096-token limit, so programs were chosen to fit within half of it. The 300 Code Contest programs average 112.9 lines; Coreutils 9.5 and CGC binaries were compiled without stripping symbols and repaired function by function, which cannot infer undefined globals. Around 30% of hard cases still fail, mainly from decompiler address/data confusion, ill-inferred buffer sizes, long outputs that include STL code and LLM type-cast shortcuts; deviations not exercised by tests remain undetected. CodeQL analysis of Juliet samples needed manual query adaptation.
scope_limitations_zh: 在 Code Contest 上，成功的含义是修复后的代码能够编译，且重建的可执行文件通过所提供的测试用例，并以 AFL++ 模糊测试作额外检查；Coreutils 与 CGC 的总体比率还计入功能异常或崩溃的重建二进制。这确立的是可编译性和基于测试的一致性，而非语义等价性，作者亦指出后者不可判定。结果依赖 IDA Pro 8.3 的输出（另以 Ghidra 10.4 重复一次实验），以及通过 API 提供、上下文上限为 4,096 个词元的 gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 与 gpt-4-0314 快照，因此所选程序须控制在该上限的一半以内。300 个 Code Contest 程序平均 112.9 行；Coreutils 9.5 与 CGC 二进制编译时未剥离符号，并逐函数修复，这种方式无法推断未定义的全局变量。约 30% 的困难案例仍然失败，主要原因包括反编译器混淆地址与数据、缓冲区大小推断错误、包含 STL 代码的过长输出，以及大语言模型以类型强制转换走捷径；测试未覆盖的行为偏差仍无法发现。对 Juliet 样本进行 CodeQL 分析时需要人工调整查询。
why_fits_en: Adds recompilability-oriented repair of decompiler output, complementing readability-oriented LLM refinement and neural decompilation research.
why_fits_zh: 补充以可重新编译为目标的反编译输出修复方法，与以可读性为目标的大语言模型改写及神经反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: The ACM page and Crossref agree on the title, nine-author order, DOI, volume 2, issue ISSTA, pages 1841–1864 and the 2025-06-22 publication date (received 2025-02-27, accepted 2025-03-31); the ACM page supplies article number ISSTA081, which Crossref omits. ACM marks the article open access under CC BY-ND 4.0, and its HTML full text was reviewed. No arXiv version of DecLLM was found. The related preprint arXiv:2310.06530, “Refining Decompiled C Code with Large Language Models” (DecGPT; v1 2023-10-10, v2 2023-11-28), shares eight of the nine authors, omitting Daoyuan Wu, and the recompilation goal, but its title, author list and reported results differ, so it is not recorded as this paper’s arXiv identifier. The Data Availability section points only to the Google Sites artifact page. As reviewed, it describes DecRule’s preprocessing rules, error examples, dynamic-repair case analysis and the CWE list; no source repository, prompt package or dataset download was identified, so code_url stays null. The prototype targeted output from the commercial IDA Pro decompiler and used OpenAI model snapshots that may no longer be served. Nothing was run.
