metadata_notes_zh: ACM 页面与 Crossref 的标题、九位作者顺序、DOI、第 2 卷 ISSTA 期、页码 1841–1864 及 2025-06-22 出版日期一致（2025-02-27 收稿，2025-03-31 接收）；文章编号 ISSTA081 由 ACM 页面提供，Crossref 未列出。ACM 将文章标为开放获取，采用 CC BY-ND 4.0 许可，本次审阅了其 HTML 全文。未发现 DecLLM 的 arXiv 版本。相关预印本 arXiv:2310.06530《Refining Decompiled C Code with Large Language Models》（DecGPT；v1 为 2023-10-10，v2 为 2023-11-28）与本文共有九位作者中的八位（未列 Daoyuan Wu），研究目标同为可重新编译，但标题、作者列表与报告结果不同，因此不作为本文的 arXiv 标识符记录。数据可用性章节仅指向 Google Sites 产物页面。经审阅，该页面介绍 DecRule 的预处理规则、错误示例、动态修复案例分析及 CWE 列表，未发现源码仓库、提示词包或数据集下载，因此 code_url 保持为空。原型针对商业反编译器 IDA Pro 的输出，所用 OpenAI 模型快照可能已停止提供。本次未运行任何内容。

title: Neural reverse engineering of stripped binaries using augmented control flow graphs
title_zh: 基于增强控制流图的剥离符号二进制神经逆向工程
date_basis: ACM’s Crossref deposit gives print and online publication on 2020-11-13, and an archived copy of the ACM article page shows the same publication date. The OOPSLA conference dates and the arXiv versions are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2020-11-13，ACM 文章页面的存档副本也显示同一出版日期。本条目不以 OOPSLA 会议日期或各 arXiv 版本日期代替。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages (OOPSLA 2020)
description_en: Nero predicts names for procedures in stripped x86-64 Linux executables; it does not produce decompiled code. Static analysis reconstructs call sites, including imported API names, and augments their arguments with concrete and abstract values along control-flow paths. LSTM, Transformer and graph neural network encoders over the resulting augmented call-site graph feed a decoder that generates the name as subtokens. On a GNU-package test set the authors report 45.53 F1 for Nero-GNN, against 35.52 for an adapted DIRE and 33.66 for Debin.
description_zh: Nero 为剥离符号的 x86-64 Linux 可执行文件中的过程预测名称，并不生成反编译代码。它通过静态分析重建调用点（包括导入的 API 名称），并沿控制流路径为参数补充具体值与抽象值。LSTM、Transformer 与图神经网络编码器处理由此得到的增强调用点图，再由解码器以子词序列生成名称。在 GNU 软件包测试集上，作者报告 Nero-GNN 的 F1 为 45.53，改造后的 DIRE 为 35.52，Debin 为 33.66。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation uses 67,246 procedures from C-only GNU packages built as x86-64 Linux executables, split by package into 60,403/2,034/4,809 examples after removing C++ executables, tests, statically linked packages and duplicate package versions. Labels come from names present before stripping, and F1 is measured over name subtokens, so outputs are learned suggestions rather than recovered original symbols. Simulated API-name obfuscation, which zeroes the .dynstr section, lowers Nero-GNN to 38.83 F1; packers and heavier obfuscation are not addressed. A procedure needs at least one statically detectable call site, and inlined procedures cannot be named. Data generation relied on a licensed IDA Pro (tested with 6.95) for procedure boundaries and export, plus angr and LLVM 10, and the model code uses TensorFlow 1.13.1; no claim is made about compatibility with current tool versions.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测使用来自纯 C 语言 GNU 软件包、构建为 x86-64 Linux 可执行文件的 67,246 个过程；在剔除 C++ 可执行文件、测试程序、静态链接软件包及同一软件包的重复版本后，按软件包划分为 60,403／2,034／4,809 个样本。标签取自剥离前的名称，F1 按名称子词计算，因此输出是模型学到的建议，而非恢复出的原始符号。模拟 API 名称混淆（将 .dynstr 节清零）会使 Nero-GNN 的 F1 降至 38.83；论文未处理加壳和更强的混淆。每个过程至少需要一个可静态检测的调用点，内联过程无法命名。数据生成依赖已授权的 IDA Pro（测试版本 6.95）识别过程边界并导出，另需 angr 与 LLVM 10；模型代码使用 TensorFlow 1.13.1。本条不对与当前工具版本的兼容性作任何判断。
why_fits_en: Adds learned procedure-name prediction for stripped binaries driven by static call-site analysis, complementing the variable-name and type-recovery papers in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充由静态调用点分析驱动、面向剥离符号二进制的过程名称学习式预测，与本节的变量名和类型恢复论文互补。
metadata_notes: ACM metadata in Crossref and in an Internet Archive copy of the ACM article page (the live page served a browser check during review) give the sentence-case title, volume 4, issue OOPSLA, article 225, pages 1–28; arXiv and the paper PDF capitalise it as 'Neural Reverse Engineering of Stripped Binaries using Augmented Control Flow Graphs'. Crossref records a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence for the article. arXiv has four versions, v1 of 2019-02-25 to v4 of 2020-10-16, and links the DOI; v4 was reviewed and serves as the PDF because the ACM-hosted PDF was not retrieved. The README calls the repository the official Nero-GNN implementation; the reviewed 2021-05-10 commit carries GPL-3.0. Data generation targets Ubuntu 20 with Python 3.8, LLVM 10, angr and a licensed IDA Pro (IDAPython 2.7 scripts tested with 6.95); the model uses Python 3.6 and TensorFlow 1.13.1. The README warns that regenerated representations may differ slightly from the Zenodo copies after a Python 3 port. Zenodo (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.4081641) hosts the binaries, procedure representations and a trained GNN model under a CC-BY-4.0 record label. No archives were downloaded and no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 中的 ACM 元数据及 ACM 文章页面的互联网档案馆存档副本（审阅时实时页面显示浏览器验证）给出句首大写形式的标题、第 4 卷、OOPSLA 期、第 225 篇、第 1–28 页；arXiv 与论文 PDF 将标题写作“Neural Reverse Engineering of Stripped Binaries using Augmented Control Flow Graphs”。Crossref 记录该文章采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 许可。arXiv 共有四个版本，从 2019-02-25 的 v1 到 2020-10-16 的 v4，并链接该 DOI；本次审阅 v4，并因未能获取 ACM 托管的 PDF 而以其作为 PDF 链接。README 称该仓库为 Nero-GNN 的官方实现，所审阅的 2021-05-10 提交采用 GPL-3.0。数据生成面向 Ubuntu 20，需要 Python 3.8、LLVM 10、angr 及已授权的 IDA Pro（IDAPython 2.7 脚本以 6.95 测试）；模型使用 Python 3.6 与 TensorFlow 1.13.1。README 提示，由于移植到 Python 3，重新生成的表示可能与 Zenodo 中的副本略有差异。Zenodo（概念 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.4081641）托管二进制文件、过程表示及训练好的 GNN 模型，记录标注为 CC-BY-4.0。本次未下载任何压缩包，也未运行代码或实验。

title: Decompiling the Synergy: An Empirical Study of Human–LLM Teaming in Software Reverse Engineering
title_zh: 解构协同：软件逆向工程中人类与 LLM 协作的实证研究
date_basis: The Internet Society’s Crossref deposit and the official NDSS paper identify publication year 2026. The PDF footer names the 23–27 February 2026 symposium; no finer publication date is asserted from the event dates.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 提交的 Crossref 元数据与 NDSS 官方论文标明出版年份为 2026。PDF 页脚标注研讨会于 2026 年 2 月 23–27 日举行；不根据会议举办日期推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: Studies how human analysts work with LLM assistance during static software reverse engineering. A survey of 153 practitioners informed six LLM features built into an instrumented IDA Pro plugin. Then 48 participants (24 self-reported novices and 24 experts) analyzed two CTF-style binaries, with the features enabled on one randomly assigned challenge. From graded writeups, interaction logs and surveys, the authors report 18 findings: novice understanding rose by about 98% to expert levels while experts gained little, known-algorithm functions were triaged up to 2.4× faster, and artifact recovery rose by at least 66%, alongside harmful hallucinations.
description_zh: 研究人类分析人员在静态软件逆向工程中如何借助 LLM 辅助开展工作。作者依据对 153 名从业者的问卷，在带插桩的 IDA Pro 插件中实现六项 LLM 功能；随后 48 名参与者（自报新手与专家各 24 名）分析两个 CTF 风格的二进制程序，其中一道随机指定的题目启用这些功能。基于评分后的解题报告、交互日志和问卷，作者报告 18 项发现：新手的理解程度提升约 98%，达到专家水平，而专家收益甚微；已知算法函数的分诊速度最高提升 2.4 倍，产物恢复量至少增加 66%；同时也出现了有害的幻觉。
scope_limitations_en: A human study of LLM-assisted analysis, not an evaluation of autonomous agents or of LLM decompilation accuracy. It uses two unobfuscated C challenges of 26 functions each, static analysis in IDA Pro only (no debuggers or symbolic execution), researcher-written prompts, and a choice of GPT-4o, GPT-4o-Mini, GPT-4-Turbo, Claude-3-5-Sonnet or Gemini-Pro. The 2024–2025 sessions retain 48 of 51 participants; expertise is self-reported, and understanding is a rubric score of writeups graded by two researchers. LLM-created artifacts were not correlated with better understanding, and three LLM users reported a nonexistent buffer overflow that an LLM had suggested; the vulnerability-finding feature was negatively correlated with understanding. Individual observations, writeups and survey responses are not released, even on request; aggregated data is available only on request.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是一项关于 LLM 辅助分析的人类研究，并非对自主智能体或 LLM 反编译准确率的评测。研究使用两个未经混淆、各含 26 个函数的 C 语言题目，仅允许在 IDA Pro 中进行静态分析（不能使用调试器或符号执行），提示词由研究团队编写，模型可在 GPT-4o、GPT-4o-Mini、GPT-4-Turbo、Claude-3-5-Sonnet 与 Gemini-Pro 中选择。2024–2025 年的实验在 51 名参与者中保留 48 名；专业水平为自报，理解程度是由两名研究人员按评分细则给解题报告打出的分数。LLM 直接生成的产物与理解程度提升无相关性；三名 LLM 用户报告了一个由 LLM 提示、实际并不存在的缓冲区溢出，而“查找漏洞”功能与理解得分呈负相关。个人观察记录、解题报告和问卷回答均不公开，也不接受申请；汇总数据仅可申请获取。
why_fits_en: Measures how LLM assistance inside a decompiler changes human reverse-engineering outcomes, complementing agent-only evaluations. The paper points to DAILA, listed in the curated catalog, as the actively maintained version of its study plugin.
why_fits_zh: 衡量反编译器内的 LLM 辅助如何改变人类逆向工程的结果，与仅评测智能体的研究互补。论文指出，精选目录收录的 DAILA 是其研究插件持续维护的版本。
metadata_notes: The nine-author order follows the PDF, the NDSS paper page and Crossref. The PDF spells ‘Adam Doupé’, while Crossref and the paper page give ‘Doupe’; the page also lists Ruoyu “Fish” Wang. The PDF footer gives ISBN 979-8-9919276-8-0 and the DOI; Crossref lists no pages, and no page range was verified. No arXiv version was found. Footnote 1 and the Open Science section link mahaloz/dec-synergy-study. Its reviewed 2026-07-22 snapshot declares BSD-2-Clause and contains both challenges (sources, binaries, IDA databases and a solver) and the study infrastructure: a pwn.college Dojo module and REaLLM, the study version of DAILA. REaLLM requires Python 3.10+, libbs 2.9.1 and dailalib 3.15.6; study functionality needs a separately licensed IDA Pro 9 installation and the user’s own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini API keys. The infrastructure README documents a Docker build and a dojo.patch that this snapshot does not contain. The paper reports the known-algorithm speedup as up to 2.4× in the abstract, 238% in the introduction and at least 248% for experts on four functions in Finding 7. Finding 6 calls a p = 0.4 result statistically significant, despite the paper’s α = 0.05. These figures are author-reported. No upstream code was run and no experiments were reproduced.
metadata_notes_zh: 九位作者的顺序以 PDF、NDSS 论文页和 Crossref 为准。PDF 写作“Adam Doupé”，Crossref 与论文页写作“Doupe”；论文页还将 Ruoyu Wang 列为 Ruoyu “Fish” Wang。PDF 页脚标注 ISBN 979-8-9919276-8-0 及 DOI；Crossref 未列出页码，本条目未核实页码范围。未找到 arXiv 版本。论文脚注 1 与开放科学一节链接 mahaloz/dec-synergy-study。所审阅的 2026-07-22 快照声明采用 BSD-2-Clause，包含两道题目（源码、二进制、IDA 数据库与求解程序）及研究基础设施：一个 pwn.college Dojo 模块，以及 DAILA 的研究版本 REaLLM。REaLLM 需要 Python 3.10+、libbs 2.9.1 与 dailalib 3.15.6；要使用研究中的功能，还需另行获得许可的 IDA Pro 9 安装，以及用户自己的 OpenAI、Anthropic 或 Gemini API 密钥。基础设施 README 说明了 Docker 构建步骤和 dojo.patch，但该快照中没有这些文件。论文对已知算法加速幅度的表述不一：摘要为最高 2.4 倍，引言为 238%，发现 7 则称专家在四个函数上至少快 248%。发现 6 将 p = 0.4 的结果称为统计显著，而论文设定的显著性阈值为 α = 0.05。这些数字均由作者报告。本次未运行上游代码，也未复现实验。

title: DynPRE: Protocol Reverse Engineering via Dynamic Inference
title_zh: DynPRE：基于动态推断的协议逆向工程
date_basis: Internet Society-deposited Crossref metadata supplies only publication year 2024; the publisher PDF separately identifies the 26 February–1 March 2024 symposium, which is not used to assert a publication month or day.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据仅给出出版年份 2024；出版方 PDF 另列研讨会日期为 2024 年 2 月 26 日至 3 月 1 日，本条目不据此推定出版月份或日期。
description_en: DynPRE starts from captured client–server traces and then interacts with a live protocol server to infer message formats and types. It detects session-specific identifiers such as cookies and rewrites them on the fly so that replayed requests stay valid. It then sends byte-level probe requests whose responses serve as semantic feedback for field identification, aligns the responses, and applies a request–response mapping refinement that also recognizes message types. On 12 protocols with 10-, 100- and 1,000-message datasets, the authors report average field perfection of 0.50 and message-type V-measure of 0.94, against 0.15–0.31 perfection for Netzob, NetPlier, FieldHunter, BinaryInferno and NEMESYS.
description_zh: DynPRE 以捕获的客户端—服务端流量为起点，再与在线协议服务端交互，推断报文格式与类型。它检测 Cookie 等会话特定标识符并实时改写，使重放的请求保持有效；随后发送字节级探测请求，以服务端响应作为字段识别的语义反馈，对响应进行对齐分析，并通过请求—响应映射细化格式，同时识别报文类型。作者在 12 种协议、规模分别为 10、100 与 1,000 条报文的数据集上，报告平均字段完美分割率为 0.50、报文类型 V-measure 为 0.94，而 Netzob、NetPlier、FieldHunter、BinaryInferno 与 NEMESYS 的完美分割率为 0.15–0.31。
scope_limitations_en: The method needs captured traces plus a reachable server that it can query repeatedly; it does not work from passive captures alone. Probing changes server state: each probe opens a new session, but protocols with global state, such as IoT device power state, can still degrade feedback. On the 1,000-message datasets an analysis averaged 259 minutes, 50,344 connection attempts and about 3.98 million exchanged messages, so slow or rate-limiting servers reduce efficiency. Encryption and authentication were disabled in the open-source evaluation setups, and encrypted traffic in the IoT case studies was decrypted with device private keys. Checksummed protocols need an added checksum-reversal step, shown only on ICMP. Format ground truth comes from tshark dissectors, and message types from manual reading of protocol documents. The five-device IoT case studies test whether generated messages trigger device behaviors, not whether specifications are complete. State-machine inference reuses existing methods and is not evaluated as a contribution.
scope_limitations_zh: 该方法需要捕获流量以及可被反复查询的可达服务端，无法仅凭被动捕获流量工作。探测会改变服务端状态：每次探测都会新建会话，但具有全局状态的协议（如 IoT 设备的开关状态）仍可能降低反馈质量。在 1,000 条报文的数据集上，单次分析平均耗时 259 分钟，平均发起 50,344 次连接、交换约 398 万条报文，因此低速或限流的服务端会降低效率。在开源评测环境中，加密与认证机制均被关闭；IoT 案例研究中的加密流量则借助设备私钥解密。带校验和的协议需要额外的校验和逆向步骤，且仅在 ICMP 上演示。格式真实标签来自 tshark 解析器，报文类型则来自人工阅读协议文档。针对五台设备的 IoT 案例研究检验生成的报文能否触发设备行为，而非规范是否完整。状态机推断沿用已有方法，并未作为贡献加以评估。
why_fits_en: Adds active, server-interactive protocol inference, complementing the trace-only, binary-assisted and source-based protocol reconstruction research in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充主动与服务端交互的协议推断方法，与本节中仅基于流量、借助二进制及基于源码的协议重建研究互补。
metadata_notes: The NDSS paper page lists the seven authors with affiliations and links the PDF and slides; Crossref gives the same author order and only the year 2024. The PDF footer gives the 26 February–1 March 2024 symposium in San Diego, ISBN 1-891562-93-2 and the DOI. No arXiv version was found. The paper says DynPRE is available at github.com/DynPRE/DynPRE, but the reviewed 2025-08-27 snapshot contains only a README asking readers to contact the authors by email for the code and declares no license. code_url is therefore null, and no public implementation is claimed. The paper ran the baselines from public releases, using a public re-implementation for FieldHunter. Nothing was run for this review.
metadata_notes_zh: NDSS 论文页面列出七位作者及其单位，并链接 PDF 与演示幻灯片；Crossref 给出相同的作者顺序，仅记载年份 2024。PDF 页脚标明研讨会于 2024 年 2 月 26 日至 3 月 1 日在圣迭戈举行，并载有 ISBN 1-891562-93-2 与 DOI。未找到 arXiv 版本。论文称 DynPRE 可在 github.com/DynPRE/DynPRE 获取，但所审阅的 2025-08-27 快照仅有一份 README，请读者通过电子邮件联系作者获取代码，且未声明许可证。因此 code_url 为 null，本条目不声称存在公开实现。论文的基线工具来自公开版本，其中 FieldHunter 使用公开的重新实现。本次审阅未运行任何内容。

title: BinMetric: A Comprehensive Binary Code Analysis Benchmark for Large Language Models
title_zh: BinMetric：面向大语言模型的综合二进制代码分析基准
date_basis: The IJCAI Organization’s Crossref deposit gives publication month September 2025. The proceedings page’s citation metadata separately gives 2025-09-16; this entry keeps the month that both sources state and does not use the August 16–22 conference dates.
date_basis_zh: IJCAI 组织向 Crossref 提交的元数据给出出版月份为 2025 年 9 月；论文集页面的引用元数据另给出 2025-09-16。本条目采用两处来源均载明的月份，不使用 8 月 16–22 日的会议日期。
description_en: BinMetric poses 1,000 questions across six binary-analysis tasks: call-site reconstruction, decompilation, signature recovery, binary code summarization, algorithm classification and assembly instruction generation. The questions come from 20 open-source C projects compiled for x86-64, stripped and processed with IDA Pro, and aligned with source code through DWARF information. The authors evaluate 12 LLMs from five model families with one-shot prompts, alongside IDA Pro’s decompiler, LLM4Decompile, BinT5 and HexT5 where those apply.
description_zh: BinMetric 提供六类二进制分析任务共 1,000 道题目：调用点重建、反编译、函数签名恢复、二进制代码摘要、算法分类与汇编指令生成。题目取自 20 个开源 C 项目：项目针对 x86-64 编译、剥离符号并经 IDA Pro 处理，再借助 DWARF 信息与源码对齐。作者使用单样例提示评测来自五个模型家族的 12 个大语言模型，并在适用任务上与 IDA Pro 反编译器、LLM4Decompile、BinT5 和 HexT5 对比。
scope_limitations_en: Scores are question-level metrics on isolated snippets, not end-to-end reverse-engineering workflows or agentic tool use. Preprocessing requires IDA Pro, and all binaries are x86-64 builds with each project’s default compiler settings on Ubuntu 22.04; other architectures, optimization sweeps and obfuscation are not studied. Most tasks score text overlap with Rouge-L, BLEU, METEOR or CodeBLEU, so they do not test semantic equivalence; only assembly generation checks compilation and test-case execution, where the average execution pass rate is below 1%. Summary labels were generated by ChatGPT and then manually reviewed, and algorithm classification uses 80 snippets from a single algorithms project. Leakage screening relied on exact-match web searches. The evaluated models predate 2025 (including gpt-3.5-turbo-16k-0613 and gpt-4-0613) and ran with a maximum length of 8,192 tokens, so the rankings are historical.
scope_limitations_zh: 得分是针对孤立代码片段的题目级指标，并不代表端到端逆向工程流程或智能体工具使用能力。预处理需要 IDA Pro，所有二进制均是在 Ubuntu 22.04 上以各项目默认编译设置构建的 x86-64 程序；未研究其他架构、优化级别变化或混淆。多数任务以 Rouge-L、BLEU、METEOR 或 CodeBLEU 衡量文本重合度，因而并不检验语义等价；只有汇编生成任务检查能否编译及测试用例执行结果，其平均执行通过率低于 1%。摘要标签由 ChatGPT 生成后经人工审核；算法分类使用取自单一算法项目的 80 个片段。数据泄露筛查依赖网页精确匹配搜索。被评测模型均早于 2025 年（包括 gpt-3.5-turbo-16k-0613 与 gpt-4-0613），最大长度设为 8,192 个词元，因此排名只反映当时情况。
why_fits_en: Adds a multi-task benchmark spanning binary lifting, semantic recovery, algorithm identification and assembly synthesis, complementing single-task decompilation and agent benchmarks.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个涵盖二进制提升、语义恢复、算法识别与汇编合成的多任务基准，与单一任务的反编译及智能体基准互补。
metadata_notes: The proceedings title reads “Binary Code Analysis Benchmark”; arXiv v1, the only version, is titled “A Comprehensive Binary Analysis Benchmark for Large Language Models” and is a 23-page extended version whose comment says it was to be published in IJCAI 2025. The proceedings PDF, page metadata and Crossref agree on the eight-author order, the DOI and pages 7715–7723 in the Main Track. Neither the proceedings PDF nor arXiv v1 links code, data or a leaderboard. A same-named GitHub repository describes itself as the IJCAI’25 benchmark but declares no license and is not linked from the paper, so it is not recorded as author-provided code. Per-task counts are 70 call-site, 250 decompilation, 250 signature, 250 summarization, 80 classification and 100 assembly-generation items. No benchmark data was downloaded, and no experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 论文集中的标题为“Binary Code Analysis Benchmark”；arXiv 唯一版本 v1 的标题为“A Comprehensive Binary Analysis Benchmark for Large Language Models”，是 23 页的扩展版本，备注称将发表于 IJCAI 2025。论文集 PDF、页面元数据与 Crossref 一致给出八位作者顺序、DOI 及主会第 7715–7723 页。论文集 PDF 与 arXiv v1 均未链接代码、数据或排行榜。GitHub 上一个同名仓库自称为该 IJCAI’25 基准，但未声明许可证，论文也未链接它，因此不将其记录为作者提供的代码。各任务题目数分别为调用点重建 70 道、反编译 250 道、签名恢复 250 道、代码摘要 250 道、算法分类 80 道、汇编生成 100 道。本次未下载基准数据，也未运行实验。

title: DiSCo: Towards Decompiling EVM Bytecode to Source Code using Large Language Models
title_zh: DiSCo：利用大语言模型将 EVM 字节码反编译为源代码
date_basis: The ACM article page and publisher-deposited Crossref metadata agree on publication on 2025-06-19. The PDF footer’s July 2025 issue date and the FSE conference dates are not substituted for this publication date.
date_basis_zh: ACM 文章页面与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据均将出版日期列为 2025-06-19；本条目不以 PDF 页脚的 2025 年 7 月期号日期或 FSE 会议日期替代该出版日期。
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Software Engineering (FSE 2025)
description_en: DiSCo lifts Ethereum contract creation bytecode to Solidity source by prompting a frozen LLM, instead of emitting decompiler pseudocode. It abstracts control-flow paths into logic-invariant semantic units, recovers constructor logic by simulating creation bytecode captured from block execution, and infers stripped names with signature databases and a type-aware graph model. These units become natural-language descriptions plus coding specifications in the prompt. GPT-4 is the primary model; Llama 3 is also tested.
description_zh: DiSCo 通过提示冻结参数的大语言模型，把以太坊合约的创建字节码提升为 Solidity 源码，而不是输出反编译伪代码。它将控制流路径抽象为逻辑不变的语义单元，模拟执行从区块执行中捕获的创建字节码以恢复构造函数逻辑，并借助签名数据库与类型感知图模型推断被剥离的名称。这些单元被转写为自然语言描述，并与编码规范一起放入提示词。主要模型为 GPT-4，另测试了 Llama 3。
scope_limitations_en: Ground truth comes from Etherscan source files: 200 highest-balance contracts for all baselines and 1,000 for automated tests; separate studies add 50 Vyper, 50 newly deployed and 149 closed-source attack contracts. Compilability (about 75% with best-of-five sampling, 46% for a single run), differential-fuzzing pass rates and embedding similarity do not establish equivalence to deployed source. Nearly half of the imitation-learning fuzzer’s transactions revert, and manual review judged about 28.5% of generated contracts semantically consistent, and 12% for Vyper inputs. The authors report timeouts or unsound analysis on contracts with many paths, and name inference remains weak. Baselines give the same LLM output from Panoramix, Ethervm and Elipmoc, mostly taken from their websites or decompiled manually; this is not a comparison of standalone decompilers. Results depend on a GPT-4 preview snapshot. Attack reproduction covers ten January 2025 incidents, four of which were reproduced.
scope_limitations_zh: 真实标签来自 Etherscan 上的源码文件：200 个余额最高的合约用于全部基线，1,000 个用于自动化测试；另有独立实验使用 50 个 Vyper 合约、50 个新部署合约和 149 个闭源攻击合约。可编译率（五次采样取优约为 75%，单次运行为 46%）、差分模糊测试通过率与嵌入相似度都不能证明与已部署源码等价。模仿学习模糊测试器生成的交易近半数会回滚；人工审查认为约 28.5% 的生成合约语义一致，Vyper 输入仅为 12%。作者报告路径过多的合约会导致超时或分析不可靠，名称推断能力也仍然有限。基线是将 Panoramix、Ethervm 和 Elipmoc 的输出（多取自其网站，部分为人工反编译）交给同一大语言模型，并非独立反编译器之间的比较。结果依赖某个 GPT-4 预览版快照。攻击复现仅覆盖 2025 年 1 月的十起事件，其中四起复现成功。
why_fits_en: Extends LLM-assisted decompilation to EVM smart-contract bytecode, recovering constructor logic and identifiers and checking results by compilation and differential execution.
why_fits_zh: 将大语言模型辅助反编译扩展到 EVM 智能合约字节码，恢复构造函数逻辑与标识符，并通过编译和差分执行检查结果。
metadata_notes: The six-author order follows the ACM PDF and Crossref. ACM lists article FSE103 in volume 2, issue FSE, pages 2311–2334, and licenses the paper under CC BY 4.0. No arXiv version was found. The Data Availability section points to github.com/suxnju/disco, which now redirects to b1ue3ky/disco. At the reviewed 2025-04-13 commit, that MIT-licensed repository holds dataset CSVs of contract addresses, evaluation results and user-study material, but no DiSCo implementation, so it is recorded as a project link rather than code. Contract sources and on-chain data keep their own terms. The primary model is given as GPT-4-0315-Preview. No code, prompts or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 六位作者的顺序以 ACM PDF 与 Crossref 为准。ACM 列出第 2 卷 FSE 期、文章编号 FSE103、页码 2311–2334，并以 CC BY 4.0 授权论文。未找到 arXiv 版本。论文的数据可用性章节指向 github.com/suxnju/disco，该地址现重定向至 b1ue3ky/disco。在所审阅的 2025-04-13 提交中，这个采用 MIT 许可证的仓库包含列出合约地址的数据集 CSV、评估结果与用户研究材料，但没有 DiSCo 实现，因此记录为项目链接而非代码。合约源码与链上数据保留各自条款。论文所列主要模型为 GPT-4-0315-Preview。本次未运行代码、提示词或实验。

title: StackSight: Unveiling WebAssembly through Large Language Models and Neurosymbolic Chain-of-Thought Decompilation
title_zh: StackSight：借助大语言模型与神经符号思维链反编译揭示 WebAssembly
date_basis: PMLR states that Volume 235 was published on 08 July 2024, and the paper page gives the same citation date. The July 21–27 conference dates and the June 2024 arXiv submission are not used as the publication date.
date_basis_zh: PMLR 标明第 235 卷于 2024 年 7 月 8 日出版，论文页面给出的引用日期与此相同。本条目不以 7 月 21—27 日的会议日期或 2024 年 6 月的 arXiv 提交日期作为出版日期。
description_en: StackSight decompiles WebAssembly text-format functions into C++ with LLM prompting. A static analysis annotates each WAT instruction with the virtual-stack state, using symbolic notation where branches diverge; a one-shot chain-of-thought prompt then asks the model to recover variable meanings, summarize the function and write C++. With GPT-4 the share of outputs passing all benchmark tests rises from 19.7% to 36.5% on HumanEval-X and from 42.4% to 59.6% on MBXP relative to one-shot prompting; GPT-3.5 and Code Llama-7B-Instruct are also evaluated.
description_zh: StackSight 借助大语言模型提示，将 WebAssembly 文本格式（WAT）函数反编译为 C++。它先通过静态分析为每条 WAT 指令标注虚拟栈状态，在分支分叉处使用符号记法；再用单样例思维链提示，要求模型恢复变量含义、总结函数功能并写出 C++。使用 GPT-4 时，与单样例提示相比，通过全部基准测试的输出比例在 HumanEval-X 上从 19.7% 升至 36.5%，在 MBXP 上从 42.4% 升至 59.6%；论文还评估了 GPT-3.5 与 Code Llama-7B-Instruct。
scope_limitations_en: Inputs are short exercise functions from the C++ splits of HumanEval-X (161 of 164 compiled) and MBXP (773 of 974), built as Emscripten 3.1.46 side modules at -Oz with function names kept by --profiling-funcs and converted with wasm2wat 1.0.33; minified, obfuscated or whole-application WebAssembly is not evaluated. Correctness is the share of outputs that compile and pass the benchmarks' test cases after a test oracle renames functions, inserts tests and adds namespace directives, with manual pass-by-value edits. Passing these tests is not proof of equivalence with the original module. Summaries are scored by BERTScore and SBERT; the user study had 15 participants on 20 snippets per dataset. wasm2c and an earlier neural decompiler were excluded for producing no compilable output, and results depend on specific hosted model versions.
scope_limitations_zh: 输入是 HumanEval-X（164 个中 161 个可编译）与 MBXP（974 个中 773 个）C++ 子集中的简短练习函数，以 Emscripten 3.1.46 按 -Oz 编译为侧模块，通过 --profiling-funcs 保留函数名，再用 wasm2wat 1.0.33 转换；未评估经过压缩、混淆或完整应用规模的 WebAssembly。正确性指输出能够编译并通过基准测试用例的比例；测试判定器会重命名函数、插入测试并补充命名空间指令，按值传参则由人工修改。通过这些测试并不证明与原始模块等价。函数摘要以 BERTScore 和 SBERT 评分；用户研究有 15 名参与者，每个数据集 20 个代码片段。wasm2c 与一种早期神经反编译器因无法生成可编译输出而未纳入比较，结果也依赖特定版本的托管模型。
why_fits_en: Adds LLM-based WebAssembly decompilation guided by static stack analysis, covering the bytecode format shipped in web applications alongside the native-code decompilation papers in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充由静态栈分析引导的大语言模型 WebAssembly 反编译方法，覆盖网页应用所交付的字节码格式，与本节的原生代码反编译论文并列。
metadata_notes: PMLR lists Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235, pages 13010–13028; no DOI is given. arXiv has a single version, v1 of 2024-06-07, whose comment cites the ICML 2024 proceedings. The models are gpt-3.5-turbo-1106, gpt-4-0125-preview and Code Llama-7b-Instruct; GPT-4 was compared only with one-shot prompting, while the GPT-3.5 and Code Llama baselines also use 3-, 5- and 10-shot prompts. The appendix gives the emcc and wasm2wat commands and the prompts. The paper links third-party tools such as WABT and Emscripten but no author code, prompts repository or evaluation harness, and none was found. No code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: PMLR 列出 Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning、PMLR 第 235 卷第 13010–13028 页，未给出 DOI。arXiv 仅有 2024-06-07 的 v1，其备注引用 ICML 2024 论文集。所用模型为 gpt-3.5-turbo-1106、gpt-4-0125-preview 与 Code Llama-7b-Instruct；GPT-4 仅与单样例提示比较，GPT-3.5 与 Code Llama 的基线另含 3、5、10 样例提示。附录给出 emcc 与 wasm2wat 命令及提示词。论文链接了 WABT、Emscripten 等第三方工具，但未提供作者代码、提示词仓库或评测框架，本次也未找到。本次未运行代码或实验。

title: Idioms: A Simple and Effective Framework for Turbo-Charging Local Neural Decompilation with Well-Defined Types
title_zh: Idioms：以明确定义的类型显著增强局部神经反编译的简单有效框架
date_basis: The official NDSS paper and the Internet Society’s Crossref deposit establish publication year 2026. The February 23–27 symposium dates are not used as a publication day.
date_basis_zh: NDSS 官方论文与 Internet Society 提交的 Crossref 元数据确认出版年份为 2026；不以 2 月 23—27 日的研讨会日期作为出版日。

citation.container_title: Proceedings 2026 Network and Distributed System Security Symposium

description_en: Idioms fine-tunes code language models to turn Hex-Rays output for one target function into predicted original C together with definitions of the user-defined structs, unions and typedefs it uses. Input can include neighboring decompiled functions in breadth-first call-graph order, so evidence about a type scattered across callers and callees reaches the model. The authors also build Realtype, 157,163 functions from compiled open-source C repositories with full type definitions. Their CodeGemma-7b-based model passes ExeBench unit tests for 54.4% of functions versus 46.3% for LLM4Decompile and 37.5% for Nova, and scores at least 95% higher on Realtype.
description_zh: Idioms 微调代码语言模型，把单个目标函数的 Hex-Rays 输出转换为预测的原始 C 代码，并同时给出其中使用的用户自定义结构体、联合体和类型别名定义。输入可按调用图广度优先顺序附带相邻的反编译函数，使分散在调用者与被调用者中的类型线索能够提供给模型。作者还构建了 Realtype 数据集，包含来自已编译开源 C 仓库的 157,163 个函数及完整类型定义。其基于 CodeGemma-7b 的模型在 ExeBench 上有 54.4% 的函数通过单元测试，LLM4Decompile 为 46.3%，Nova 为 37.5%；在 Realtype 上的得分至少高出 95%。
scope_limitations_en: This is local, function-level neural decompilation: each prediction covers one target function and its type definitions, not a compilable whole program. Evaluation uses x86-64 Linux gcc binaries from open-source GitHub projects and ExeBench’s “real” subset; O1–O3 builds disable inlining, and keeping only functions that decompiled at every level removes 21% of the Hex-Rays and 76% of the Ghidra test sets. ExeBench unit tests are an optimistic proxy; Realtype has no tests, so dependency-graph equivalence and exact name and type matches serve as conservative proxies, and a Realtype user-defined type counts as correct only if all of its fields, 17.6 on average when counted recursively, match. The main models use proprietary Hex-Rays output and context windows of 2,048 or 4,096 tokens. Predicted names and types are statistical, not recovered originals. Pretraining leakage from GitHub remains possible, and obfuscated code and malware were not evaluated.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是局部、函数级的神经反编译：每次预测只覆盖一个目标函数及其类型定义，而非可编译的完整程序。评测使用来自 GitHub 开源项目的 x86-64 Linux gcc 二进制及 ExeBench 的“real”子集；O1–O3 构建禁用内联，且只保留在所有优化级别均能反编译的函数，使 Hex-Rays 与 Ghidra 测试集分别减少 21% 和 76%。ExeBench 单元测试是偏乐观的代理指标；Realtype 没有测试，因此以依赖图等价性及名称、类型的完全匹配作为偏保守的代理指标，且 Realtype 的用户自定义类型须所有字段（递归计算平均 17.6 个）均匹配才算正确。主要模型使用专有 Hex-Rays 的输出，上下文窗口为 2,048 或 4,096 个词元。预测的名称与类型属于统计推断，并非恢复的原始信息。仍可能存在来自 GitHub 的预训练数据泄漏，且未评估混淆代码和恶意软件。
why_fits_en: Adds neural decompilation that jointly predicts code and user-defined type definitions with interprocedural context, and introduces a type-rich benchmark, complementing assembly-to-source models and type and symbol recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充借助过程间上下文、同时预测代码与用户自定义类型定义的神经反编译方法，并提供类型丰富的基准，与从汇编生成源码的模型及类型、符号恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: The NDSS page, final PDF and Crossref agree on the published title, three-author order and DOI; Crossref lists no pages. arXiv:2502.04536 v1 (2025-02-06) is titled “Idioms: Neural Decompilation With Joint Code and Type Prediction” and v2 (2025-06-17) “Idioms: Neural Decompilation With Joint Code and Type Definition Prediction”; the repository README still uses the v1 title. The paper links Zenodo version 10.5281/zenodo.15683630, while the README links its concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14797016; both resolve to the same open 2025-06-17 record of about 11.8 GB, including a 10.1 GB models archive, and the Zenodo metadata names no license. The reviewed 2025-12-03 repository snapshot has no license file, and GitHub detects none, so no open-source license is asserted. Its env.yml pins Python 3.11, CUDA 12.1, transformers 4.46.3 and peft 0.17.0; training also needs unsloth on GPUs with compute capability 7.0 or greater, dataset building runs GHCC builds in Docker that can take weeks, and the main decompilation step needs IDA Pro’s Hex-Rays. ExeBench tests run in a provided Docker image. No code, models or datasets were run or downloaded.
metadata_notes_zh: NDSS 页面、最终 PDF 与 Crossref 的正式标题、三位作者顺序和 DOI 一致；Crossref 未列出页码。arXiv:2502.04536 的 v1（2025-02-06）题为《Idioms: Neural Decompilation With Joint Code and Type Prediction》，v2（2025-06-17）题为《Idioms: Neural Decompilation With Joint Code and Type Definition Prediction》；仓库 README 仍使用 v1 标题。论文链接 Zenodo 版本 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15683630，README 则链接其概念 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14797016；两者指向同一个 2025-06-17 发布的开放记录，约 11.8 GB，其中模型压缩包约 10.1 GB，Zenodo 元数据未注明许可证。所审阅的 2025-12-03 仓库快照没有许可证文件，GitHub 也未检测到许可证，因此本条目不认定任何开源许可证。其 env.yml 固定 Python 3.11、CUDA 12.1、transformers 4.46.3 与 peft 0.17.0；训练还需要在计算能力 7.0 及以上的 GPU 上使用 unsloth，构建数据集需在 Docker 中运行可能耗时数周的 GHCC 编译，主要反编译步骤需要 IDA Pro 的 Hex-Rays。ExeBench 测试在提供的 Docker 镜像中运行。本次未运行或下载代码、模型及数据集。

title: EnIGMA: Interactive Tools Substantially Assist LM Agents in Finding Security Vulnerabilities
title_zh: EnIGMA：交互式工具显著帮助语言模型智能体发现安全漏洞
date_basis: PMLR states that Volume 267 was published on 06 October 2025, matching the paper page’s citation_publication_date of 2025/10/06. The 13–19 July 2025 conference dates are not used.
date_basis_zh: PMLR 说明第 267 卷于 2025 年 10 月 6 日出版，与论文页面 citation_publication_date 所载 2025/10/06 一致；本条目不采用 2025 年 7 月 13–19 日的会议日期。
description_en: EnIGMA extends SWE-agent for capture-the-flag challenges with interactive agent tools that keep a gdb debugging session or a pwntools server connection open across turns, alongside decompile and disassemble commands, an LM summarizer for long outputs, and category-specific demonstrations and guidelines. It is evaluated with four LMs on 390 challenges from NYU CTF, InterCode-CTF, Cybench and a HackTheBox set the authors collected. The paper ablates tools, summarizers and demonstrations, and analyzes solution leakage and “soliloquizing”, where the model writes its own observations instead of acting in the environment.
description_zh: EnIGMA 在 SWE-agent 基础上面向 CTF 题目进行扩展：交互式智能体工具可在多轮之间保持 gdb 调试会话或 pwntools 服务器连接，另有反编译与反汇编命令、用于长输出的语言模型摘要器，以及按题目类别编写的示例和指导。论文使用四种语言模型，在 NYU CTF、InterCode-CTF、Cybench 及作者收集的 HackTheBox 题集共 390 道题目上评测；还对工具、摘要器和示例做消融实验，并分析解答泄露和“自言自语”（soliloquizing）现象，即模型不与环境交互而自行编写观察结果。
scope_limitations_en: The benchmarks mix cryptography, forensics, pwn, reverse engineering, web and miscellaneous tasks (104 of the 390 are reverse engineering), so aggregate solve rates such as 13.5% on NYU CTF are not reverse-engineering accuracy. The per-category table reports 17.65% on NYU CTF’s 51 reverse-engineering challenges with Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Results are pass@1 with a $3 per-instance cost cap and 2024 models (GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet and LLaMA 3.1 405B Instruct); the NYU CTF baseline comparison uses pass@5. Many challenges have public write-ups, and the authors’ leakage and soliloquy measures are heuristics; on 21 later CSAW 2024 challenges the best configurations solved 2. Solving a CTF shows a captured flag, not recovered program structure or source.
scope_limitations_zh: 各基准混合了密码学、取证、二进制漏洞利用、逆向工程、Web 与杂项任务（390 道题中有 104 道为逆向工程），因此 NYU CTF 上 13.5% 等总体解题率并不等于逆向工程准确率。分类别表格报告，使用 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 时，NYU CTF 中 51 道逆向工程题的解题率为 17.65%。结果采用 pass@1，每道题成本上限为 3 美元，使用 2024 年的模型（GPT-4 Turbo、GPT-4o、Claude 3.5 Sonnet 与 LLaMA 3.1 405B Instruct）；NYU CTF 基线对比采用 pass@5。许多题目存在公开题解，作者对泄露和“自言自语”的度量属于启发式方法；在 21 道较晚发布的 CSAW 2024 题目上，最佳配置解出 2 道。解出 CTF 题目表明获得了 flag，而非恢复了程序结构或源码。
why_fits_en: Evaluates how interactive debugger and connection tools change agent performance on CTF tasks that include reverse engineering, complementing the reverse-engineering-specific benchmarks in this section.
why_fits_zh: 评估交互式调试和连接工具如何影响智能体在包含逆向工程的 CTF 任务上的表现，与本节中专门针对逆向工程的基准互补。
metadata_notes: The 16-author order follows the PMLR page and the arXiv record; the PMLR metadata writes ‘Carlos E Jimenez’ and ‘Karthik R Narasimhan’, while the PDF prints ‘Carlos E. Jimenez’ and ‘Karthik Narasimhan’. PMLR lists pages 246–355 and no DOI; the arXiv v3 comment reads ‘ICML 2025’. The SWE-agent README still cites the earlier arXiv title ‘EnIGMA: Enhanced Interactive Generative Model Agent for CTF Challenges’. PMLR’s software link is the moving v0.7 branch; the reviewed head 084d5d1 (2025-04-28) is MIT-licensed and documents running challenges with Docker image sweagent/enigma:latest. The current main README says to use SWE-agent 0.7 while EnIGMA is updated for 1.0. The project site links trajectories (MIT); the separate benchmarks repository reformats Cybench and InterCode-CTF only and leaves their copyright with the original creators, so it does not supply the HackTheBox set. Table 9 reports the NYU-agent overall rates as 3.00 and 4.00 in the reverse order of the main text. No code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 16 位作者的顺序以 PMLR 页面和 arXiv 记录为准；PMLR 元数据写作“Carlos E Jimenez”和“Karthik R Narasimhan”，PDF 印作“Carlos E. Jimenez”和“Karthik Narasimhan”。PMLR 列出页码 246–355，未提供 DOI；arXiv v3 备注为“ICML 2025”。SWE-agent README 仍引用较早的 arXiv 标题“EnIGMA: Enhanced Interactive Generative Model Agent for CTF Challenges”。PMLR 的软件链接指向会变动的 v0.7 分支；所审阅的分支头 084d5d1（2025-04-28）采用 MIT 许可证，并说明使用 Docker 镜像 sweagent/enigma:latest 运行题目。当前 main 分支 README 称，在 EnIGMA 更新至 1.0 期间应使用 SWE-agent 0.7。项目网站链接了运行轨迹（MIT）；另一个基准仓库仅重新格式化了 Cybench 与 InterCode-CTF，版权仍归原作者，因此并未提供 HackTheBox 题集。表 9 中 NYU 智能体的总体解题率 3.00 与 4.00 与正文所述顺序相反。本次未运行代码或实验。

title: Statistical Deobfuscation of Android Applications
title_zh: Android 应用的统计式反混淆
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives print and online publication on 2016-10-24. That is also the first day of the October 24–28 conference; the date comes from the publisher record, not from the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2016-10-24。该日期恰为 10 月 24—28 日会议的首日；本条目依据出版方记录，而非根据会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2016 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: DeGuard reverses layout obfuscation in Android APKs, predicting original names for the fields, methods, classes and packages that ProGuard renames. Built on Soot, it represents an app as a dependency graph over program elements and keeps Android API and other unobfuscated names fixed. It then runs MAP inference with Nice2Predict on a conditional random field learned from 1,684 F-Droid apps, under constraints that keep the renamed APK semantically equivalent. On 100 held-out F-Droid apps obfuscated with ProGuard, names identical to the originals rise from 13.3% to 79.1%, and third-party library prediction reaches 91.3% precision and 91.0% recall.
description_zh: DeGuard 逆转 Android APK 中的布局混淆，为被 ProGuard 重命名的字段、方法、类和包预测原始名称。它基于 Soot 将应用表示为程序元素之间的依赖图，并保持 Android API 及其他未混淆名称不变；随后在从 1,684 个 F-Droid 应用学习的条件随机场上借助 Nice2Predict 进行 MAP 推断，并以约束保证重命名后的 APK 语义等价。在 100 个留出的、经 ProGuard 混淆的 F-Droid 应用上，与原始名称完全相同的比例从 13.3% 提升至 79.1%，第三方库预测的精确率为 91.3%、召回率为 91.0%。
scope_limitations_en: Only layout (identifier) obfuscation is addressed. Data, control-flow and cryptographic obfuscation, custom string encryption, reflection and goto-based code reordering are not reversed, and the paper notes that most malware samples it inspected also used such techniques. The benchmark is 100 benign, open-source F-Droid apps, obfuscated by enabling ProGuard without changing its rules and scored by exact match to the original names, so semantically close names count as errors; elements that ProGuard removed are not scored. Accuracy on other obfuscators or on malware may be lower. Libraries are identified by a package-name heuristic covering 133 libraries, and the training apps may import the same libraries. The 49-family malware study gives manual examples, such as Base64 decoders and location handling, without precision figures.
scope_limitations_zh: 仅处理布局（标识符）混淆。数据、控制流与密码学混淆、自定义字符串加密、反射以及基于 goto 的代码重排均不在逆转范围内；论文指出，其检查的大多数恶意样本同时使用了这些技术。基准为 100 个良性开源 F-Droid 应用，通过启用 ProGuard 且不修改其规则进行混淆，并以与原始名称完全一致作为评分标准，因此语义相近的名称也计为错误；被 ProGuard 删除的元素不计分。在其他混淆器或恶意软件上的准确率可能较低。第三方库依据包名启发式规则识别，共涵盖 133 个库，训练应用也可能导入相同的库。针对 49 个恶意软件家族的研究给出 Base64 解码器、位置信息处理等人工检查示例，未报告精确率。
why_fits_en: Adds learned identifier recovery for obfuscated Android packages, complementing the interface-reconstruction papers in the app section and the binary symbol-recovery research elsewhere in the bibliography.
why_fits_zh: 补充面向混淆 Android 安装包的学习式标识符恢复方法，与应用部分的界面重建论文及本文献目录中其他二进制符号恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: ACM's Crossref deposit and the ETH-hosted author PDF agree on the title, four-author order and CCS ’16 DOI; Crossref gives pages 343–355. The paper and the SRI project page name http://apk-deguard.com as the public DeGuard service; on 2026-10-18 it redirected to HTTPS and then did not respond, so it is not linked as a working service. No DeGuard source repository was found, and code_url is null. The project page says DeGuard is built on the open-source Nice2Predict framework; that separate inference engine is not recorded as this paper's code. Nothing was run.
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据与 ETH 托管的作者版 PDF 在标题、四位作者顺序及 CCS ’16 DOI 上一致；Crossref 给出页码 343–355。论文与 SRI 项目页面将 http://apk-deguard.com 列为公开的 DeGuard 服务；该地址在 2026-10-18 跳转至 HTTPS 后无响应，因此未作为可用服务链接。未找到 DeGuard 源码仓库，code_url 为 null。项目页面说明 DeGuard 构建于开源的 Nice2Predict 框架之上；该独立推断引擎不作为本论文的代码记录。本次未运行任何内容。

title: FidelityGPT: Correcting Decompilation Distortions with Retrieval Augmented Generation
title_zh: FidelityGPT：利用检索增强生成纠正反编译失真
date_basis: The Internet Society’s Crossref deposit and the official NDSS paper identify publication year 2026. No finer publication date is asserted from the 23–27 February 2026 symposium dates.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 提交的 Crossref 元数据与 NDSS 官方论文标明出版年份为 2026；不根据 2026 年 2 月 23–27 日的会议日期推定更精确的出版日期。
description_en: FidelityGPT post-processes existing decompiler output: an LLM labels lines with six distortion types, such as non-conventional dereferencing, redundant variables and confusing control flow, and then rewrites the labeled lines. Its prompts define the distortion types and add retrieval-augmented context from a manually annotated database of distorted IDA Pro and Ghidra lines. A semantic-intensity algorithm chooses which lines to query, and a variable-dependency analysis carries redundant-variable context across 50-line chunks. On 620 function pairs, the authors report 89% detection accuracy and 83% precision, and correction fix rates of 94% (FR) and 64% (CFR) against 83% and 37% for their DeGPT runs.
description_zh: FidelityGPT 对现有反编译器输出进行后处理：由大语言模型为代码行标注六类失真（如非常规解引用、冗余变量和令人困惑的控制流），再改写被标注的行。其提示词定义各失真类型，并从人工标注的 IDA Pro 与 Ghidra 失真代码行数据库中检索增强上下文。语义强度算法负责选择用于查询的代码行，变量依赖分析则在 50 行分块之间传递冗余变量上下文。作者在 620 对函数上报告检测准确率 89%、精确率 83%，纠正的修复率（FR）为 94%、正确修复率（CFR）为 64%，而他们运行的 DeGPT 分别为 83% 和 37%。
scope_limitations_en: The 620 pairs are mostly -O0 IDA Pro 7.5 functions sampled from Coreutils, curl, ImageMagick, OpenSSL, PuTTY and SQLite builds in a binary-similarity dataset, across ARM-32, MIPS-32 and x86-32, plus x86-64 TheAlgorithms/C code; separate -O1–-O3 and Ghidra sets test generalization. Ground-truth labels and FR/CFR were assessed manually by the author team against the paper’s criteria. Fix rates count lines marked as fixed and are not semantic-equivalence proofs: the authors note that repaired code often cannot be recompiled or executed. Correction runs on whole functions and may degrade on long ones, and the distortion database, built from 150 IDA Pro and 91 Ghidra lines, may miss rarer anomalies. Main results use GPT-4o at temperature 0.5 and remain stochastic; DeepSeek-chat and temperature-0 runs are reported separately. Training-data exposure of the open-source projects cannot be ruled out.
scope_limitations_zh: 620 对函数大多取自二进制相似性数据集中 Coreutils、curl、ImageMagick、OpenSSL、PuTTY 与 SQLite 的构建产物，经 IDA Pro 7.5 在 -O0 下反编译，覆盖 ARM-32、MIPS-32 与 x86-32，另含 x86-64 的 TheAlgorithms/C 代码；另有 -O1–-O3 与 Ghidra 数据集用于检验泛化能力。真实标签与 FR／CFR 均由作者团队依照论文标准人工评估。修复率统计的是被标为已修复的行，并非语义等价证明：作者指出修复后的代码往往无法重新编译或执行。纠正阶段以整个函数为单位，函数较长时效果可能下降；失真数据库由 150 行 IDA Pro 与 91 行 Ghidra 代码构建，可能遗漏较少见的异常。主要结果使用温度为 0.5 的 GPT-4o，仍具随机性；DeepSeek-chat 与温度为 0 的结果另行报告。无法排除这些开源项目出现在训练数据中的可能。
why_fits_en: Adds LLM-based detection and correction of distortions in decompiler output, complementing DeGPT-style refinement and end-to-end LLM decompilation.
why_fits_zh: 补充基于大语言模型检测并纠正反编译输出失真的方法，与 DeGPT 式输出优化和端到端大语言模型反编译互补。
metadata_notes: The eight-author order follows the NDSS paper page, the PDF, Crossref and arXiv v1, which carries the same DOI. The PDF footer gives ISBN 979-8-9919276-8-0; Crossref lists no pages. The paper’s reference [31] points to the authors’ repository, reviewed at a 2025-09-07 commit. It has no license file, so no reuse terms are inferred; its datasets contain decompiled functions and source code from third-party projects with their own licenses. The snapshot includes the detection and correction scripts, prompt templates, both distortion databases, seven decompiled-function sets with ground truth and a detection evaluator; the -O1–-O3 and Ghidra evaluation sets were not identified in it. Its README requires manual merging of chunked detection output and states that correction must be evaluated manually using the paper’s Table I. The configuration targets an OpenAI-compatible GPT-4o endpoint at temperature 0 with pinned LangChain 0.1 and Chroma dependencies. No code, API calls or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 八位作者的顺序以 NDSS 论文页、PDF、Crossref 及 arXiv v1 为准，arXiv 记录载有相同 DOI。PDF 页脚标注 ISBN 979-8-9919276-8-0；Crossref 未列出页码。论文参考文献 [31] 指向作者仓库，本次审阅其 2025-09-07 提交。仓库没有许可证文件，因此不推定任何复用条款；其数据集包含来自第三方项目的反编译函数与源码，这些项目保留各自许可证。该快照包含检测与纠正脚本、提示词模板、两套失真数据库、七组带真实标签的反编译函数以及检测评估脚本；未在其中找到 -O1–-O3 与 Ghidra 评估集。README 要求人工合并分块检测的输出，并说明纠正结果须依照论文表 I 人工评估。配置面向兼容 OpenAI 接口的 GPT-4o 端点，温度为 0，并固定 LangChain 0.1 与 Chroma 依赖版本。本次未运行代码、调用 API 或复现实验。

title: Large Language Models for Code Analysis: Do LLMs Really Do Their Job?
title_zh: 面向代码分析的大语言模型：LLM 真的胜任吗？
date_basis: Publication month in the official USENIX proceedings BibTeX; the August 14–16, 2024 symposium dates are not used to assert a publication day.
date_basis_zh: 采用 USENIX 官方论文集 BibTeX 中的出版月份，不以 2024 年 8 月 14–16 日的会议日期推定具体出版日。
description_en: Evaluates GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4, LLaMA-2-13B, Code-LLaMA-2-13B-Instruct and StarChat-Beta on explaining what de-commented JavaScript, Python and C code does, then repeats the task on JavaScript obfuscated with JavaScript Obfuscator (identifier renaming, dead-code injection, control-flow flattening and string splitting) and with Wobfuscator’s WebAssembly transformation. GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 are also asked to rewrite 100 IOCCC winning programs as readable, compilable code. Case studies apply GPT models to a botnet and a benign browser-extension repository, an Android SMS stealer decompiled with JD-GUI, and WannaCry code decompiled with RetDec.
description_zh: 评估 GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4、LLaMA-2-13B、Code-LLaMA-2-13B-Instruct 与 StarChat-Beta 解释已去除注释的 JavaScript、Python 和 C 代码功能的能力，再在经 JavaScript Obfuscator（标识符重命名、死代码注入、控制流平坦化与字符串拆分）及 Wobfuscator WebAssembly 变换混淆的 JavaScript 上重复该任务。研究还要求 GPT-3.5 与 GPT-4 将 100 个 IOCCC 获奖程序改写为可读、可编译的代码。案例研究将 GPT 模型用于一个僵尸网络仓库与一个正常浏览器扩展仓库、经 JD-GUI 反编译的 Android 短信窃取程序，以及经 RetDec 反编译的 WannaCry 代码。
scope_limitations_en: Ground truth is GPT-4’s own explanations after manual checking by four students; other models are scored against those texts with similarity metrics and a GPT-4 judge, which the authors say is unreliable without manual calibration. Correctness is judged at explanation level, not by recovered behavior or executable equivalence. Only JavaScript is obfuscated with generated transformations; neither GPT model deciphered the WebAssembly that Wobfuscator inserts, and the smaller models produced no meaningful explanations once obfuscation was applied. Author-reported figures include 97.4% GPT-4 accuracy on non-obfuscated code and 87% on obfuscated JavaScript; in IOCCC de-obfuscation, about 20% of GPT-3.5’s targets and 19% of GPT-4’s yielded compilable code, and only 8% and 4% produced correct results. The malware analyses are qualitative case studies on a few samples, with manual chunking for WannaCry, missed behavior when context was split, and a false alarm in the botnet repository. Models recognized code from popular repositories, so memorization is a confound. The evaluated GPT-3.5/GPT-4-era and LLaMA-2-13B-class models are dated. The study analyzes source or already-decompiled text; it does not perform binary decompilation.
scope_limitations_zh: 真实标签是 GPT-4 自身生成、经四名学生人工核查的解释；其他模型则通过相似度指标与 GPT-4 评判与这些文本比较，作者也指出该评判方法若无人工校准并不可靠。正确性在解释层面判断，并非依据恢复出的行为或可执行等价性。只有 JavaScript 经过工具生成的混淆变换；两个 GPT 模型都未能解读 Wobfuscator 插入的 WebAssembly，较小模型在施加混淆后则无法给出有意义的解释。作者报告 GPT-4 在未混淆代码上的准确率为 97.4%，在混淆 JavaScript 上为 87%；在 IOCCC 去混淆任务中，GPT-3.5 约 20%、GPT-4 19% 的目标得到可编译代码，最终仅分别有 8% 和 4% 产生正确结果。恶意软件分析是针对少量样本的定性案例研究：WannaCry 需人工分块输入，上下文被拆分时会漏掉行为，僵尸网络仓库中还出现误报。模型能认出来自热门仓库的代码，因此记忆效应是混杂因素。被评测的 GPT-3.5／GPT-4 时代模型及 LLaMA-2-13B 级别模型已经过时。研究分析的是源码或已反编译的文本，并不执行二进制反编译。
why_fits_en: Measures how far LLM explanations survive JavaScript obfuscation and decompiler output, complementing JavaScript deobfuscation benchmarks and tools in the collection.
why_fits_zh: 衡量 LLM 的代码解释在 JavaScript 混淆和反编译器输出下还能保持多少可靠性，与合集中的 JavaScript 去混淆基准和工具互补。
metadata_notes: USENIX publishes no DOI for the paper; the arXiv identifier is recorded, and the final PDF name usenixsecurity24-fang.pdf does not use the secYY publisher profile. The USENIX page, its BibTeX and the final PDF agree on the 11-author order, the single-name author Asmita, pages 829–846 and ISBN 978-1-939133-44-1; the page also lists a prepublication PDF. arXiv v2 (2024-03-05) carries the comment “Accepted by Usenix Security 2024”. The paper names the online appendix; at the reviewed 2024-08-28 commit it holds dataset, result and case-study folders and declares no license, and its samples include third-party code that keeps its own terms. The appendix is recorded as the project link rather than as code. Model versions beyond family names are not specified in the paper. The appendix contents and malware samples were not downloaded, and no experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: USENIX 未为该论文提供 DOI；本条目记录 arXiv 标识符，最终 PDF 文件名 usenixsecurity24-fang.pdf 也不符合 secYY 出版方规则。USENIX 页面、其 BibTeX 与最终 PDF 一致给出 11 位作者顺序、单名作者 Asmita、第 829–846 页及 ISBN 978-1-939133-44-1；页面还提供一份预发表 PDF。arXiv v2（2024-03-05）备注为“Accepted by Usenix Security 2024”。论文点名了在线附录；在所审阅的 2024-08-28 提交中，附录包含数据集、结果与案例研究目录，但未声明许可证，其中的样本包括保留各自条款的第三方代码。该附录作为项目链接记录，而非代码。论文除模型家族名称外未说明具体模型版本。本次未下载附录内容或恶意软件样本，也未运行实验。

title: Beyond Classification: Inferring Function Names in Stripped Binaries via Domain Adapted LLMs
title_zh: 超越分类：借助领域适配的大语言模型推断去符号二进制中的函数名
date_basis: The official NDSS paper and the Internet Society’s Crossref deposit establish publication year 2025. The February 24–28 symposium dates are not used as a publication day.
date_basis_zh: NDSS 官方论文与 Internet Society 提交的 Crossref 元数据确认出版年份为 2025；不以 2 月 24—28 日的研讨会日期作为出版日。

citation.container_title: Proceedings 2025 Network and Distributed System Security Symposium

description_en: SymGen infers function names for stripped binaries by generating them with a LoRA-fine-tuned Code Llama model instead of classifying over a fixed name vocabulary. Ghidra decompiles each stripped function, its own name is masked, and callee names are normalized for deduplication. Before fine-tuning, the model is domain-adapted on decompiled code paired with LLM-generated summaries of the matching source functions. On functions from 33 C projects built for x86-64, x86-32, ARM and MIPS at O0–O3, deduplicated from 2,237,915 to 495,494, the authors report average word-level F1 of 0.277 (0.380 on x86-64), plus case studies on obfuscated binaries and Linux malware.
description_zh: SymGen 使用经 LoRA 微调的 Code Llama 模型生成去符号二进制的函数名，而不是在固定的名称词表上分类。每个去符号函数先由 Ghidra 反编译，再屏蔽其自身名称，并对被调用函数名进行归一化以便去重。微调之前，模型先以反编译代码及其对应源函数的大语言模型生成摘要进行领域适配。在 33 个 C 项目针对 x86-64、x86-32、ARM 和 MIPS 架构及 O0–O3 优化级别构建的函数上（经去重由 2,237,915 个减至 495,494 个），作者报告词级平均 F1 为 0.277（x86-64 上为 0.380），并给出混淆二进制与 Linux 恶意软件的案例研究。
scope_limitations_en: Names are split into words and scored with precision, recall and F1, with SymLM’s CodeWordNet grouping similar words; predictions are descriptive guesses, not recovered original symbols. Average F1 is 0.277 and lower on MIPS (0.137) and ARM (0.262). The gains of up to 409.3%, 553.5% and 489.4% in the abstract are author-reported relative improvements over AsmDepictor; the baselines were retrained on the authors’ deduplicated dataset, where they score far below their own papers, and XFL was compared on x86-64 only. A separate model is trained for each architecture and optimization level. All binaries were built with GCC 9.4.0, inputs depend on Ghidra output, and Code Llama’s closed pretraining data leaves leakage possible. Obfuscation tests apply three default Hikari passes to 363 binaries from six projects (F1 0.271–0.303); the malware study covers 812 functions in 16 x86-64 builds (F1 0.348).
scope_limitations_zh: 函数名被拆分为单词，并以精确率、召回率和 F1 评分，同时使用 SymLM 的 CodeWordNet 归并语义相近的词；预测结果是描述性的推测，并非恢复的原始符号。平均 F1 为 0.277，在 MIPS（0.137）和 ARM（0.262）上更低。摘要中最高 409.3%、553.5% 与 489.4% 的提升是作者报告的相对 AsmDepictor 的改进；各基线在作者去重后的数据集上重新训练，得分远低于其原论文结果，XFL 仅在 x86-64 上比较。每种架构和优化级别分别训练一个模型。所有二进制均由 GCC 9.4.0 构建，输入依赖 Ghidra 输出，且 Code Llama 的预训练数据未公开，仍可能存在数据泄漏。混淆测试对来自六个项目的 363 个二进制应用 Hikari 的三种默认混淆（F1 为 0.271–0.303）；恶意软件研究涵盖 16 个 x86-64 构建中的 812 个函数（F1 为 0.348）。
why_fits_en: Adds generative LLM-based function-name inference for stripped binaries with explicit deduplication, complementing classification-based function naming and variable, type and data-structure recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充采用显式去重、基于生成式大语言模型的去符号二进制函数名推断方法，与基于分类的函数命名及变量、类型和数据结构恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: The NDSS page, final PDF and Crossref agree on the title, three-author order and DOI; Crossref lists no pages. The PDF marks Linxi Jiang and Xin Jin as equal-contribution first authors. SymGen is the system name and is not part of the title; an arXiv title search found no preprint. The paper links the reviewed 2025-06-05 repository snapshot, which provides Ghidra decompilation, data-processing, summary-generation, alpaca-lora-based fine-tuning, prediction and evaluation scripts, a sample dataset and a 39 MB LoRA adapter (r=8) for codellama/CodeLlama-34b-Instruct-hf; base weights are not included and keep their own terms. The paper reports about 37 hours of LoRA training on one 80 GB A100. The README uses a Python 3.9 conda environment with largely unpinned requirements, including peft installed from Git. It links Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.15530083 (about 7.5 GB of source projects, binaries and decompiled data; CC BY 4.0 in its metadata), whose third-party projects keep their own licenses. The README states Apache License 2.0 and LICENSE contains Apache 2.0 text after an OSU copyright header, but GitHub reports NOASSERTION; this record does not resolve that discrepancy. No code, models or datasets were run or downloaded.
metadata_notes_zh: NDSS 页面、最终 PDF 与 Crossref 的标题、三位作者顺序和 DOI 一致；Crossref 未列出页码。PDF 注明 Linxi Jiang 与 Xin Jin 为同等贡献的第一作者。SymGen 是系统名称，并不属于论文标题；按标题检索 arXiv 未发现预印本。论文链接的仓库按 2025-06-05 快照审阅，提供 Ghidra 反编译、数据处理、摘要生成、基于 alpaca-lora 的微调、预测与评估脚本，一份样例数据集，以及面向 codellama/CodeLlama-34b-Instruct-hf 的 39 MB LoRA 适配器（r=8）；不含基础模型权重，其权重适用各自条款。论文报告在一块 80 GB A100 上进行 LoRA 训练约需 37 小时。README 使用 Python 3.9 conda 环境，依赖大多未固定版本，其中 peft 从 Git 安装。README 链接 Zenodo 记录 10.5281/zenodo.15530083（约 7.5 GB，含源项目、二进制与反编译数据；元数据标注 CC BY 4.0），其中第三方项目保留各自许可证。README 声明采用 Apache License 2.0，LICENSE 文件在 OSU 版权声明之后包含 Apache 2.0 文本，但 GitHub 报告为 NOASSERTION；本条目不对这一差异作出判断。本次未运行或下载代码、模型及数据集。

title: “Len or index or count, anything but v1”: Predicting Variable Names in Decompilation Output with Transfer Learning
title_zh: “len、index 或 count，就是别叫 v1”：基于迁移学习预测反编译输出中的变量名
date_basis: IEEE’s Crossref deposit and the proceedings title establish publication year 2024. Its published-print date, 2024-05-19, is the first day of the May 19–23 symposium, and the IEEE Xplore record could not be retrieved to confirm a separate publication date, so no day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: IEEE 提交的 Crossref 元数据及论文集名称确认出版年份为 2024。其 published／纸质出版日期 2024-05-19 恰为 5 月 19—23 日会议的首日，且未能获取 IEEE Xplore 记录以确认另有出版日期，因此本条目不推定具体日期。
description_en: VarBERT suggests variable names for IDA Hex-Rays and Ghidra decompiler output with a BERT-style model pre-trained on 5.2M human-written C functions from Debian and fine-tuned on decompiled code; it also predicts whether each variable came from the developer or was introduced by the decompiler. The authors build VarCorpus from Gentoo C and C++ packages compiled for x86-64 at O0–O3, labeling decompiled variables from debug symbols. On per-function splits of O2 binaries, top-1 accuracy is 54.43% for IDA and 54.49% for Ghidra; on an IDA-O0 subset it reaches 50.70%, against 35.94% for DIRE and 38.00% for DIRTY.
description_zh: VarBERT 使用 BERT 式模型为 IDA Hex-Rays 与 Ghidra 的反编译输出建议变量名：模型先以来自 Debian 的 520 万个人工编写的 C 函数预训练，再以反编译代码微调；它还预测每个变量出自开发者，还是由反编译器引入。作者从 Gentoo 的 C 与 C++ 软件包构建 VarCorpus，在 O0 至 O3 下编译为 x86-64，并借助调试符号为反编译变量标注名称。在 O2 二进制的按函数划分上，IDA 与 Ghidra 的 Top-1 准确率分别为 54.43% 和 54.49%；在 IDA-O0 子集上为 50.70%，DIRE 与 DIRTY 分别为 35.94% 和 38.00%。
scope_limitations_en: Predicted names are learned suggestions scored against developer names, not recovered originals. Top-1 accuracy drops to 42.40% (IDA) and 40.49% (Ghidra) on per-binary O2 splits, and the per-binary IDA-O0 lead over DIRTY is 4.52 points. The DIRE and DIRTY comparison covers IDA at O0 only, on about 400K functions (roughly 15% of VarCorpus), because DIRE's training time was prohibitive. The method can name only variables the decompiler recovers, and labeling relies on IDA and Ghidra preserving variables when matching debug symbols. Corpora come from Linux distribution packages, mainly x86-64 with a smaller AArch64 O2 experiment, and may not represent Windows or macOS executables; deduplication removes exact duplicates only. The user study had 27 students who completed 13 function pairs. Types, structures and recompilable code are outside its scope.
scope_limitations_zh: 预测名称是模型学到的建议，以开发者原名称评分，并非恢复出的原始符号。在 O2 的按二进制划分上，Top-1 准确率降至 42.40%（IDA）与 40.49%（Ghidra）；在 IDA-O0 的按二进制划分上，其领先 DIRTY 的幅度为 4.52 个百分点。与 DIRE、DIRTY 的比较仅覆盖 O0 下的 IDA，并因 DIRE 训练耗时过长而只使用约 40 万个函数（约占 VarCorpus 的 15%）。方法只能为反编译器恢复出的变量命名，标注则依赖 IDA 与 Ghidra 在匹配调试符号时保留变量。语料来自 Linux 发行版软件包，以 x86-64 为主，另有规模较小的 AArch64 O2 实验，可能不代表 Windows 或 macOS 可执行文件；去重仅删除完全重复项。用户研究由 27 名完成全部 13 组函数的学生参与。类型、数据结构与可重新编译的代码不在其范围内。
why_fits_en: Adds transfer-learning variable-name prediction across two decompilers and four optimization levels, with a dataset that addresses train–test overlap in earlier naming benchmarks.
why_fits_zh: 补充跨两种反编译器与四种优化级别的迁移学习变量名预测方法，并提供一个针对早期命名基准训练集与测试集重叠问题的数据集。
metadata_notes: Crossref gives the 13 authors in this order and pages 4069–4087 of the 2024 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy; the DOI resolves to IEEE Xplore document 10646727, whose page could not be retrieved during review. The title follows the paper's curly quotation marks; Crossref stores straight quotes. The 19-page author-hosted PDF, linked from the repository, lacks IEEE pagination and includes the program committee's meta-review. No arXiv version was found. The paper used IDA Pro 7.6, Ghidra 10.4, PyTorch 1.9.0, Transformers 4.10.0 and FairSeq 0.10.0. The reviewed 2025-12-17 repository commit has no license file, so no open license is asserted; its README lists Python 3.8+, Java 11 for Joern and Java 17+ for Ghidra 10.4, requirements.txt leaves torch and transformers unpinned, the Dockerfile (Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11) fetches a modified Joern from Dropbox, and the README serves the HSC and VarCorpus data, Gentoo binaries and 16 fine-tuned models from Dropbox. Inference is offered through the separate binsync/varbert_api library and the DAILA plugin. No data or models were downloaded and no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 按此顺序列出 13 位作者，并给出 2024 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 第 4069–4087 页；DOI 指向 IEEE Xplore 文档 10646727，审阅时未能获取该页面。标题沿用论文中的弯引号，Crossref 记录的是直引号。仓库链接的 19 页作者自存 PDF 没有 IEEE 页码，并附有程序委员会的元评审。未找到 arXiv 版本。论文使用 IDA Pro 7.6、Ghidra 10.4、PyTorch 1.9.0、Transformers 4.10.0 与 FairSeq 0.10.0。所审阅的 2025-12-17 仓库提交没有许可证文件，因此本条不认定开放许可；其 README 要求 Python 3.8+、供 Joern 使用的 Java 11 和供 Ghidra 10.4 使用的 Java 17+；requirements.txt 未固定 torch 与 transformers 版本，Dockerfile（Ubuntu 22.04、Python 3.11）会从 Dropbox 下载修改版 Joern；README 还通过 Dropbox 提供 HSC 与 VarCorpus 数据、Gentoo 二进制文件及 16 个微调模型。推理功能由独立的 binsync/varbert_api 库与 DAILA 插件提供。本次未下载数据或模型，也未运行代码或实验。

title: WebCode2M: A Real-World Dataset for Code Generation from Webpage Designs
title_zh: WebCode2M：面向网页设计稿代码生成的真实世界数据集
date_basis: The ACM article page and ACM-deposited Crossref metadata agree on publication on 2025-04-22; the April 28–May 2 conference dates are not used as the publication date.
date_basis_zh: ACM 文章页面与 ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据均将出版日期记为 2025-04-22；本条目不以 4 月 28 日至 5 月 2 日的会议日期作为出版日期。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the ACM on Web Conference 2025

description_en: WebCode2M pairs about 2.56 million real-world webpage screenshots with purified HTML/CSS code and element bounding-box layout trees. Pages sampled from a Common Crawl snapshot are cleaned (scripts, metadata and hidden elements removed, styles merged into one block), rendered with Playwright, and filtered by a neural scorer trained on 10,000 annotated samples. The paper fine-tunes Pix2Struct-1.3B as the WebCoder baseline, introduces TreeBLEU to measure DOM-structure recall, and benchmarks specialized, open and commercial multimodal models on short, medium and long test subsets of 256 pages each.
description_zh: WebCode2M 将约 256 万张真实网页截图与净化后的 HTML/CSS 代码及元素边界框布局树配对。数据取样自 Common Crawl 快照，经清洗（移除脚本、元数据与隐藏元素，并将样式合并为单一样式块）后用 Playwright 渲染，再由基于 10,000 条人工标注样本训练的神经评分器筛选。论文以 Pix2Struct-1.3B 微调出基线模型 WebCoder，提出衡量 DOM 结构召回率的 TreeBLEU 指标，并在短、中、长三个各含 256 个网页的测试子集上评测专用、开源及商业多模态模型。
scope_limitations_en: The task is static HTML/CSS generation from a design image. Scripts are stripped during purification, so interaction, client-side behavior and backend logic are not reconstructed, and outputs are judged by visual score, CLIP similarity and TreeBLEU rather than functional equivalence. The paper reports that no evaluated model reproduces image elements accurately, and scores fall as target code grows longer. The 768 test pages were drawn from high-scoring candidates and manually inspected; the scorer is about 90% accurate, so low-quality training samples remain, and the authors warn that crawled content may still include inappropriate material. Commercial models are named only by family, and about one-third of Gemini test cases failed with recitation errors, so those comparisons are snapshots. The dataset card's CC BY 4.0 license does not clear rights in the crawled pages' code, text or images.
scope_limitations_zh: 任务是根据设计图生成静态 HTML/CSS。净化过程会移除脚本，因此不重建交互、客户端行为或后端逻辑；输出以视觉得分、CLIP 相似度和 TreeBLEU 评判，而非功能等价性。论文报告，所有被评测模型都无法准确还原图像元素，且目标代码越长得分越低。768 个测试网页取自高分候选并经人工检查；评分器准确率约为 90%，训练集中仍有低质量样本，作者也提醒爬取内容可能仍含不当材料。商业模型仅以模型家族命名，约三分之一的 Gemini 测试样例因 recitation 错误失败，因此相关比较只反映当时情况。数据集卡片声明的 CC BY 4.0 许可不能清除所爬取网页代码、文本或图片的权利。
why_fits_en: Adds a large real-world design-to-code training corpus with layout trees and a structure metric, complementing the smaller real-page and synthetic website-reconstruction benchmarks in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充带布局树和结构指标的大规模真实设计稿到代码训练语料，与本节中规模较小的真实网页基准及合成网站重建基准互补。
metadata_notes: arXiv v1 (2024-04-09) was titled “VISION2UI: A Real-World Dataset with Layout for Code Generation from UI Designs”; the reviewed v2 (2025-02-22, comment “WWW'25”) carries the final title and DOI. The ACM page and Crossref list Bohua Chen before Yi Su, while arXiv v2 lists Yi Su first; this record follows the publisher order. The project page links the paper, the naturalcc code directory and the Hugging Face dataset. The reviewed dataset-card revision f53cd4a (2025-03-05) declares CC BY 4.0, says the dataset is also called Vision2UI, warns of inappropriate content and points to a purified variant; its data directory is about 1.1 TB. The naturalcc repository declares MIT. Its webcode2m README still uses earlier names: the UICoder model and the vision2ui_test set, which now redirects to webcode2m_test. The environment file pins Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.1.2 and Transformers 4.33.1. No dataset, model or code was downloaded or run.
metadata_notes_zh: arXiv v1（2024-04-09）的标题为“VISION2UI: A Real-World Dataset with Layout for Code Generation from UI Designs”；所审阅的 v2（2025-02-22，备注“WWW'25”）采用最终标题并载有 DOI。ACM 页面与 Crossref 将 Bohua Chen 列于 Yi Su 之前，而 arXiv v2 将 Yi Su 列前；本条目遵循出版方顺序。项目页面链接论文、naturalcc 代码目录及 Hugging Face 数据集。所审阅的数据集卡片修订版 f53cd4a（2025-03-05）声明 CC BY 4.0，说明该数据集也称 Vision2UI，提醒可能含不当内容，并指向一个净化版本；其数据目录约 1.1 TB。naturalcc 仓库声明 MIT 许可。其 webcode2m README 仍使用早期名称：UICoder 模型与 vision2ui_test 测试集，后者现已重定向至 webcode2m_test。环境文件固定 Python 3.10、PyTorch 2.1.2 与 Transformers 4.33.1。本次未下载或运行数据集、模型或代码。

title: SoK: AI-Augmented Binary Reversing
title_zh: SoK：人工智能增强的二进制逆向工程
date_basis: arXiv v1 submission; the reviewed v2 revision of 2026-09-04 does not change the first-submission date.
date_basis_zh: arXiv v1 首次提交日期；所审阅的 2026-09-04 v2 修订版不改变首次提交日期。
description_en: A systematization-of-knowledge survey of machine-learning, LLM and agentic approaches to binary reversing. Version 2 collects 246 papers published since 2015, found through keyword searches of 11 security, software-engineering and AI venues plus citation snowballing, and organizes them into 22 domains by inference task: from code-boundary detection and recovery of function names, types and struct layouts to code similarity, malware and vulnerability analysis, and decompilation. Its taxonomy links conventional triage, static, dynamic and security-testing analyses to AI pipelines through the binary-derived artifacts they exchange, and it derives 12 insights and open directions such as binary-aligned ground truth and goal-driven agentic reversing.
description_zh: 一篇系统化知识综述，梳理机器学习、大语言模型与智能体方法在二进制逆向中的应用。第二版通过关键词检索 11 个安全、软件工程与人工智能会议并辅以引文滚雪球，收集 2015 年以来的 246 篇论文，按推断任务归入 22 个领域：从代码边界检测，到函数名、类型与结构体布局恢复，再到代码相似性、恶意软件与漏洞分析以及反编译。其分类体系通过二进制派生的分析产物，把传统的初筛、静态分析、动态分析与安全测试同人工智能流程联系起来，并总结出 12 条洞见及若干开放方向，例如与二进制对齐的语义真值和目标驱动的智能体逆向。
scope_limitations_en: A literature systematization with no new experiments, benchmark or tool; it classifies and summarizes reported results without reproducing them. The corpus covers papers available up to July 31, 2026, applies citation thresholds that fall from 12 for 2015–2016 papers to 2 for 2025–2026 papers, excludes methods that need source code at inference time, and leaves out Android and interpreted-language bytecode. Detailed per-stage tables draw on 88 top-venue studies rather than the full corpus. It is an arXiv preprint with no stated venue, and this record makes no claim of peer review. Papers it cites are not thereby part of this collection; each needs its own review.
scope_limitations_zh: 这是一篇文献系统化综述，不包含新的实验、基准或工具；它对已报告的结果进行分类和总结，并未复现。语料涵盖截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日可获得的论文，引用量门槛从 2015—2016 年论文的 12 次逐步降至 2025—2026 年论文的 2 次，排除推断时需要源码的方法，也不包括 Android 与解释型语言字节码。各阶段的详细表格基于 88 项顶级会议研究，而非完整语料。它是未注明发表场所的 arXiv 预印本，本条目不声称其经过同行评审。其引用的论文并不因此纳入本合集，每篇都需要单独审阅。
why_fits_en: Provides a structured map of ML, LLM and agent research across binary reversing tasks, helping place the collection’s binary-analysis papers and locate related work that still needs individual review.
why_fits_zh: 为跨二进制逆向任务的机器学习、大语言模型与智能体研究提供结构化地图，有助于定位本合集中的二进制分析论文，并找出仍需逐篇审阅的相关工作。
metadata_notes: Reviewed arXiv v2 (2026-09-04; comment “21 pages, 7 tables, 4 figures”), which lists five authors and 246 papers; this record follows the v2 author list. v1 (2026-06-16; “20 pages, 7 tables, 3 figures”) listed six authors, Yujeong Kwon, Yiyue Zhang, Shakhzod Yuldoshkhujaev, Kexin Pei, Dokyung Song and Hyungjoon Koo, and analyzed 144 papers published between 2015 and 2025. Neither version states a venue or journal reference. Footnote 1 in both versions links the companion site, an interactive JavaScript table of the surveyed papers grouped by domain with links to their publications; no source repository is linked, so code_url is null. The site and its paper list may change after this review. No experiments or site code were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 审阅 arXiv v2（2026-09-04；备注为“21 pages, 7 tables, 4 figures”），该版列出五位作者及 246 篇论文；本条目采用 v2 的作者列表。v1（2026-06-16；“20 pages, 7 tables, 3 figures”）列出六位作者：Yujeong Kwon、Yiyue Zhang、Shakhzod Yuldoshkhujaev、Kexin Pei、Dokyung Song 与 Hyungjoon Koo，并分析了 2015 至 2025 年发表的 144 篇论文。两个版本均未注明发表场所或期刊信息。两版的脚注 1 都链接到配套网站，这是一个按领域分组列出所综述论文并链接其出版页面的交互式 JavaScript 表格；未链接源码仓库，因此 code_url 为空。网站及其论文列表可能在本次审阅后变化。本次未运行任何实验或网站代码。

title: Beyond the C: Retargetable Decompilation using Neural Machine Translation
title_zh: 超越 C：基于神经机器翻译的可重定向反编译
date_basis: Internet Society-deposited Crossref metadata supplies only publication year 2022; the publisher PDF separately identifies the 24 April 2022 workshop, which is not used to assert a publication month or day.
date_basis_zh: Internet Society 向 Crossref 提交的元数据仅给出出版年份 2022；出版方 PDF 另列研讨会日期为 2022 年 4 月 24 日，本条目不据此推定出版月份或日期。
description_en: BTC (Beyond The C) treats decompilation as plain-text translation from compiler-emitted x86-64 assembly to source code. It uses byte-pair-encoding tokenizers trained separately on assembly and source, and a standard fairseq transformer. Function pairs are matched through the compiler's CFI and line directives rather than language-specific parsers, compiler plugins or lifters, so the same pipeline is retrained for Go, Fortran, OCaml and C. Training sets range from about 10,000 functions for small C, Go and Fortran corpora to 2 million C functions built from Debian packages. The best model, trained on the large C set, reaches a normalized average edit distance of 0.46 on held-out functions.
description_zh: BTC（Beyond The C）将反编译视为从编译器输出的 x86-64 汇编到源码的纯文本翻译，分别在汇编与源码上训练字节对编码分词器，并使用标准 fairseq Transformer。它借助编译器输出的 CFI 与行号指令配对函数，而非依赖特定语言的解析器、编译器插件或提升器，因此同一流程可针对 Go、Fortran、OCaml 与 C 重新训练。训练集规模从小型 C、Go 与 Fortran 语料的约 10,000 个函数，到基于 Debian 软件包构建的 200 万个 C 函数不等。在大型 C 数据集上训练的最佳模型，在留出函数上的归一化平均编辑距离为 0.46。
scope_limitations_en: Evaluation covers four languages at function level and scores outputs only by normalized edit distance to the original source. No compilation, test-based or semantic-equivalence check is reported, and whole-program decompilation is not evaluated. The authors state that the method cannot guarantee semantic correctness and is not yet ready for practical use on real code: even the best score means changes to roughly half of a function's tokens. Input is compiler-produced x86-64 assembly with labels and CFI directives intact, so disassembly of stripped binaries, other architectures and compilers without such directives are outside the evaluation. Sequence-length limits exclude long functions, and the small corpora are mostly competitive-programming and small utility code. The comparison with Katz et al. cites that work's reported score on shorter snippets rather than rerunning it on the same data.
scope_limitations_zh: 评测在函数层面覆盖四种语言，仅以与原始源码的归一化编辑距离评分；未报告编译、测试或语义等价检查，也未评估完整程序的反编译。作者指出该方法无法保证语义正确，尚不能用于真实代码：即便最佳分数也意味着大约一半的函数词元需要修改。输入是保留标签与 CFI 指令的编译器生成 x86-64 汇编，因此对去符号二进制的反汇编、其他架构以及不输出此类指令的编译器均不在评测范围内。序列长度限制排除了较长函数，小型语料主要来自编程竞赛题和小型工具代码。与 Katz 等人的比较引用的是该工作在更短代码片段上报告的分数，而非在相同数据上重新运行。
why_fits_en: Adds neural decompilation evaluated beyond C, in Go, Fortran and OCaml, with a language-agnostic data pipeline, complementing the C-focused neural and LLM decompilation research in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充在 C 之外的 Go、Fortran 与 OCaml 上评测、并采用语言无关数据流程的神经反编译研究，与本节中聚焦 C 语言的神经网络及大语言模型反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: The NDSS paper page lists Iman Hosseini and Brendan Dolan-Gavitt (NYU) and links the PDF and slides; Crossref gives the same two authors and only the year 2022. The PDF footer gives BAR 2022, 24 April 2022, San Diego, with ISBN 1-891562-76-2 and the DOI. arXiv v1 (2022-12-17), the only version, was posted after the workshop and links the BAR DOI. The paper's Availability section gives the figshare link for code, data and trained models. It is a private-share link: a scripted request received an HTTP 202 challenge, while a browser showed an item titled “Beyond the C - data & code”, marked as privately shared, CC BY 4.0, modified 2022-01-04, with btc.zip (18.98 GB) and additional.zip. The archives were not downloaded or inspected, and the promised VS Code extension was not located. Nothing was run.
metadata_notes_zh: NDSS 论文页面列出 Iman Hosseini 与 Brendan Dolan-Gavitt（纽约大学），并链接 PDF 与演示幻灯片；Crossref 给出相同的两位作者，仅记载年份 2022。PDF 页脚标明 BAR 2022 于 2022 年 4 月 24 日在圣迭戈举行，并载有 ISBN 1-891562-76-2 与 DOI。arXiv v1（2022-12-17）是唯一版本，发布于研讨会之后，并链接 BAR DOI。论文的可用性章节给出存放代码、数据与训练模型的 figshare 链接。该链接为私有分享链接：脚本请求收到 HTTP 202 质询，而浏览器显示一个名为“Beyond the C - data & code”的条目，标注为私有分享、CC BY 4.0、修改于 2022-01-04，含 btc.zip（18.98 GB）与 additional.zip。本次未下载或检查这些压缩包，也未找到论文提及的 VS Code 扩展。本次未运行任何内容。

title: ExeBench: an ML-scale dataset of executable C functions
title_zh: ExeBench：机器学习规模的可执行 C 函数数据集
date_basis: The ACM article page and ACM’s Crossref deposit both give publication on 2022-06-13, which is also the day of the MAPS ’22 symposium. The date follows the publisher’s stated publication date, not the event schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 文章页面与 ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据均将出版日期列为 2022-06-13，这一天也是 MAPS ’22 研讨会的举办日。本条目采用出版方标明的出版日期，而非依据会议日程推定。
description_en: ExeBench is a dataset, not a decompiler. It extracts C functions from GitHub and AnghaBench, makes them compilable by locating real headers and definitions or injecting synthetic ones, and generates input/output examples from function signatures with a C++ wrapper that runs each function. After exact deduplication the authors report 4,485,817 compilable and 687,843 executable functions, of which 124,612 have rich IO that a constant or identity implementation cannot pass; the paper also describes x86 and ARM assembly at O0, Os and Ofast for each row. Decompilation studies such as SLaDe and LLM4Decompile later used it to test whether decompiled functions re-execute correctly.
description_zh: ExeBench 是数据集，而非反编译器。它从 GitHub 与 AnghaBench 中提取 C 函数，通过查找真实的头文件与定义或注入合成定义使其可编译，再依据函数签名生成输入／输出样例，并以 C++ 包装器运行每个函数。精确去重后，作者报告共有 4,485,817 个可编译函数和 687,843 个可执行函数，其中 124,612 个带有常量或恒等实现无法通过的丰富 IO；论文还说明每行数据附有 O0、Os 与 Ofast 下的 x86 和 ARM 汇编。SLaDe、LLM4Decompile 等反编译研究随后用它检验反编译函数能否正确重新执行。
scope_limitations_en: IO is generated from signatures without program context: 10 pairs per function (30 across three seeds of synthetic definitions), arrays default to 32 elements, and success falls below 5% for functions with pointer–integer conversions and stays low for goto, labels and complex control flow, so executable functions skew simpler than the compilable population. Synthetic IO is produced with injected stand-in definitions rather than the functions’ real dependencies; only 4,464 functions have rich IO with real definitions. Finite IO pairs test behavior on sampled inputs, not semantic equivalence, and deduplication removes exact matches after tokenization only. Running functions with real dependencies executes untrusted code; the authors used restricted containers. The paper’s exact v1.00 data is available only on request, while the public v1.01 release has revised splits (for example 2,134 instead of 2,232 real test functions). Each function keeps its source repository’s license; ExeBench additions are MIT.
scope_limitations_zh: IO 依据函数签名生成，不考虑程序上下文：每个函数 10 对（合成定义使用三个随机种子，共 30 对），数组默认长度为 32；含指针与整数互转的函数生成成功率低于 5%，含 goto、标签及复杂控制流的函数成功率也较低，因此可执行函数整体比可编译函数更简单。合成 IO 基于注入的替代定义，而非函数的真实依赖生成；带有真实定义且具备丰富 IO 的函数仅有 4,464 个。有限的 IO 对只检验采样输入上的行为，并不证明语义等价；去重也只删除分词后完全相同的函数。运行带真实依赖的函数意味着执行不受信任的代码，作者使用了权限受限的容器。论文所用的 v1.00 原始数据仅可申请获取，公开的 v1.01 版本调整了数据划分（例如真实测试函数为 2,134 个，而非 2,232 个）。每个函数保留其来源仓库的许可证，ExeBench 新增内容采用 MIT 许可。
why_fits_en: Adds the executable C-function benchmark behind several decompilation papers in this section, so readers can check its construction, IO limits and version differences directly.
why_fits_zh: 补充本节多篇反编译论文所依赖的可执行 C 函数基准，便于读者直接核查其构建方式、IO 局限与版本差异。
metadata_notes: ACM metadata in Crossref and on the article page gives the sentence-case title and pages 50–59 of the Proceedings of the 6th ACM SIGPLAN International Symposium on Machine Programming; the 10-page PDF capitalises it as 'ExeBench: An ML-Scale Dataset of Executable C Functions'. No arXiv version was found. The live ACM pages served a browser check to plain HTTP clients and were read through a browser session; the article page marks the full text world-readable, while the PDF's 2022 notice licenses publication rights to ACM, so no open content license is asserted for the paper. The reviewed 2022-09-15 repository commit has no LICENSE file; its README assigns each C function its source repository's license and releases IO examples and wrappers under MIT. Its helper compiles a function's assembly with the C++ wrapper using g++ -O0 and runs it as a host subprocess without its own sandbox. Hugging Face revision 093085f (2023-03-09) hosts v1.01 as zstandard JSON-lines TAR archives with no license tag in the card metadata; the v1.00 dataset jordiae/exebench_legacy requires contacting the authors. No data was downloaded and no code was run.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 与文章页面中的 ACM 元数据给出句首大写形式的标题，以及 Proceedings of the 6th ACM SIGPLAN International Symposium on Machine Programming 第 50–59 页；10 页的 PDF 将标题写作“ExeBench: An ML-Scale Dataset of Executable C Functions”。未找到 arXiv 版本。ACM 实时页面对普通 HTTP 客户端显示浏览器验证，本次通过浏览器会话阅读；文章页面将全文标记为公开可读，但 PDF 中的 2022 年声明将出版权授予 ACM，因此本条不认定论文采用开放内容许可。所审阅的 2022-09-15 仓库提交没有 LICENSE 文件；其 README 说明每个 C 函数沿用来源仓库的许可证，IO 样例与包装器以 MIT 发布。仓库辅助代码使用 g++ -O0 将函数汇编与 C++ 包装器一同编译，并作为宿主机子进程直接运行，本身不提供沙箱。Hugging Face 修订版 093085f（2023-03-09）以 zstandard 压缩的 JSON Lines TAR 包托管 v1.01，数据卡元数据中没有许可证标签；v1.00 数据集 jordiae/exebench_legacy 需联系作者获取。本次未下载数据，也未运行代码。

title: XFL: Naming Functions in Binaries with Extreme Multi-label Learning
title_zh: XFL：基于极端多标签学习的二进制函数命名
date_basis: IEEE Xplore and the publisher’s Crossref deposit both record publication in May 2023; IEEE added the article to Xplore on 21 July 2023. No publication day is asserted.
date_basis_zh: IEEE Xplore 与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据均记录出版时间为 2023 年 5 月；IEEE 于 2023 年 7 月 21 日将文章加入 Xplore。本条目不认定具体出版日。

citation.container_title: 2023 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy (SP)

description_en: XFL treats function naming in stripped binaries as extreme multi-label classification: names are split into tokens, and PfastreXML ranks which tokens from a vocabulary of frequent labels fit each function. Its DEXTER embedding combines static-analysis features built on angr’s VEX IR with call-graph and whole-binary context, and a separate language model orders predicted tokens into a name string. On 741,724 functions from 10,047 x86-64 C binaries in Debian packages, with a 1,024-label vocabulary, the authors report precision 0.835, recall 0.575 and F1 0.681, ahead of Punstrip, Debin and Nero in precision and F1.
description_zh: XFL 将去符号二进制中的函数命名视为极端多标签分类：函数名被拆分为词元，再由 PfastreXML 从常见标签词表中为每个函数排序合适的词元。其 DEXTER 嵌入结合基于 angr VEX 中间表示的静态分析特征、调用图上下文和整个二进制的全局上下文，另有一个语言模型把预测的词元排列成函数名字符串。在来自 Debian 软件包、共 10,047 个 x86-64 C 二进制中的 741,724 个函数上，以 1,024 个标签的词表，作者报告精确率 0.835、召回率 0.575、F1 0.681，在精确率和 F1 上领先 Punstrip、Debin 与 Nero。
scope_limitations_en: Predictions are token labels from a fixed vocabulary, ranked and optionally assembled into names; they are not recovered source names, and scoring matches tokens rather than exact names. Evaluation uses x86-64 ELF C binaries from Debian packages, built with mixed compilers and optimization settings, plus Nero’s smaller dataset; the trained model is specific to x86-64 GNU/Linux binaries. All tools receive function boundaries from symbol tables at test time, so boundary-detection errors are excluded. Many test names also occur in training; restricted to names never seen in training, F1 falls to 0.242. Obfuscated and adversarial binaries are out of scope. Debin and Dire figures on the Nero dataset are copied from the Nero paper rather than rerun.
scope_limitations_zh: 预测结果是固定词表中的词元标签，经排序后可选地组合成名称；它们并非恢复的源码名称，评分也按词元而非完整名称匹配。评测使用来自 Debian 软件包、以多种编译器与优化设置构建的 x86-64 ELF C 二进制，以及规模较小的 Nero 数据集；训练所得模型仅适用于 x86-64 GNU/Linux 二进制。测试时所有工具均从符号表获取函数边界，因此不计入边界检测错误。许多测试函数名也出现在训练集中；仅考察训练中从未出现的名称时，F1 降至 0.242。混淆和对抗性二进制不在研究范围内。Nero 数据集上 Debin 与 Dire 的数据取自 Nero 论文，并未重新运行。
why_fits_en: Adds function-name prediction for stripped binaries framed as multi-label learning over binary embeddings, complementing variable-name, type and data-structure recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充以二进制嵌入上的多标签学习预测去符号二进制函数名的方法，与变量名、类型及数据结构恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: IEEE Xplore and Crossref agree on the title, three-author order, DOI, pages 2375–2390 and the May 2023 date.
