Reviewed arXiv v4 (2022-12-12; v1 2021-07-28), whose title and authors match; it was not compared page by page with the IEEE version. The paper’s code link github.com/unibw-patch/xfl now redirects to lmu-plai/xfl. The reviewed 2025-11-30 snapshot carries GPL-3.0 in COPYING. Its README describes xfl/ as partial original source with experiment data and logs and recommends the refactored xfl-r/ for comparisons; lm/ holds the name-generation language model. The README’s BibTeX lists pages 1677–1692 and DOI 10.1109/SP46215.2023.00096, which doi.org does not resolve, so this record uses the registered DOI. XFL-R setup requires Python 3.8, TensorFlow 2.13.1, PostgreSQL 13, radare2 5.5.4 and Ghidra 10.4, a PfastreXML build compiled from source downloaded separately, and a 46.9 GB Zenodo archive of models and tables (10.5281/zenodo.10733597) whose metadata names no license; pretrained DEXTER embeddings are linked from a separate download host. The paper reports about 850 GB of RAM for DEXTER training. Nothing was run or downloaded.
metadata_notes_zh: IEEE Xplore 与 Crossref 的标题、三位作者顺序、DOI、页码 2375–2390 及 2023 年 5 月日期一致。审阅 arXiv v4（2022-12-12；v1 为 2021-07-28），其标题与作者一致；未与 IEEE 版本逐页比对。论文中的代码链接 github.com/unibw-patch/xfl 现重定向至 lmu-plai/xfl。所审阅的 2025-11-30 快照在 COPYING 中采用 GPL-3.0。其 README 说明 xfl/ 是包含实验数据和日志的部分原始源码，并建议使用重构后的 xfl-r/ 进行比较；lm/ 包含生成函数名的语言模型。README 中的 BibTeX 列出页码 1677–1692 及 DOI 10.1109/SP46215.2023.00096，但 doi.org 无法解析该 DOI，因此本条目使用已注册的 DOI。XFL-R 的安装需要 Python 3.8、TensorFlow 2.13.1、PostgreSQL 13、radare2 5.5.4 与 Ghidra 10.4，需要从另行下载的源码编译 PfastreXML，还需要一个 46.9 GB 的 Zenodo 模型与数据表压缩包（10.5281/zenodo.10733597），其元数据未注明许可证；预训练 DEXTER 嵌入链接至另一个下载站点。论文报告训练 DEXTER 约需 850 GB 内存。本次未运行或下载任何内容。

title: WaDec: Decompiling WebAssembly Using Large Language Model
title_zh: WaDec：基于大语言模型的 WebAssembly 反编译
date_basis: ACM-deposited Crossref metadata gives print and online publication on 2024-10-27. That is also the first day of the October 27–November 1 conference; the date comes from the publisher record, not from the conference schedule.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2024-10-27。该日期恰为 10 月 27 日至 11 月 1 日会议的首日；本条目依据出版方记录，而非根据会议日程推定。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 39th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering

description_en: WaDec decompiles WebAssembly text (wat) into C by fine-tuning CodeLlama-7b with LoRA on loop-level wat–C snippet pairs. Functions are ordered by dependency and sliced so that each input holds at most one loop, with nested loops replaced by markers. Prompts add declarations of called functions, previously defined local variables and offset-to-string mappings; the outputs are then reassembled, with string constants restored and variables renamed. Training data come from 51,768 the-stack-dedup and 377 TheAlgorithms/C programs compiled with Emscripten. On 3,977 C files, the authors report 3.34% code inflation, 52.11% recompilability, 43.55% re-execution and 27.15% output consistency, compared with Wasm2c and Ghidra.
description_zh: WaDec 使用循环级 wat–C 代码片段对，以 LoRA 微调 CodeLlama-7b，将 WebAssembly 文本格式（wat）反编译为 C。它按依赖关系排列函数并进行切片，使每个输入至多包含一个循环，嵌套循环以标记替代。提示中补充被调用函数的声明、此前已定义的局部变量以及偏移到字符串的映射；随后重组输出，恢复字符串常量并重命名变量。训练数据来自经 Emscripten 编译的 51,768 个 the-stack-dedup 程序和 377 个 TheAlgorithms/C 程序。作者在 3,977 个 C 文件上报告，代码膨胀率为 3.34%，可重新编译率为 52.11%，可重新执行率为 43.55%，输出一致率为 27.15%，并与 Wasm2c 及 Ghidra 进行比较。
scope_limitations_en: The reported rates are author results on C programs compiled to Wasm with Emscripten. About half of the outputs recompile, fewer than half re-execute and roughly a quarter reproduce the original output, so decompiled code is generally not semantically equivalent. The 3,977-file benchmark comes from the same two sources as the training programs. Optimized builds are not evaluated: the authors neither adapted the method to nor trained it on O1/O2 code. The model also handles data structures poorly, often flattening them into separate variables or arrays. Only C sources are studied; Wasm produced from other languages or toolchains is not evaluated. Baselines are Wasm2c and Ghidra's Wasm plugin, and LLM baselines were excluded because none could decompile Wasm functions without fine-tuning. Slicing means one function may be decompiled several times, at about 0.1 to 2 seconds per prompt.
scope_limitations_zh: 所报告的比率是作者在经 Emscripten 编译为 Wasm 的 C 程序上取得的结果。约一半输出可重新编译，不到一半可重新执行，约四分之一能复现原始输出，因此反编译代码总体上并不语义等价。含 3,977 个文件的基准与训练程序来自相同的两个来源。未评估优化构建：作者既未针对 O1/O2 代码调整方法，也未用其训练模型。模型处理数据结构的能力也较弱，常将其拆成独立变量或数组。研究仅涉及 C 源码，未评估由其他语言或工具链生成的 Wasm。基线为 Wasm2c 与 Ghidra 的 Wasm 插件；由于没有大语言模型能在未经微调时反编译 Wasm 函数，此类基线被排除。切片意味着一个函数可能需多次反编译，每个提示约需 0.1 至 2 秒。
why_fits_en: Adds LLM decompilation of WebAssembly with recompilation and re-execution checks, complementing the native-binary decompilation research in this section and the WebAssembly tools in the catalog.
why_fits_zh: 补充带重新编译与重新执行检查的大语言模型 WebAssembly 反编译方法，与本节中的原生二进制反编译研究及目录中的 WebAssembly 工具互补。
metadata_notes: ACM's Crossref deposit gives the three-author order, pages 481–492 and publication on 2024-10-27. The reviewed arXiv v3 (2024-09-11, comment “This paper was accepted by ASE 2024”) carries the ACM reference format and DOI; v1 dates from 2024-06-17. The paper's footnote names github.com/XinyuShe/WaDec as the replication artifact, while its reference list and the README's clone command still point to an anonymous review mirror. The reviewed 2024-07-24 snapshot contains dataset-construction notebooks, an evaluation JSON file and inference and metric scripts, but no license file or declaration, so no open license is inferred. The README lists only Python 3.x and Git as prerequisites. It points to the wadecc/FGW2C dataset (110,096 examples, no license declared) and the wadecc/Wat2c model, a LoRA adapter whose configuration names codellama/CodeLlama-7b-hf as its base, so the base model's own license also applies. No dataset, model or code was downloaded or run.
metadata_notes_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据给出三位作者的顺序、481–492 页码及 2024-10-27 出版日期。所审阅的 arXiv v3（2024-09-11，备注“This paper was accepted by ASE 2024”）载有 ACM 引用格式与 DOI；v1 发布于 2024-06-17。论文脚注将 github.com/XinyuShe/WaDec 列为复现产物，但其参考文献和 README 中的克隆命令仍指向匿名评审镜像。所审阅的 2024-07-24 快照包含数据集构建笔记本、一份评估 JSON 文件以及推断与指标脚本，但没有许可证文件或声明，因此不推定为开放许可。README 仅列出 Python 3.x 与 Git 作为前提条件，并指向 wadecc/FGW2C 数据集（110,096 条样本，未声明许可证）及 wadecc/Wat2c 模型；后者是 LoRA 适配器，其配置将 codellama/CodeLlama-7b-hf 列为基座模型，因此基座模型自身的许可证同样适用。本次未下载或运行数据集、模型或代码。

title: SymLM: Predicting Function Names in Stripped Binaries via Context-Sensitive Execution-Aware Code Embeddings
title_zh: SymLM：基于上下文敏感、执行感知代码嵌入的去符号二进制函数名预测
date_basis: The ACM article page and the publisher’s Crossref deposit both give publication on 2022-11-07, which is also the first day of the November 7–11 conference; the publisher-stated date is recorded.
date_basis_zh: ACM 文章页面与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据均将出版日期列为 2022-11-07，这也是 11 月 7—11 日会议的首日；本条目记录出版方给出的日期。

citation.container_title: Proceedings of the 2022 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

description_en: SymLM predicts function names for stripped binaries as sets of name words. It encodes each function’s instructions with a Trex model pretrained on micro-execution traces, fuses them with embeddings of callers, internal callees and external library calls taken from Ghidra’s interprocedural CFG, and scores words from a fixed vocabulary with an MLP decoder; name preprocessing and a word-embedding module, CodeWordNet, handle abbreviations and synonyms. On 1,431,169 functions from 16,027 binaries of 27 projects across x86, x64, ARM and MIPS, O0–O3 and four Hikari obfuscations, the authors report weighted average precision 0.634, recall 0.677 and F1 0.655, plus a firmware case study.
description_zh: SymLM 将去符号二进制的函数名预测为一组名称单词。它使用在微执行轨迹上预训练的 Trex 模型编码每个函数的指令，将其与取自 Ghidra 过程间控制流图的调用者、内部被调用函数及外部库调用的嵌入融合，再由 MLP 解码器对固定词表中的单词打分；名称预处理和词嵌入模块 CodeWordNet 用于处理缩写与同义词。在 27 个项目的 16,027 个二进制、共 1,431,169 个函数上（涵盖 x86、x64、ARM 与 MIPS，O0–O3 优化级别及四种 Hikari 混淆），作者报告加权平均精确率 0.634、召回率 0.677、F1 0.655，并给出固件案例研究。
scope_limitations_en: Names are predicted as unordered word sets from a fixed training vocabulary and scored with word-level precision, recall and F1, with CodeWordNet counting semantically similar words as matches. This is not exact source-name recovery, and out-of-vocabulary words cannot be produced. Binaries were built with GCC 7.5 for Linux and split by binary within the same 27 projects. On 540 binaries from 12 unseen projects, overall performance remains lower, which the authors partly attribute to vocabulary mismatch; a later NDSS 2025 comparison on deduplicated data reports SymLM’s average F1 at 0.105. NFRE comparisons are x64-only, and NERO comparisons use NERO’s dataset. Obfuscation covers four Hikari passes, not packing or encryption. In the firmware case study, 172 of 1,061 functions in eight 32-bit ARM firmware images received partially correct names.
scope_limitations_zh: 函数名被预测为来自固定训练词表的无序单词集合，并按单词级精确率、召回率和 F1 评分，CodeWordNet 会将语义相近的单词计为匹配。这并非精确恢复源码名称，且无法生成词表外的单词。二进制由 GCC 7.5 为 Linux 构建，并在同样的 27 个项目内按二进制划分数据集。在来自 12 个未见项目的 540 个二进制上，整体表现仍然较低，作者将部分原因归于词表不匹配；后来一项 NDSS 2025 研究在去重数据上比较时，报告 SymLM 的平均 F1 为 0.105。与 NFRE 的比较仅针对 x64，与 NERO 的比较使用 NERO 的数据集。混淆实验覆盖四种 Hikari 混淆，不包括加壳或加密。固件案例中，八个 32 位 ARM 固件映像的 1,061 个函数里有 172 个得到部分正确的名称。
why_fits_en: Adds execution-aware, calling-context function-name prediction for stripped binaries, evaluated across architectures, optimizations and obfuscations, complementing variable-name, type and data-structure recovery research.
why_fits_zh: 补充结合执行语义与调用上下文的去符号二进制函数名预测方法，并在多种架构、优化级别和混淆设置下评估，与变量名、类型及数据结构恢复研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref truncates the title to “SymLM”; the full title follows the ACM page and the author-hosted PDF, which carries the CCS ’22 header and DOI. ACM and Crossref agree on the four-author order and pages 1631–1645, and ACM marks the article free to read. An arXiv title search found no preprint. The reviewed 2025-07-06 repository snapshot is MIT-licensed and includes a vendored fairseq, dataset-generation scripts, a sample x64 dataset, training, prediction and evaluation scripts, and CodeWordNet training code. Its README sets up Python 3.8 with CUDA 11.3 PyTorch and pinned requirements such as transformers 4.16.2 and gensim 3.8.1; training needs a December 2021 Trex checkpoint and CodeWordNet models from Google Drive links, and it warns that newer Trex checkpoints may be incompatible. The full dataset is Zenodo record 8306055 (about 9.4 GB; CC BY 4.0 in its metadata), which is registered under the paper’s DOI rather than a separate dataset DOI. The paper reports 8 days of training on top of the Trex pretraining. Nothing was run or downloaded.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 将标题截断为“SymLM”；完整标题以 ACM 页面和作者托管的 PDF 为准，该 PDF 带有 CCS ’22 页眉及 DOI。ACM 与 Crossref 的四位作者顺序和页码 1631–1645 一致，ACM 将文章标为免费阅读。按标题检索 arXiv 未发现预印本。所审阅的 2025-07-06 仓库快照采用 MIT 许可证，包含内置的 fairseq、数据集生成脚本、x64 样例数据集、训练、预测与评估脚本以及 CodeWordNet 训练代码。其 README 使用 Python 3.8 与 CUDA 11.3 版 PyTorch，并固定 transformers 4.16.2、gensim 3.8.1 等依赖；训练需要通过 Google Drive 链接获取 2021 年 12 月的 Trex 检查点和 CodeWordNet 模型，README 并提示较新的 Trex 检查点可能不兼容。完整数据集位于 Zenodo 记录 8306055（约 9.4 GB；元数据标注 CC BY 4.0），该记录登记的是论文 DOI，而非单独的数据集 DOI。论文报告在 Trex 预训练之外还需训练 8 天。本次未运行或下载任何内容。

title: Nova: Generative Language Models for Assembly Code with Hierarchical Attention and Contrastive Learning
title_zh: Nova：结合层次注意力与对比学习的汇编代码生成式语言模型
date_basis: Publication year stated by the official ICLR proceedings; no finer publication date is asserted. The proceedings page's citation date of 2025-05-01 is not adopted, and the arXiv dates are not substituted.
date_basis_zh: 采用 ICLR 官方论文集标明的出版年份，不推定更精确的出版日期。论文集页面 2025-05-01 的引用日期未被采用，也不以 arXiv 日期代替。
description_en: Nova is a generative LLM for x86-64 assembly, trained from DeepSeek-Coder checkpoints on stripped, normalized gcc -O0 to -O3 assembly built from AnghaBench and The Stack. It adds hierarchical attention that builds per-instruction summaries, and contrastive objectives that keep a function's source and O0–O3 assembly close while ordering them by optimization level. Fine-tuned for decompilation, Nova-1.3B and Nova-6.7B reach 25.17% and 34.36% average Pass@1 on HumanEval-Decompile, 14.84 and 12.41 points above same-size LLM4Decompile; separately fine-tuned models report the highest average Recall@1 for O0-to-O3 binary code similarity on six real-world projects.
description_zh: Nova 是面向 x86-64 汇编的生成式大语言模型，从 DeepSeek-Coder 检查点出发，以 AnghaBench 与 The Stack 代码经 gcc -O0 至 -O3 编译、剥离符号并规范化后的汇编训练。它加入为每条指令构建摘要的层次注意力，以及对比学习目标：使同一函数的源码与 O0–O3 汇编表示彼此接近，并按优化级别排序。针对反编译微调后，Nova-1.3B 与 Nova-6.7B 在 HumanEval-Decompile 上的平均 Pass@1 分别为 25.17% 和 34.36%，比同规模 LLM4Decompile 高 14.84 和 12.41 个百分点；另行微调的模型在六个真实项目上的 O0 对 O3 二进制代码相似性检测中取得最高的平均 Recall@1。
scope_limitations_en: Decompilation is evaluated function by function on the 164 HumanEval-Decompile C problems, each compiled for x86-64 at O0–O3, by running 20 samples per function against the problems' test cases; Pass@k on these tests is neither whole-program nor equivalence evidence. Baselines other than LLM4Decompile and Nova were prompted with three-shot examples rather than fine-tuned. Similarity results cover O0 queries against O3 candidates in pools of 50–500 functions from Binutils, Curl, ImageMagick, SQLite, OpenSSL and PuTTY, after fine-tuning on BinaryCorp-3M. Decompilation fine-tuning used a 2.16M-pair sample, the README says only 50K files came from The Stack, and the paper limits Nova to x86-64 assembly and 1.3B and 6.7B models. Inputs require the paper's assembly normalization.
scope_limitations_zh: 反编译以函数为单位，在 HumanEval-Decompile 的 164 个 C 问题上评测；每个问题在 O0–O3 下编译为 x86-64，每个函数采样 20 次并以题目测试用例运行。基于这些测试的 Pass@k 既不能证明整程序反编译能力，也不能证明等价性。除 LLM4Decompile 与 Nova 外，其他基线采用三样例提示而非微调。相似性结果针对 O0 查询与 O3 候选，候选池为来自 Binutils、Curl、ImageMagick、SQLite、OpenSSL 与 PuTTY 的 50–500 个函数，模型先在 BinaryCorp-3M 上微调。反编译微调使用抽样的 216 万对数据，README 称仅从 The Stack 获取 5 万个文件；论文也说明 Nova 仅支持 x86-64 汇编，模型规模限于 1.3B 和 6.7B。输入需要按论文方式规范化汇编。
why_fits_en: Adds an assembly-specialized foundation model evaluated on both decompilation and binary code similarity, complementing the decompilation-specific LLM papers in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充一个面向汇编的基础模型，同时评测反编译与二进制代码相似性，与本节专注反编译的大语言模型论文互补。
metadata_notes: Authors follow the proceedings, which list pages 95905–95926. arXiv has seven versions: v1 of 2023-11-22 was titled 'Nova+: Generative Language Models for Binaries' (written Nova$^+$ in the arXiv metadata) and listed six authors, without Petr Babkin; the checked later versions (v3, v5, v7) use the final title, and v7 of 2025-11-11 states ICLR 2025 publication. The repository README's abstract gives a relative decompilation gain of up to 146.54%, while the paper reports absolute percentage points. Licence signals are listed separately: the reviewed 2026-01-04 repository commit carries a BSD 3-Clause LICENSE, and the Hugging Face cards for nova-1.3b, nova-6.7b and their -bcr decompilation variants are tagged bsd-3-clause-clear; the models start from DeepSeek-Coder checkpoints, whose terms are not assessed here. requirements.txt pins torch 2.3.0, transformers 4.40.2, vllm 0.5.0 and deepspeed 0.14.4 for a Python 3.10 environment, and training examples use four GPUs. No models were downloaded and no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 作者以论文集为准，论文集列出第 95905–95926 页。arXiv 共有七个版本：2023-11-22 的 v1 题为“Nova+: Generative Language Models for Binaries”（arXiv 元数据写作 Nova$^+$），列出六位作者，不含 Petr Babkin；本次核查的后续版本（v3、v5、v7）均使用最终标题，2025-11-11 的 v7 注明发表于 ICLR 2025。仓库 README 的摘要称反编译相对提升最高达 146.54%，论文报告的则是绝对百分点。各项许可信息分开记录：所审阅的 2026-01-04 仓库提交附有 BSD 3-Clause LICENSE，Hugging Face 上 nova-1.3b、nova-6.7b 及其 -bcr 反编译变体的模型卡均标注 bsd-3-clause-clear；模型从 DeepSeek-Coder 检查点出发，本条不评估其条款。requirements.txt 为 Python 3.10 环境固定 torch 2.3.0、transformers 4.40.2、vllm 0.5.0 与 deepspeed 0.14.4，训练示例使用四块 GPU。本次未下载模型，也未运行代码或实验。

title: Unleashing the Power of Generative Model in Recovering Variable Names from Stripped Binary
title_zh: 释放生成式模型在剥离符号二进制变量名恢复中的能力
date_basis: The official NDSS paper and the publisher’s Crossref deposit establish publication year 2025. The conference dates and the arXiv versions do not establish a publication day.
date_basis_zh: NDSS 官方论文与出版方提交的 Crossref 元数据确认出版年份为 2025；会议日期与各 arXiv 版本日期不能据此推定具体出版日。
description_en: GenNm suggests names for placeholder variables in decompiled code of stripped binaries by fine-tuning generative code models (CodeGemma-2B by default; CodeLlama-7B and a LoRA-tuned CodeLlama-34B are also tested). Queries add renamed caller code and callee signatures propagated along the call graph; a DPO-style symbol-preference optimization (SymPO) counters bias toward frequent training names, and a data-flow name-validation step chooses among candidates over iterative rounds. The authors report 5.6–11.4-point precision gains over VarBERT and ReSym on rebuilt DIRTY and VarCorpus datasets, and 22.8% precision on names unseen in training against 17.3% for the strongest baseline.
description_zh: GenNm 通过微调生成式代码模型（默认 CodeGemma-2B，另测试 CodeLlama-7B 及经 LoRA 微调的 CodeLlama-34B），为剥离符号二进制反编译代码中的占位变量建议名称。查询会加入沿调用图传播、已重命名的调用者代码与被调用者签名；类 DPO 的符号偏好优化（SymPO）抑制模型偏向训练集中高频名称，基于数据流的名称验证步骤则在多轮迭代中从候选名称里选择。作者报告，在重建的 DIRTY 与 VarCorpus 数据集上，其精确率比 VarBERT 和 ReSym 高 5.6–11.4 个百分点；对训练中未出现的名称，精确率为 22.8%，最强基线为 17.3%。
scope_limitations_en: Predictions are scored against debug-symbol names by token matching with SymLM's word clusters and rules, plus a GPT-4 evaluator for context relevance and semantic accuracy; neither shows that outputs are the original identifiers, and overall split-by-binary precision is 35.8% (DIRTY) and 41.2% (VarCorpus). Precision is about 30% for projects unseen in training, and gains are smaller at -O2 and -O3. Ground truth comes from debug information in Linux binaries rebuilt from GitHub projects or Gentoo packages, with IDA Pro output in the paper's examples. GenNm needs each binary's call graph, which is why the DIRTY dataset was rebuilt; split-by-function VarCorpus results use a 15% binary sample, and the black-box GPT-3.5/GPT-4 comparison uses 1,000 sampled functions. It recovers variable names only, not types, function names or full decompiled code.
scope_limitations_zh: 预测结果依据调试符号中的名称评分：一方面借助 SymLM 的词簇与规则进行词元匹配，另一方面由 GPT-4 评估器判断上下文相关性与语义准确性；两者都不能说明输出就是原始标识符，按二进制划分时整体精确率为 35.8%（DIRTY）和 41.2%（VarCorpus）。对训练中未出现的项目，精确率约为 30%，在 -O2 与 -O3 下的提升也较小。真实标签来自由 GitHub 项目或 Gentoo 软件包重建的 Linux 二进制文件中的调试信息，论文示例使用 IDA Pro 输出。GenNm 需要每个二进制的调用图，这也是重建 DIRTY 数据集的原因；VarCorpus 按函数划分的结果只使用 15% 的二进制样本，与黑盒 GPT-3.5／GPT-4 的比较使用 1,000 个抽样函数。它只恢复变量名，不恢复类型、函数名或完整的反编译代码。
why_fits_en: Adds generative, call-graph-aware variable-name recovery with explicit treatment of name-frequency bias, extending the learned-naming line of work in this section.
why_fits_zh: 补充结合调用图上下文、并专门处理名称频率偏差的生成式变量名恢复方法，延续了本节的学习式命名研究。
metadata_notes: The record uses the NDSS title and the 11 authors in the NDSS paper's order, which match Crossref; Crossref gives year 2025 without pages. The arXiv record has carried three titles. v1 of 2023-06-05, 'LmPa: Improving Decompilation by Synergy of Large Language Model and Program Analysis', listed nine authors, without Ziyang Huang and Danning Xie; its title framed the work as improving decompilation in general, although its abstract already targeted variable-name recovery. v2 of 2024-05-01 was 'Leveraging Generative Models to Recover Variable Names from Stripped Binary'. v3 of 2024-07-20 and v4 of 2024-12-09, with the 11 NDSS authors, are 'Symbol Preference Aware Generative Models for Recovering Variable Names from Stripped Binary'; the NDSS paper defers implementation details to this extended version. The paper cites the artifact as Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14220042, a v1.0 code snapshot under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14220041 as in the README badge. The reviewed 2026-01-29 repository commit is MIT-licensed, and Zenodo record 14287032 holds a 9.8 GB CC-BY-4.0 data package with intermediate results and model checkpoints. The README asks for Ubuntu 20.04+, Python 3.10 with vllm 0.5.3.post1, at least 24 GB of GPU memory for inference and 96 GB for training. No data or models were downloaded and no code or experiments were run.
metadata_notes_zh: 本条目采用 NDSS 标题，并按 NDSS 论文顺序列出 11 位作者，与 Crossref 一致；Crossref 仅给出 2025 年，未列页码。arXiv 记录先后使用过三个标题。2023-06-05 的 v1 题为“LmPa: Improving Decompilation by Synergy of Large Language Model and Program Analysis”，列出九位作者，不含 Ziyang Huang 与 Danning Xie；该标题将工作表述为泛化的反编译改进，但其摘要已聚焦变量名恢复。2024-05-01 的 v2 题为“Leveraging Generative Models to Recover Variable Names from Stripped Binary”。2024-07-20 的 v3 与 2024-12-09 的 v4 列出 NDSS 的 11 位作者，题为“Symbol Preference Aware Generative Models for Recovering Variable Names from Stripped Binary”；NDSS 论文将实现细节留给这一扩展版本。论文将产物引用为 Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14220042，即概念 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14220041（与 README 徽章一致）下的 v1.0 代码快照。所审阅的 2026-01-29 仓库提交采用 MIT 许可，Zenodo 记录 14287032 提供 9.8 GB、采用 CC-BY-4.0 的数据包，内含中间结果与模型检查点。README 要求 Ubuntu 20.04+、带 vllm 0.5.3.post1 的 Python 3.10，推理至少需要 24 GB 显存，训练建议 96 GB。本次未下载数据或模型，也未运行代码或实验。

title: BinaryAI: Binary Software Composition Analysis via Intelligent Binary Source Code Matching
title_zh: BinaryAI：基于智能二进制—源代码匹配的二进制软件成分分析
date_basis: ACM's Crossref deposit records print and online publication on 2024-04-12, two days before the April 14–20 ICSE 2024 conference; the conference dates and arXiv dates are not substituted for it.
date_basis_zh: ACM 提交的 Crossref 元数据将纸质与在线出版日期均记为 2024-04-12，早于 4 月 14–20 日举行的 ICSE 2024 两天；本条目不以会议日期或 arXiv 日期替代该日期。
description_en: BinaryAI identifies which open-source C/C++ libraries a stripped binary reuses by matching its functions to source code. Ghidra decompiles each binary function to pseudo-C, and a Pythia-410M model, trained with a CLIP-style contrastive loss on about 10 million binary–source function pairs, embeds pseudo-code and source functions in one space. Candidates retrieved from a corpus of 56,342,179 source functions from 12,013 libraries are refined with link-time locality and the call graph, and a library is reported when the share of its matched functions exceeds a threshold. The authors report 22.54% recall@1 against 10.75% for CodeCMR, and library-detection precision and recall of 85.84% and 64.98% against 73.36% and 59.81% for an unnamed commercial tool.
description_zh: BinaryAI 通过将剥离符号的二进制中的函数与源代码匹配，识别其复用了哪些开源 C/C++ 库。它先用 Ghidra 将每个二进制函数反编译为类 C 伪代码，再用以 CLIP 式对比损失、在约 1,000 万对二进制—源码函数上训练的 Pythia-410M 模型，把伪代码与源码函数嵌入同一向量空间。从包含 12,013 个库、56,342,179 个源码函数的语料中检索出候选后，方法借助链接时的位置局部性和调用图加以精炼；当某个库中被匹配函数的比例超过阈值时，即判定二进制包含该库。作者报告其 recall@1 为 22.54%，CodeCMR 为 10.75%；库识别的精确率与召回率分别为 85.84% 和 64.98%，一款未具名商业工具为 73.36% 和 59.81%。
scope_limitations_en: Training pairs come from ArchLinux and AUR packages compiled automatically with DWARF debug information, and the corpus and test set cover C/C++ projects only. The SCA test set is 150 stripped binaries the authors compiled from 85 GitHub projects, with 1,045 reused libraries labeled manually from build files, headers and license metadata; function-level ground truth covers 15 of those binaries (23,529 pairs). The recall@1 figures combine the model's validation set with those 15 binaries. The two commercial baselines are anonymized under confidentiality agreements, and every baseline was rebuilt on the authors' 12,013-library dataset. The 112 false positives the authors examined all trace to incomplete library-dependency data. The model, training pairs, source-function corpus and labeled test set are not public, and the hosted service the paper links may run a different model and corpus from the evaluated 2024 system. Matches identify reused source; they are not a decompilation or proof that the binary is unmodified.
scope_limitations_zh: 训练函数对来自自动编译并保留 DWARF 调试信息的 ArchLinux 与 AUR 软件包，语料和测试集均只涵盖 C/C++ 项目。软件成分分析测试集是作者由 85 个 GitHub 项目编译出的 150 个剥离符号的二进制，其中 1,045 个被复用库依据构建文件、头文件和许可证元数据人工标注；函数级真实标签仅覆盖其中 15 个二进制（23,529 对）。recall@1 数据合并了模型验证集与这 15 个二进制。两款商业基线依保密协议匿名，所有基线均在作者的 12,013 个库数据集上重建。作者检查的 112 个误报都可追溯到不完整的库依赖数据。模型、训练函数对、源码函数语料和带标注的测试集均未公开；论文链接的在线服务所用模型与语料可能不同于 2024 年评测的系统。匹配结果说明复用了哪些源码，并不是反编译结果，也不能证明二进制未被修改。
why_fits_en: Adds binary-to-source function matching and binary software composition analysis, which identify reused open-source code inside stripped binaries, complementing binary-to-binary similarity and decompilation research.
why_fits_zh: 补充二进制到源代码的函数匹配和二进制软件成分分析，用于识别剥离符号的二进制中复用的开源代码，与二进制间相似性及反编译研究互补。
metadata_notes: Crossref records the ICSE 2024 proceedings article, pages 1–13, and its seven-author order matches arXiv. arXiv v1 is dated 2024-01-20, v2 2024-01-23 and v3 2024-08-26; the reviewed v3 carries the ICSE '24 ACM reference format and DOI. The ACM landing page refused automated access, so publication facts follow Crossref and the arXiv v3 copy. The abstract links binaryai.net, which now redirects to the binaryai.cn web service, and the GPL-3.0 binaryai/sdk repository is a client for that service that needs a service credential. Neither releases the model, training pairs, corpus or labeled test set, so code_url and project_url stay null. A footnote says the module is deployed in industry with a growing corpus; another says the base model went through earlier OPT and BLOOM iterations before Pythia. Nothing was run.
metadata_notes_zh: Crossref 记录该文为 ICSE 2024 论文集文章，页码 1–13，七位作者顺序与 arXiv 一致。arXiv v1 发布于 2024-01-20，v2 为 2024-01-23，v3 为 2024-08-26；所审阅的 v3 带有 ICSE '24 的 ACM 引用格式与 DOI。ACM 文章页面拒绝自动访问，因此出版信息以 Crossref 和 arXiv v3 为准。摘要链接 binaryai.net，该地址现重定向至 binaryai.cn 在线服务；采用 GPL-3.0 许可的 binaryai/sdk 仓库是该服务的客户端，使用时需要服务凭据。两者都未发布模型、训练函数对、语料或带标注的测试集，因此 code_url 与 project_url 均为空。论文脚注说明该模块已在工业界部署且语料持续扩充；另一脚注说明基础模型此前曾采用 OPT 与 BLOOM，后改用 Pythia。本次未运行任何内容。
